jobs.excerpt: Taking network infrastructure from plan to performance nationwide.
jobs.description:
Taking network infrastructure from plan to performance nationwide.

Implementation Lead

Remote in US (based near one of these airport hubs- Atlanta, Houston, Dallas, Washington D.C, Charlotte or Chicago). Will require extensive travel

About the role

Are you an experienced implementation professional who thrives in fast-paced environments and enjoys leading complex network infrastructure deployments from start to finish? The Implementation Lead plays a critical role in coordinating onsite installation activities, ensuring quality standards are met, and serving as the primary field representative throughout project execution.

You'll lead installation teams, manage onsite logistics, oversee testing and troubleshooting efforts, and ensure deployments are completed accurately, safely, and efficiently. Your work will directly impact project success, customer satisfaction, and the performance of mission-critical network infrastructure

What you’ll be doing

As a member of the Deployment & Implementation team, you'll be responsible for coordinating field installations, ensuring infrastructure quality, and supporting successful project delivery across customer environments. Your responsibilities will include:

Installation Leadership & Project Coordination

  • Coordinate onsite implementation activities to ensure installations align with approved designs and project requirements.
  • Lead installation crews and serve as the primary onsite representative for Boldyn throughout project execution.
  • Coordinate activities between escorts, Field Service Representatives, contractors, vendors, and internal implementation teams.
  • Track installation progress and provide regular status updates to project managers and stakeholders.
  • Manage onsite inventory, equipment logistics, and installation resources to support project timelines.
  • Ensure all equipment is properly scanned, tracked, and installed in the correct locations.

Network Installation, Testing & Troubleshooting

  • Oversee installation of fiber, copper, and networking infrastructure.
  • Perform testing and validation of network infrastructure to ensure quality and performance standards are achieved.
  • Conduct signal strength and speed coverage verification to confirm alignment with deployment plans.
  • Troubleshoot network issues in partnership with Engineering, NOC, Circuit, and Vendor teams.
  • Repair and resolve fiber and copper connectivity issues identified during testing and commissioning activities.
  • Support the successful activation and optimization of deployed network solutions.

Quality Assurance & Documentation

  • Conduct quality control inspections of installed equipment and infrastructure.
  • Verify installations meet project specifications, company standards, and customer requirements.
  • Complete closeout documentation, including network records and wireless design as-builts.
  • Maintain accurate daily records, installation reports, and project documentation.
  • Capture and organize closeout photographs of installed equipment and completed work.
  • Support inventory reconciliation, return shipments, and project closeout activities. [

Collaboration & Customer Engagement

  • Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.
  • Communicate effectively with project teams, field personnel, and customers throughout deployment activities.
  • Foster a collaborative work environment focused on safety, quality, and operational excellence.
  • Support incident resolution, work order completion, and escalated field-related issues.
  • Contribute to a culture of teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.

What you’ll bring

Think you could make a difference here? We're looking for someone who brings strong technical installation expertise, leadership capabilities, and a commitment to delivering high-quality infrastructure solutions. You will also bring some of the following:

  • Minimum of 3+ years of experience in cabling installation, networking infrastructure, or related electronic systems.
  • Experience leading or coordinating field installation projects and onsite crews.
  • Technical school certification preferred but not required.
  • Knowledge of fiber optic and copper infrastructure installation, testing, and troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with IP networking, Ethernet, routers, firewalls, and CAT5/CAT6 technologies.
  • Ability to read and interpret construction drawings, installation specifications, and wiring diagrams.
  • Working knowledge of BICSI, INSTF, or related cabling standards and best practices preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in dynamic field environments.
  • Strong organizational skills with experience managing equipment, inventory, and project documentation.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, contractors, and internal teams.
  • Mechanical aptitude and proficiency using hand tools, power tools, and installation equipment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to follow established installation, testing, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • High level of accountability, integrity, adaptability, and attention to detail.
  • Ability and willingness to travel extensively. Candidates should be located near a major airport.

About us

At Boldyn Networks, we're reimagining the future of interconnectivity. Our network solutions are solving some of tomorrow’s greatest challenges. We are one team across the globe—always listening, learning, and challenging each other to be our best. Here, you can change lives today and create a better tomorrow.

Why work with us?

We’re large enough to deliver and maintain large-scale operations, yet agile enough to empower your growth. You’ll work on meaningful projects, collaborate with talented colleagues, and develop new skills along the way.

We also offer:

Ready to apply?

Are you ready to create an impact that will last for generations? Join us at Boldyn Networks today. Hit apply and follow the instructions to get started.

Diversity & Inclusion

We celebrate diversity in all its forms. Our backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences make us stronger. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of race, age, gender, background, or religion. Together, we’ll solve customer challenges in the smartest ways possible.

jobs.description:
Position Summary
Prometheus Federal Services (PFS) is a trusted partner to federal health agencies. We are seeking a Marketing / Media Specialist Sr that leads the planning, design, production, and delivery of integrated marketing and digital media products that support enterprise adoption of the VHA AI Education Hub. The specialist translates complex AI, policy, training, and program information into clear, engaging, accessible communications for VHA leaders, clinicians, operational and administrative staff, trainees, and other stakeholders. The role combines strategic marketing, visual communication, multimedia production, web content development, and user-centered design to build awareness, drive enrollment and completion, promote approved AI practices, and reinforce the Hub as the authoritative source for AI education, guidance, and guardrails.

Reasonable Accommodations Statement
To succeed in this job, an individual must be able to satisfactorily perform each essential duty. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform essential functions.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute an enterprise outreach and marketing strategy for the AI Education Hub, aligned with launch, adoption, engagement, and sustainment objectives.
  • Create audience-segmented campaign plans, message frameworks, editorial calendars, and channel strategies for clinicians, administrative staff, leaders, trainees, AI use-case owners, and field innovators.
  • Design and produce campaign toolkits, newsletters, leader talking points, presentations, infographics, web graphics, digital signage, email content, job aids, success stories, and other promotional assets.
  • Develop interactive and multimedia products that combine graphic design, animation, audio, video, and web functionality to support outreach and learning.
  • Support production of short video modules, recorded expert sessions, demonstrations, simulations, and other interactive learning assets in coordination with instructional designers, trainers, technical staff, and subject-matter experts.
  • Apply user-centered design principles to ensure media products, Hub interfaces, and campaign experiences are intuitive, consistent, and responsive to user needs.
  • Translate complex AI concepts, approved-use guidance, ethics, privacy, safety, policy, and governance information into plain-language, audience-appropriate content without overstating capabilities or replacing clinical judgment.
  • Establish and maintain visual standards, campaign identity, templates, and content-design conventions, including the visual designation system for VA-approved, external, or restricted content.
  • Ensure digital media, web content, documents, presentations, and audiovisual products meet applicable Section 508 accessibility requirements, including alternative text, color contrast, captions, transcripts, audio descriptions, and accessible interaction patterns.
  • Coordinate reviews and approvals with NAII, DHO, CAIO/OIT, VHA leadership, communications offices, education partners, privacy, security, legal, and other stakeholders.
  • Partner with evaluation and analytics staff to monitor reach, engagement, enrollment, completion, satisfaction, and campaign performance; recommend adjustments based on data and user feedback.
  • Identify, develop, and disseminate high-impact use cases and success stories that demonstrate responsible AI adoption and measurable value to the VHA workforce and Veterans.
  • Maintain organized source files, production documentation, content inventories, calendars, and archives in authorized VA environments.
  • Participate in agile sprint planning, status reporting, quality reviews, pilot refinement, enterprise launch activities, and transition-to-sustainment planning.

Primary Deliverables Supported

  • Content designation policy and visual designation system specification.
  • Platform architecture and user-experience design package.
  • Interactive learning asset library, including video, simulation, graphic, and knowledge-check components.
  • Enterprise launch plan and execution report.
  • Communication materials, including campaign toolkit, enterprise newsletters, and leader materials.
  • Live session calendar and content archive.
  • Success story compendium and dissemination plan.
  • Updated communication and media products reflecting pilot findings, analytics, emerging tools, and policy changes.
Minimum Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, media production, graphic design, digital design, web design, public relations, or a related field.
  • At least eight years of progressively responsible experience in marketing, digital media, multimedia production, visual communication, web content, or a closely related discipline.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing integrated outreach or adoption campaigns for large, complex organizations.
  • Advanced proficiency with contemporary graphic-design, presentation, video-editing, audio-editing, animation, prototyping, and web-content tools.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, content-management systems, and interactive media concepts sufficient to collaborate with developers and produce or configure responsive digital content.
  • Demonstrated ability to convert technical or policy-heavy subject matter into clear visual narratives and plain-language content for varied audiences.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent products, review cycles, and deadlines in an agile or fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of federal digital accessibility requirements and experience producing Section 508-conformant documents, web content, presentations, graphics, and multimedia.
  • Strong written, verbal, visual, interpersonal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to read, write, speak, and understand English and satisfy applicable VA suitability, background-investigation, privacy, information-security, training, and Rules of Behavior requirements.
  • Ability to work in the U.S. indefinitely without sponsorship
  • Ability to obtain a public trust
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs, Veterans Health Administration, another federal agency, or a large healthcare organization.
  • Experience marketing workforce-development, training, digital-transformation, AI, technology-adoption, or change-management initiatives.
  • Experience creating media for clinical, operational, administrative, and executive audiences.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft 365, SharePoint or intranet publishing, learning-management systems, and enterprise email or newsletter platforms.
  • Knowledge of responsible AI communications, including privacy, security, ethics, safety, and approved-use messaging.
  • Experience with usability testing, analytics, A/B testing, audience research, or campaign optimization.

Compensation & Benefits

PFS offers a benefits package that may include health, dental, and vision coverage; flexible spending accounts; disability and life insurance; a retirement plan; paid time off; and other programs to support employees and their families. Learn more about PFS Benefits.

The posted salary range is the company’s good-faith estimate for this role. PFS benefits and compensation are determined by various factors, including, but not limited to, location; the individual's particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience; as well as contract and organizational requirements.

Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000

Equal Employment Opportunity

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, parental status, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, political affiliation, military service, or other status protected by law.

Reasonable accommodations are available to ensure applicants with disabilities have equal access to the hiring process, in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable laws.

Syneos Health® is a leading fully-integrated life sciences services organization built to accelerate customer success. We partner with innovators at every point across the drug development and commercialization continuum, helping them navigate complexity, anticipate change and accelerate progress.

Our Clinical Solutions team members act with a drug development mindset, applying their years of experience and deep expertise to truly understand customer needs and represent those in the solutions we shape.

Whether you join us in a Functional Service Provider partnership or a Full-Service environment, you’ll collaborate with passionate problem solvers, innovating as a team to help our customers achieve their goals. We are agile and driven to deliver – for one another, our customers, and, most importantly, for those in need.

Discover what your 25,000 future colleagues already know:

Why Syneos Health

• We are passionate about developing our people, through career development and progression; supportive and engaged line management; technical and therapeutic area training; peer recognition and total rewards program.
• We are committed to building an inclusive culture – where you can authentically be yourself. Central to this is our purpose – Driven to Deliver – which captures the passion of our colleagues to show up each day and shape solutions that have the ability to dramatically impact someone’s life.
• We are continuously building the company we all want to work for and our customers want to work with. Why? Because we know that when we bring together smart colleagues from across the world, we can shape the future of healthcare, driving impact for customers and defining the pace of patient progress.

Job Responsibilities

  • Minimum 3 years of onsite monitoring experience.
  • 1-2 years of Oncology experience is preferred.
  • candidates with other therapeutic areas experience such as Neuroscience, Haematology, , Cardiovascular, Rare Disease also preferred.
  • Remote opportunity, Mumbai client based.
  • Performs site qualification, site initiation, interim monitoring, site management activities and close-out visits (performed on-site or remotely) ensuring regulatory, ICH-GCP and/or Good Pharmacoepidemiology Practice (GPP) and protocol compliance. Uses judgment and experience to evaluate overall performance of site and site staff and to provide recommendations regarding site-specific actions; immediately communicates/escalates serious issues to the project team and develops action plans. Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes.
  • Verifies the process of obtaining informed consent has been adequately performed and documented for each subject/patient, as required/appropriate. Demonstrates diligence in protecting the confidentiality of each subject/patient. Assesses factors that might affect subject/patient’s safety and clinical data integrity at an investigator/physician site such as protocol deviation/violations and pharmacovigilance issues.
  • Per the Clinical Monitoring/Site Management Plan (CMP/SMP): Assesses site processes. Conducts Source Document Review of appropriate site source documents and medical records. Verifies required clinical data entered in the case report form (CRF) is accurate and complete. Applies query resolution techniques remotely and on site, and provides guidance to site staff as necessary, driving query resolution to closure within agreed timelines. Utilizes available hardware and software to support the effective conduct of the clinical study data review and capture. Verifies site compliance with electronic data capture requirements.
  • May perform investigational product (IP) inventory, reconciliation and reviews storage and security. Verifies the IP has been dispensed and administered to subjects/patients according to the protocol. Verifies issues or risks associated with blinded or randomized information related to IP. Applies knowledge of GCP/local regulations and organizational procedures to ensure IP is appropriately (re)labelled, imported and released/returned.
  • Routinely reviews the Investigator Site File (ISF) for accuracy, timeliness and completeness. Reconciles contents of the ISF with the Trial Master File (TMF). Ensures the investigator/physician site is aware of the requirement of archiving essential documents in accordance with local guidelines and regulations.
  • Documents activities via confirmation letters, follow-up letters, trip reports, communication logs, and other required project documents as per SOPs and Clinical Monitoring Plan/Site Management Plan. Supports subject/patient recruitment, retention and awareness strategies. Enters data into tracking systems as required to track all observations, ongoing status and assigned action items to resolution.
  • For assigned activities, understands project scope, budgets, and timelines; manages site-level activities / communication to ensure project objectives, deliverables and timelines are met. Must be able to quickly adapt to changing priorities to achieve goals / targets.
  • May act as primary liaison with study site personnel, or in collaboration with Central Monitoring Associate. Ensures all assigned sites and project-specific site team members are trained and compliant with applicable requirements
  • Prepares for and attends Investigator Meetings and/or sponsor face to face meetings. Participates in global clinical monitoring/project staff meetings (inclusive of Sponsor representation, as applicable) and attends clinical training sessions according to the project specific requirements.
  • Provides guidance at the site and project level towards audit readiness standards and supports preparation for audit and required follow-up actions.
  • Maintains a working knowledge of ICH/GCP Guidelines or other applicable guidance, relevant regulations, and company SOPs/processes; completes assigned training as required. For Real World Late Phase, the CRA II will use the business card title of Site Management Associate II. Additional responsibilities include:Site support throughout the study lifecycle from site identification through close-out. Knowledge of local requirements for real world late phase study designs.Chart abstraction activities and data collection
    Collaboration with Sponsor affiliates, medical science liaisons and local country staff. The SMA II may be requested to train junior staff. Identify and communicate out of scope activities to Lead CRA/Project Manager. Proactively suggest potential sites based on local knowledge of treatment patterns, patient advocacy and Health Care Provider (HCP) associations.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree or RN in a related field or equivalent combination of education, training and experience
  • Minimum 3 years of onsite monitoring experience in Global Clinical Trials.
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practice/ICH Guidelines and other applicable regulatory requirements
  • Must demonstrate good computer skills and be able to embrace new technologies
  • Excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to manage required travel of up to 75% on a regular basis
  • US ONLY: As part of your employment with Syneos Health, you may be deployed to Sites that require certain medical and other personal information to gain facility access. Pursuant to our Employee Privacy Notice, Syneos Health can provide the Sites with the information necessary for you to gain such access. Further, a Site may ask you for additional information beyond that which Syneos Health has in its possession. You are required to comply with any such Site requests as a condition of your employment with Syneos Health. Please note that failure to provide requested information may result in a Site barring you from entry, which could put your ongoing employment at risk.

Get to know Syneos Health

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Insomniac Games is looking for a Senior Cinematics Facial Animator. In this role, the Senior Cinematics Facial Animator is responsible for creating high-quality in-game cinematic facial animation utilizing FACS based rigs that meet the visual and performance standards established by the Animation Director. This role includes integration of facial capture data into scene layouts and polish of facial performance through final implementation in the game engine.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following:

  • Develop high-quality cinematic facial animation content using both motion capture data and hand-key techniques with FACS based rigs, ensuring alignment with schedule and performance benchmarks.
  • Collaborate closely with Animation Directors and Lead Animators to design cinematic facial performances that reflect the game's vision and adhere to its unique cinematography style.
  • Contribute to setting and maintaining performance standards and working in tandem with other departments to ensure seamless integration of cinematics into the game engine.
  • Troubleshoot technical issues with facial animation integration into engine.
  • Refine and enhance character performances, focusing on facial animation, to create lifelike and engaging scenes.
  • Participate actively in cinematic team feedback sessions, presenting work, and incorporating constructive critique.
  • Demonstrate a strong grasp of animation and camera principles essential for crafting a realistic and immersive cinematic experience.
  • Utilize project management tools such as Jira and Flow to effectively track progress and manage workload.
  • Communicate efficiently with the Animation Director and Project Management to report on progress, addressing potential roadblocks to ensure timely delivery of tasks.
  • Perform additional related responsibilities as assigned to support the animation team's goals and objectives.

Supervisory Responsibilities: This job has no supervisory responsibilities, however this role mentors more junior artists.

Qualifications: To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Mathematical Skills: Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportions, percentages, area, circumference, and volume.  Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

Reasoning Skills: Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables.

Computer Skills: Advanced knowledge of Maya, Insomniac proprietary tools (preferred), and a knowledge of Microsoft Office Suite. MotionBuilder and Adobe Premiere a plus. Knowledge of common state machine flow in any game engine a plus.

jobs.excerpt: 📍 Location: Remote 📅 Experience: 3–6 years in SaaS Technical Project Management / Software Delivery 💼 Type: Full-time👤 Reports to: Product ManagersAbout iClosedWe're looking for the person who makes sure what we build actually ships — on time, with the right process, and without things getting lost between Product, Engineering, QA, and Design.
jobs.description:
📍 Location: Remote

📅 Experience: 3–6 years in SaaS Technical Project Management / Software Delivery

💼 Type: Full-time

👤 Reports to: Product Managers

About iClosed

We're looking for the person who makes sure what we build actually ships — on time, with the right process, and without things getting lost between Product, Engineering, QA, and Design.

Product Managers decide what we build. You own how and when it gets delivered: the plan, timeline, dependencies, process, release coordination, and visibility around delivery.

iClosed is a profit maximizer for high-ticket sales teams, helping them make more — much more — by plugging in iClosed. We work with customers like , Iman Gadzhi, Whop, , and thousands of users.

Our product moves fast, and we need someone who can bring structure to that speed. You'll run the full software development lifecycle, challenge timelines when they don't make sense, surface risks before they become delays, and make sure releases move cleanly from planning through production.

This is not a passive project coordinator role. You own delivery.

What You'll Own

Software Delivery

  • Own the SDLC end to end — from ticket readiness through development, QA, release, and post-release verification.
  • Turn product priorities into clear delivery plans, milestones, owners, and timelines.
  • Break epics into deliverable phases and manage dependencies across teams.
  • Identify delivery risks early and escalate before they turn into missed deadlines.
  • Keep every initiative moving and make ownership clear at every stage.

Agile Process

  • Run sprint planning, standups, backlog grooming, retrospectives, and delivery reviews.
  • Track velocity, throughput, burn-down, and other relevant delivery metrics.
  • Keep tickets, boards, ownership, and workflows clean and accurate.
  • Continuously improve the way Engineering, QA, Design, and Product work together.
  • Strengthen processes around definition of done, QA handoff, branching, deployment, and release readiness.

Release Management

  • Own the release calendar and coordinate deployments across teams.
  • Manage release readiness, go/no-go decisions, rollback preparation, and post-release verification.
  • Coordinate hotfixes and urgent production releases when required.
  • Ensure release notes and relevant documentation are completed.
  • Make sure everyone involved knows exactly what is shipping, when, and who owns each step.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Coordinate Engineering, QA, Design, and Product so dependencies don't become blockers.
  • Work closely with Product Managers on scope, sequencing, delivery trade-offs, and realistic timelines.
  • Challenge estimates where needed and push for clarity when scope or ownership is ambiguous.
  • Make sure handoffs between teams happen cleanly and nothing gets dropped.

Reporting & Visibility

  • Give leadership clear visibility into delivery status, risks, timelines, and blockers.
  • Report progress using meaningful delivery metrics rather than vague status updates.
  • Escalate quickly when something is off track.
  • Keep upcoming releases and priorities visible across the organization.

Who We're Looking For

Required

  • 3–6 years managing delivery of SaaS products in an agile environment.
  • Strong understanding of the SDLC and how modern web applications are built, tested, deployed, and maintained.
  • Hands-on experience with release management, including environments, versioning, CI/CD coordination, hotfixes, and production releases.
  • Proven experience coordinating cross-functional teams across Engineering, QA, Design, and Product.
  • Technical enough to follow architecture discussions, understand PR summaries, challenge estimates, and identify delivery risks.
  • Strong experience with project management tools such as Jira, Linear, or similar.
  • Comfortable owning workflows, ticket quality, boards, and delivery processes.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication — clear updates, focused meetings, and no ambiguity around ownership.
  • Startup mindset: hands-on, decisive, adaptable, and comfortable creating structure where it doesn't already exist.

Nice to Have

  • Previous experience as a developer or QA engineer.
  • Experience with AWS-based infrastructure and deployments.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment workflows.
  • Scrum Master, PMP, SAFe, or similar certification.
  • Exposure to SOC 2 or compliance-driven software change management.

Success in This Role

  • Releases ship when the team says they will.
  • Delivery risks and dependencies are surfaced before they become delays.
  • Engineering, QA, Design, and Product always know what they own and what's coming next.
  • Sprint and release processes are consistent, visible, and predictable.
  • Product Managers can focus on product direction instead of chasing delivery.
  • Leadership has clear visibility into timelines, blockers, and release status.
  • The development process gets stronger and more efficient over time.

What We Offer

  • Work directly with the founding and product teams.
  • Fully remote environment.
  • Flexible schedule.
  • Fitness and Healthcare Allowance.
  • Competitive compensation.
  • Performance-based bonus structure.
  • Long-term growth opportunities as the Product and Engineering organization scales.

Why is this one different?

You're not here to schedule meetings and chase people for updates.

You're the person who makes delivery predictable.

Product decides what should be built. Engineering builds it. You make sure the entire system between those two points works — scope, sequencing, dependencies, QA, releases, communication, and process.

When something is slipping, you know before everyone else. When a release is coming, everyone knows exactly what's happening. When the team grows, the delivery process grows with it.

Nail it, and you'll become a key part of how iClosed scales its Product and Engineering organization.

If you're excited to be part of a team that values speed, ownership, clarity, and shipping, we'd love to hear from you!

  • Product Experience: Demonstrated experience partnering with Product and Engineering teams in agile environments, including backlog review, requirements clarification, acceptance criteria, testing, release readiness, and operational escalation management.
  • Communication: Ability to synthesize complex data issues into clear written summaries, executive-ready recommendations, client-ready explanations, and actionable requirements for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Organizational Skills: Ability to manage multiple escalations, release reviews, stakeholder requests, and product workstreams in a fast-paced environment while maintaining clear prioritization and follow-through.
  • Preferred Experience: Experience supporting RWD products, clinical analytics products, data quality programs, client-facing healthcare platforms, identity management workflows, or data governance operating models preferred.

 Education:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Health Informatics, Medical Informatics, Computer Science, Health Information Management, Nursing, Pharmacy, Analytics, or a related field required.
  • Master's Degree in Medical Informatics, Health Informatics, Business Analytics, Healthcare Administration, or a related discipline preferred.
  • Relevant professional certifications, such as AHIC, CPHIMS, RHIA, CCS, CHDA, or equivalent experience, a plus.

Physical Demands and Work Environment:

  • Sedentary work (i.e. sitting for long periods of time);
  • Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or negligible amount of force;
  • Frequently or constantly lift, carry push, pull or otherwise move objects and repetitive motions;
  • Subject to inside environmental conditions
  • Travel for this position will include less than 10-15% as needed to perform job responsibilities.

Inovalon Offers a Competitive Salary and Benefits Package

In addition to the base compensation, this position may be eligible for performance-based incentives.

The actual base pay offered may vary depending on multiple factors including, but not limited to, job-related knowledge/skills, experience, business needs, geographical location, and internal equity. At Inovalon, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top end of the range for their role, and compensation decisions are dependent upon the facts and circumstances of each position and candidate.

Inovalon invests in associates to help them stay healthy, save for long-term financial goals, and manage the demands of work and personal commitments. That’s why Inovalon offers a valuable benefits package with a wide range of choices to meet associate needs, which may include health insurance, life insurance, company-paid disability, 401k, 18+ days of paid time off, and more.

Base Compensation Range
$135,000—$160,000 USD

This position is not eligible for immigration sponsorship (e.g. H-1B, TN, or E-3). Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States as a condition of employment. (This is only applicable for US-based positions)

If you don’t meet every qualification listed but are excited about our mission and the work described, we encourage you to apply. Inovalon is most interested in finding the best candidate for the job, and you may be just the right person for this or other roles.

By embracing inclusion, we enhance our work environment and drive business success. Inovalon strives to provide equal opportunities to the communities where we operate and to our clients and everyone whom we serve. We endeavor to create a culture of inclusion in which our associates feel empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work and pursue their professional goals in an equitable setting. We understand that by fostering this type of culture, and welcoming different perspectives, we generate innovation and growth.

jobs.excerpt: Who we are:Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable.
jobs.description:
Who we are:

Motive empowers the people who run physical operations with tools to make their work safer, more productive, and more profitable. For the first time ever, safety, operations and finance teams can manage their drivers, vehicles, equipment, and fleet related spend in a single system. Combined with industry leading AI, the Motive platform gives you complete visibility and control, and significantly reduces manual workloads by automating and simplifying tasks.

Motive serves nearly 100,000 customers – from Fortune 500 enterprises to small businesses – across a wide range of industries, including transportation and logistics, construction, energy, field service, manufacturing, agriculture, food and beverage, retail, and the public sector.

Visit to learn more.

About the Role

Motive's Strategic Analytics (SA) team drives data-informed decision-making for the Product organization. We turn business metrics and product usage data into insight that directly shapes strategy across Growth, Churn, and Profitability.

This Senior Analyst role sits at the center of Profitability — a high-visibility domain in SA right now. You will own complex COGS and gross margin analysis across Motive's hardware and software product lines, work directly with our CPO, CTO, and senior leadership, and turn ambiguous executive questions into clear, defensible analytical POVs. This is not a reporting role. This is a problem-solving role.

You will start as a pure individual contributor and own your work end-to-end. Over time, there is a real path to taking on team leadership responsibilities.

What You’ll Do

  • Own end-to-end COGS and gross margin analysis for Motive’s hardware and software product lines — including vehicle gateways, dashcams, and a growing suite of software products
  • Model cost-saving opportunities, build scenario analyses, and deliver recommendations on profitability levers directly to the CPO, CTO, and finance leadership
  • Take ambiguous, high-stakes business questions from senior stakeholders — structure them, build the analysis, and walk into executive conversations with a clear point of view
  • Partner closely with data engineering, finance, and product teams to understand cost drivers, surface insights, and influence roadmap and investment decisions
  • Navigate messy, complex data environments — establish ground truth, build reliable datasets, and create durable analytical frameworks the broader team can build on
  • Contribute to the operational rigor of the SA team: documentation, version control practices, and analytical best practices
  • Operate with minimal supervision — you own your domain, manage your own priorities, and push work forward without waiting to be told what to do next

Must Haves:

  • 7+ years of experience in analytics, strategic finance, or a closely related field — with demonstrated depth in financial/operational modeling
  • Expert-level SQL — you write complex queries independently and fluently
  • Deep understanding of unit economics: gross margin, contribution margin, COGS structures, cost drivers, and scenario modeling
  • Proven ability to independently frame and decompose ambiguous business problems — you structure the question before you answer it
  • Strong executive communication skills — you have presented analytical findings and a clear POV directly to VP or C-suite stakeholders
  • High autonomy and self-sufficiency — you thrive in fast-moving environments where context is incomplete and priorities shift
  • Experience working in messy data environments where you have had to establish definitions, validate data quality, and build from the ground up

Strong Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with hardware + software combination products (IoT, fleet technology, consumer electronics, or similar) and how COGS behaves differently from pure SaaS
  • Python for analysis and automation
  • Hands-on experience with a modern analytics stack — dbt, Airflow, or equivalent — and opinions about how analytics teams should operate
  • Background in strategic finance, FP&A, or management consulting with a strong technical layer

Who Thrives in This Role

You are the kind of analyst who treats a vague exec question as a starting point, not a blocker. You break problems down structurally, get into the data, and come back with something actionable and defensible. You are comfortable being wrong and updating your view. You do not need someone to hand you a well-defined problem — you build the definition. You care about the quality of your work and take pride in the clarity of your communication.

This role is not a good fit if you primarily want to build dashboards, manage a team, or work in a highly structured environment with clean data and well-defined scope.

What We Offer

  • Direct impact on Motive’s most strategically important financial decisions
  • Close partnership with the CPO and CTO — your work shapes how senior leadership thinks about the business
  • A team that values independent thinking, intellectual rigor, and clear communication over process and hierarchy
  • Path to team leadership as the role evolves
  • Competitive compensation, benefits, and equity
  • Fully remote with a collaborative, high-trust culture

Pay Transparency

Motive offers benefits including health, pharmacy, optical and dental care benefits, paid time off, sick time off, short term and long term disability coverage, life insurance as well as 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). jobs.description:
About Ping Identity:

At Ping Identity, we believe in making digital experiences both secure and seamless for all users, without compromise. We call this digital freedom. And it's not just something we provide our customers. It's something that inspires our company. People don't come here to join a culture that's built on digital freedom. They come to cultivate it.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

While protecting digital identities is at the core of our technology, protecting individual identities is at the core of our culture. We champion every identity. One of our core values, Respect Individuality, reminds us to celebrate differences so you are empowered to bring your authentic self to work.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. At Ping Identity, we're changing the way people and businesses think about cybersecurity, digital experiences, and identity and access management.

The Global Support Organization is the foremost interface between Ping and our valued customers and partners. Members of the Ping Identity Support Team are specialists in their field, responsible for providing an exceptional level of support. We operate a follow-the-sun, multi-site, model. We work with our partners and customers twenty four hours a day on services that affect both their workforce and customers. We help our customers succeed in the application, administration, and maintenance of their Ping solutions.

You will report to the Support Team manager. Ping has developed a career ladder for support to ensure there is growth potential for all employees.

In this role there is an element of on-call, on rotation across the global team to ensure that response and resolution Service level agreements are met.

Team members work a varied schedule supporting our global customer base.

Responsibilities Include:

  • You will be the dedicated engineers for our premium customers. Setting up troubleshooting sessions and speaking with customers via phone will happen regularly
  • Investigate and reproduce issues in your own lab environment.
  • Manage customer expectations and ensure SLAs are being met
  • Communicate frequently follow up with the customer by phone, email, and internet meeting systems
  • Contribute to our knowledge base
  • Understand our business processes
  • Sharing knowledge, onboarding, and supporting other Engineers.

You Have:

  • Excellent understanding of how SaaS applications and supporting SaaS solutions operate
  • Troubleshoot web-based applications (through HTTP Tracing tools and log analysis) in browsers and applications servers
  • Single Sign On (SAML, OAuth, OpenID, WS-Fed & JWT)
  • Experience with React, Angular, or Vue is a plus
  • Understanding of PKCE (Proof Key for Code Exchange) and biometric integration
  • Lightweight Directory Access Protocol and Directory Services, PKI, X.509 certificates, and
  • Internet Protocols (HTTPS/SSL/TLS )
  • Networking including Load Balancers, Firewalls, IP, and DNS
  • Linux-based and Windows server OS management
  • Excellent communication skills and organization
  • Experience working in high-pressure environments

Desired Technology Exposure and Knowledge

  • Containerized Infrastructure – Docker / Kubernetes
  • API Management inc. Postman / cURL
  • Web-application servers (i.e. Apache, IIS, NGINX, Tomcat, WebSphere, and WebLogic)
  • Identity & Access Management or Federation experience with CA SiteMinder/IdentityMinder, IBM Identity and Access Manager, Oracle Access Manager
  • User Provisioning (SCIM)
  • Cloud Services such as Azure, O365, AWS, Google

Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000

In accordance with Colorado’s Equal Pay for Equal Work Act (SB 19-085) the approximate compensation range for this role in Colorado is listed above. Final compensation for this role will be determined by various factors, such as knowledge, skills, and abilities.

Life at Ping:

We believe in and facilitate a flexible, collaborative work environment. We’re growing quickly, but remain true to the innovative, can-do startup values that got us here. Most importantly, we keep hiring talented, smart, fun, and genuinely nice people because that’s who we want to succeed with every day.

Here are just a few of the things that make Ping special:

  • A company culture that empowers you to do your best work.
  • Employee Resource Groups that create a sense of belonging for everyone.
  • Regular company and team bonding events.
  • Competitive benefits and perks.
  • Global volunteering and community initiatives

Our Benefits:

  • Generous PTO & Holiday Schedule
  • Parental Leave
  • Progressive Healthcare Options
  • Retirement Programs
  • Opportunity for Education Reimbursement
  • Commuter Offset (Specific locations)

Ping is the collective sum of all our individual experiences, backgrounds and influences and we pride ourselves in growing and learning together. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse environment where everyone’s individuality is respected and everyone has an Identity. In recruiting for new colleagues, we welcome the unique contributions you can bring and encourage you to be your best self.

We are an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex including sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability, protected Veteran Status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Consumer Engagement
jobs.excerpt: About NicheNiche is the leader in school search.  Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free.
jobs.description:
About Niche

Niche is the leader in school search. Our mission is to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. With in-depth profiles on every school and college in America, 140 million reviews and ratings, and powerful search tools, we help millions of people find the right school for them. We also help thousands of schools recruit more best-fit students, by highlighting what makes them great and making it easier to visit and apply.

Niche is all about finding where you belong, and that mission inspires how we operate every day. We want Niche to be a place where people truly enjoy working and can thrive professionally.

About The Role

Every year, over half of all college-bound high school seniors come to Niche to figure out where they belong. For many of those students, this is the most consequential decision they’ve made in their lives. Niche’s mission is to make that process easy, transparent, and free for all of them. To do that, we’ve built out a robust set of tools to help them find the right schools, guide them through the enrollment process, and understand the full financial picture.

This role exists to own the registered student relationship end to end: what happens after someone completes registration, why they come back, and how useful Niche stays to them over the course of their enrollment journey.

What You Will Own

  • The post-registration lifecycle. Activation into first real value, and the ongoing reasons a student returns to Niche. You define what a healthy registered student looks like at each stage of their journey and will be accountable for moving those cohorts in partnership with our marketing team across both our web and app experiences.
  • Re-engagement across surfaces. Improving our lifecycle messaging, push notifications, and personalized recommendations in collaboration with marketing. Deciding what we send, to whom, when, and just as importantly what we stop sending.
  • Personalization and matching quality. Making the logged-in experience more contextually relevant and delightful than the anonymous one. School recommendations, saved-list intelligence, scholarship and cost matching that dynamically updates the experience to reflect what we actually know about a student.
  • Balancing student experience with business needs. Grow the amount of data related to student interest and disinterest to both power a more relevant experience for them and unlock actionable insights for our college partners to drive revenue.
  • Cross-team dependencies. The registered student experience has a broad surface area intersecting with many teams and areas of ownership. You'll spend time getting alignment with other product teams and cross-functional partners, identifying opportunities for mutual benefit with other roadmaps you don't directly control.

What You Will Do

Within 3 Months:

You understand the registered student funnel cold: where students drop between account and full registration, what our real return-rate curves look like by acquisition source and device, and which re-engagement surfaces are actually working. You've talked to students. You've shipped tests that have already begun moving the needle on engagement and retention.

Within 6 Months:

You have a solid understanding of the full student journey and how that differs by segments and personas. You’ve taken learnings from the current enrollment cycle hits and misses and developed a clear strategy for what the most important metrics to move are based on correlation to business value and how you intend to move them.

Within 12 Months:

The registered experience for the next enrollment cycle is measurably better than the previous one based on student engagement and retention patterns. Students come back more, they go deeper in the experience and the data they generate is creating more value for our college partners.

What We Are Looking For

  • Comfort with ambiguity and real ownership. This role will own a broad surface area with many plausible strategies. You’re comfortable being the one making the difficult decisions about where to focus our time and energy, and then backing that up or changing course based on evidence
  • Rigor with data and experimentation. You have a strong background in data and can understand SQL - even when AI is the one writing it. You know the difference between a cohort curve and a monthly active user count, and have designed experiments that connect the dots between leading metrics and long-term user outcomes
  • Product craft and deep user empathy. You’ve been hands on with user research and partner closely with design to deeply understand user problems and how to solve them. You have a strong point of view about what a good consumer experience feels like, and can tell the difference between an experience improving and a vanity metric going up
  • Fluency with AI as a product capability and a working tool. You’ve shipped products where an AI model was doing meaningful work - that might be personalization, matching, content generation, document understanding - and can speak to how you evaluated cost and quality tradeoffs. You also use AI tooling in your own workflows to move faster on research, analysis and shaping product bets. You have opinions about where it helps and where it produces confident slow
  • Genuine investment in our problem space. Niche exists to make researching and enrolling in schools easy, transparent, and free. A lot of our users are the first in their family to navigate this process. You don't need a background in education, but you should care that the students who can benefit most from our product are the ones least likely to have other sources of support
  • An ability to think in systems. Our product is a 2-sided marketplace and we support a broad range of students. Decisions that seem simple on the surface can have wide-ranging impacts on those students or our college partners. You have a demonstrated ability to think beyond the immediate impact, weigh second order effects and make high-quality decisions

Nice to haves

  • Background in a two-sided marketplace where you balanced consumer and business-customer needs
  • Experience with influencing short-term metrics to drive decision-making outcomes over long time horizons like the multi-year journey of college enrollment
  • Familiarity with the college search, admissions, or financial aid landscape
  • Experience with consumer-facing products for teenagers

Compensation

Our national target base salary range is $133,000-$167,000, plus participation in our Annual Bonus and Stock Option Program. Base compensation will be commensurate with experience and skills.

At Niche, our Total Rewards Philosophy is centered around creating a workplace environment that attracts, motivates, and retains top talent by providing a comprehensive and competitive rewards package. This philosophy is built on the principles of performance-based compensation, best-in-class benefits and work-life balance, and employee well-being.

Interview Process

Candidate experience is a top priority for our talent and hiring teams. We believe in providing a transparent, authentic and comprehensive interview process where you have the opportunity to learn about us while we get to know you and your experience. The interview process is outlined here:

  • Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Partner - 30 Minutes

  • Video Interview with Hiring Manager - 45 Minutes

  • Case Study - 60 Minutes (candidates presented with a relevant product problem and given up to 3 days to build a case study - presenting to a cross-functional group including engineering, design, and CPO)

WhyNiche?

  • We are a fully flexible workforce empowering our employees to choose to work remotely, in our Pittsburgh office or whatever combination suits you
  • Full time, salaried position with competitive compensation in a fast-growing company
  • Best-in-class 100% paid employee health plan, including vision and dental and supplemental coverage
  • Flexible Paid Time Off Policy
  • Stipend that allows you to build your work from home office in a style and function that suits your personal preferences
  • Parental leave for all employees (12 weeks fully paid) in addition to short term disability for birthing parents
  • Meaningful 401(k) with employer match
  • Your ideas and work will make an immediate impact on our company and millions of users
  • You will join a team that cares about you, our mission, our work - and celebrates our wins together!

Niche will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship now or in the future for this opening.

We are currently hiring in states where we currently have employees: AZ, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KY, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MO, NE, NV, NH, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OK, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, VA, WA, DC, WV.

Candidates only. No recruiters or agencies, please. Sorry, we do not offer relocation assistance.

Niche is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. Therefore, we provide employment opportunities without regard to age, race, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, marital status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, nationality, sex, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable law.

All interviews are being held remotely. If there are preparations we can make to help ensure you have a comfortable and positive interview experience, please let us know.

Job Purpose

The Journals Indexing Specialist is a global role responsible for maintaining end to end processes associated with journals indexing at Sage. The job holder will develop and maintain processes to enhance the visibility of Sage journals by preparing robust indexing applications to indexing partners. The Journals Indexing Specialist will be responsible for collaborating with editorial, research integrity and production to ensure journals are maintaining quality standards expected by indexers and monitor the evolving requirements of external indexing services. Using data driven insights, the Journals Indexing specialist will work with the Associate Director, Research Integrity to drive the indexing strategy at Sage; monitor journals at risk of quality concerns as well as ensure successful applications to indexing services.

Key Accountabilities

  • Independently oversee the end-to-end processes associated with journal indexing applications and coverage of content by working with Production, Research Integrity, Editorial and Legal teams
  • Develop processes to support rigorous journal indexing applications at Sage
  • Create actionable, data-driven insights for Editorial and Research Integrity Teams to ensure journals adhere to indexer requirements
  • Provide subject matter expertise and acts as first point of contact for queries within Sage about indexing
  • Provide training and educational resources for Sage and external editors
  • Communicate effectively with internal and external stakeholders on behalf of Sage, act as a point of contact for all indexing services
  • Proactively identify opportunities for improvement and work with Associate Director, Research Integrity to implement cross-functional processes
  • Maintain workflows, meetings, and documentation, to ensure the indexing processes are well-organized and understood by Editorial teams
  • Maintain successful relationships with production and journal editorial teams at Sage
  • Maintain knowledge of changing indexing requirements, trends and overall research publishing landscape

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

  • Extensive knowledge of bibliometrics and analysing citations data in research journals
  • Proficiency in data analytics, data visualization using standard IT packages
  • In-depth experience in research and scholarly publishing and indexing services, particularly a working knowledge of Research Integrity principles and Production processes in journals
  • Experience collaborating with diverse stakeholders and building strong relationships with external partners
  • Evidence of familiarity with searching various databases such as Web of Science, PubMed/MEDLINE, Scopus, and their requirements for new journals.
  • Strong communication skills to translate complex concepts to external and internal stakeholders
  • Research experience, especially in a relevant background such as bibliometrics or scientometrics is highly desirable
  • High attention to detail and organisation skills to manage multiple priorities.

· A continuous improvement mindset

About the Opportunity – Manager, Customer Success Strategic Accounts

    The Customer Success Leader leads a team of Customer Success Managers supporting our High Touch and Strategic Accounts, utilizing the Lever Applicant Tracking System, driving retention and expansion across this high-value portfolio and partnering cross-functionally to ensure these customers achieve ongoing adoption and value from our products. This role carries direct responsibility for retention through renewal conversations, ensuring the team proactively owns the renewal process and outcomes across their book of business. It blends people leadership, strategic account planning, and operational rigor to deliver measurable results for our most complex, highest-value customer relationships.

About the Team:

    The Customer Success team is dedicated to helping our customers get the most value from Employ’s solutions while building strong, lasting partnerships. Our High Touch and Strategic Accounts team supports some of our most complex and high-value customers, working collaboratively to drive adoption, strengthen relationships, and support long-term retention and growth. We’re a customer-focused team that values collaboration, accountability, and delivering meaningful outcomes for our customers.

What You’ll Do:

    • Lead, mentor, and set clear performance expectations for a team of CSMs, conducting regular evaluations and providing timely, constructive feedback.

    • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement, while challenging team members to grow their capabilities and capacity.

    • Recruit and hire talent aligned with our core values and business needs; support onboarding so new hires ramp effectively.

    Customer Relationship Management & Renewals

    • Guide CSMs on strategy, problem-solving, and relationship-building for their own accounts; navigate and advise on complex, multi-party or enterprise requests, escalating as needed.

    • Own the end-to-end renewals process: inspect each CSM's renewal book for on-pace early engagement, confirmed intent-to-renew, documented strategy, and flagged zero-activity accounts.

    • Ensure every renewal carries the standard price uplift position, with exceptions escalated for approval, and drive forecast discipline so churn/expansion fields reflect true expectations.

    • Coach the team on renewal strategy, negotiation, and objection handling; partner with Sales and Finance/Deal Desk to structure terms that protect and grow revenue.

    Value Realization & Customer Voice

    • Inspect the team's value and adoption motion alongside renewals, ensuring every account has a live, outcome-based success plan with playbooks triggered on below-threshold accounts.

    • Hold the team accountable for multi-threaded relationships (documented power maps on top-tier accounts) and treat champion departures as risk triggers; build your own second-layer relationships on key accounts.

    • Own the team's voice-of-customer loop — timely NPS follow-up, documented detractor action plans, and recurring themes rolled up to senior leadership.

    Strategy and Cross-Functional Support

    Performance Monitoring and Reporting

    • Own segment-level results against topline outcomes (GRR, NRR, churn, uplift expansion, on-time renewal rate, forecast accuracy, multi-year renewal %, logo retention) and leading indicators (health score mix, NPS, adoption rate, business review completion).

    • Prepare regular reports for senior management on team achievements, challenges, and opportunities for improvement.

jobs.excerpt: My jsme Teya! Teya vznikla na základě jednoduchého přesvědčení: lokální podniky si zaslouží víc.
jobs.description:
My jsme Teya!

Teya vznikla na základě jednoduchého přesvědčení: lokální podniky si zaslouží víc.

Jsou to kavárny, restaurace, salony, obchody a podnikatelé, kteří vdechují život našim ulicím, vytvářejí pracovní místa a drží komunity pohromadě. Finanční služby jim však život příliš dlouho jen ztěžovaly – zbytečně složitými nástroji, špatnou podporou a komplexností, která je při podnikání jen brzdí.

Teya existuje proto, aby to změnila.

Budujeme finanční platformu pro lokální podniky po celé Evropě – platformu postavenou na jednoduchých nástrojích, propracovaném designu a reálné lidské podpoře. Naši členové na nás spoléhají, že jim pomůžeme podnikat s jistotou, a tato zodpovědnost formuje způsob, jakým pracujeme. Postupujeme rychle. Záleží nám na kvalitě. Jdeme do hloubky detailů. A věříme, že skvělé výsledky a upřímná pohostinnost by měly jít ruku v ruce.

Pokud chceš vytvářet smysluplné produkty, řešit reálné problémy a přinést lokálním podnikům skutečnou změnu, ozvi se nám!

Co tě u nás čeká? 🚀

Hledáme zkušeného obchodníka do terénu na pozici Business Development Manager, který se připojí k našemu rychle rostoucímu obchodnímu týmu, vezme věci pevně do rukou a pomůže nám posunout byznys na další úroveň.

  • Autonomie a výsledky: Konzistentně plnit KPI s minimální mírou vedení a udržovat přesné záznamy v CRM, reporting a dokonalý přehled o pipeline.

  • Akce v terénu: Proaktivně vyhledávat a oslovovat potenciální zákazníky ve svěřeném regionu prostřednictvím přímého oslovování, networkingu a doporučení.

  • Konzultativní prodej: Setkávat se se zákazníky osobně, rozumět jejich potřebám, výzvám a cílům a budovat důvěru skrze hodnotový prodej a dlouhodobé vztahy.

  • Nové segmenty a větší klienti: Rozšiřovat dosah Teya do nových segmentů a získávat větší, vysoce hodnotné klienty a podniky s více provozovnami s využitím (nejen) tvých dosavadních kontaktů.

  • Rozvoj produktové znalosti a podpora týmu: Rozvíjet silnou znalost produktů a řešení Teya, školit ostatní a podporovat juniornější obchodní zástupce prostřednictvím koučování, stínování a sdílení znalostí.

  • Zpětná vazba a inovace: Sdílet a vytvářet poznatky o potřebách zákazníků, konkurenci a trhu s cílem zlepšovat produkty, procesy a zkušenost obchodníků, včetně identifikace příležitostí pro partnerství a integrace.

  • Strategické projekty: Zapojovat se do mezioborových strategických projektů a navrhovat zlepšení, která mají přímý dopad na výsledky oblasti a kvalitu výstupů.

  • Upselling a cross-selling: Budovat dlouhodobé vztahy se zákazníky a aktivně identifikovat relevantní příležitosti k rozvoji jejich spolupráce s námi.

  • Reprezentace a kultura: Reprezentovat Teya jako důvěryhodný, profesionální ambasador vedený našimi hodnotami a přispívat ke spolupracující, výkonnostně orientované prodejní kultuře, která si cení učení.

  • Týmová podpora: Nejsi na to sám. V týmu si radíme, sdílíme tipy a navíc se inspirujeme od kolegů z Velké Británie, Maďarska, Chorvatska nebo Islandu.

Co k tomu potřebuješ? ✅

  • Jazyky:Češtinu/slovenštinu (C1) a angličtinu na plynulé úrovni (B2) – budeš v kontaktu s českými klienty i kolegy ze zahraničí.

  • Drive: Zkušenost s obchodem alespoň 3 roky, silná orientace na výsledky, vedení obchodních jednání na úrovni, plánování, reportování a doručování cílů.

  • Komunikace: Musíš si umět s lidmi povídat, vysvětlit jim složité věci jednoduše a umět je přesvědčit.

  • Týmový duch: I když jsi v terénu sólo, pořád jsi součástí party, která táhne za jeden provaz. Mrkni na náš Instagram @, ať vidíš, s kým do toho jdeš!

  • Odolnost: Fintech roste raketově. Musíš umět reagovat na změny a nebát se dynamického prostředí.

Co za to?💰

  • Férová fixní mzda + motivující bonusy – tvoje snaha se cení!

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

As a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) with Evergreen Nephrology, you are responsible for conducting monthly clinical check-ins, identifying and addressing clinical concerns, reinforcing care plans, escalating issues appropriately, and ensuring clinical documentation accuracy across both the EHR and partner technology platform. This position requires clinical judgment, licensed expertise, and the ability to support patients between office visits while collaborating closely with Evergreen’s providers, care teams, and leadership. LPNs are essential to delivering a safe, compliant, clinically credible Connected Care Program.

The program uses SMS as the first-line channel for patient engagement, with phone outreach used when appropriate.

While this position is fully remote, you must be able to work from 8:30am – 5pm in the pacific time zone.

Role Responsibilities

  • Patient Engagement & Outreach
    • Perform monthly CCM touchpoints for assigned patient panels.
    • Build strong, ongoing relationships with patients and caregivers through regular outreach.
    • Review patient chart data (diagnoses, kidney disease history, medications, labs, imaging, treatment cycles) before calls.
    • Explain CCM participation and reinforce program benefits.
  • Clinical Assessments & Judgment
    • Conduct structured symptom assessments (pain, fatigue, neuropathy, SOB, nausea, etc.).

    • Reinforce provider-developed CKD and chronic disease care plans.
    • Provide clinical explanation of symptom management instructions (within LPN scope).
    • Support adherence to medications, lifestyle changes, and follow-up instructions.
    • Identify social, behavioral, or access barriers and determine appropriate interventions or referrals.
  • Documentation, EHR Updates & Compliance
    • Document all patient interactions clearly in both the EHR and CCM patient management platform.

    • Ensure documentation meets regulatory, internal QA, and partner expectations.
    • Maintain high call quality and adherence to scripting and workflow pathways.
  • Quality, Performance & Continuous Improvement
    • Maintain or exceed:
      • ≥80% monthly engagement
      • ≥90% billable conversion
      • High QA/documentation accuracy scores
    • Participate in peer reviews, QA audits, coaching sessions, and continuous education.
    • Identify recurring patient needs and communicate trends to the Program Manager.
  • Other duties consistent with this role, as assigned.

Required Qualifications

The pay range for this role is $55,000-$65,000 annually. Exact pay is determined based on experience, education, demand for the role, and other role-specific factors.

TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro, empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.

AI Fearlessly.

Reporting to: Demand Generation Director Europe

Location:Remote first, office attendance as required - based in Europe

Travel: Occasional

About the Role

The Digital Marketing Specialist, Europe owns paid media execution across the region, driving digital campaigns that build pipeline and support TrendAI's new logo growth objectives. The role works across languages, cultures, and multiple markets, partnering closely with field marketing and European stakeholders to keep paid programmes aligned with wider campaign goals. This is an opportunity for a self-starter to shape how paid media fuels growth across a diverse, fast-moving region.

Key Responsibilities

Paid Media Execution

  • Implement paid strategy across pan-European campaigns to drive new logo pipeline growth
  • Execute paid media campaigns across paid LinkedIn, programmatic, retargeting and remarketing initiatives as well as across additional digital channels which vary by campaign

Field & Cross-Team Collaboration

  • Support field marketing in executing campaigns across the same paid channels
  • Collaborate with internal teams to localise and optimise landing pages and campaign assets
  • Work with agencies and European marketers to keep paid media aligned with wider campaign goals

Performance & Optimisation

  • Track, report on, and optimise campaign performance across paid channels
  • Update and change campaigns based on data for optimum performance
  • Contribute to impact reporting to understand how campaigns are contributing to overall business goals and metrics

What Skills and Experience Should You Bring?

Must have:

  • Experience running paid media campaigns (paid social, programmatic, or similar)
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn data into optimisation decisions
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively across multiple teams, languages, and cultures
  • Highly organised, with excellent verbal and written communication skills

Nice to have:

  • Experience with 6sense or other ABM/programmatic platforms
  • Experience supporting field marketing execution
  • Experience working with CRM (Dynamics 365) and MAP (Marketo) tools
  • Degree in marketing or a related field

Why You'll Love This Role

  • ​Join a growing European team working on a modern paid media and ABM stack (LinkedIn, 6sense, programmatic)
  • Genuine autonomy — highly organised self-starters can manage their own time with minimal supervision
  • Exposure – you will be involved in the thick of the action working across multiple teams to drive results
  • Remote-first, with real cross-border collaboration across Europe and beyond

At Trend Micro, we embrace change, empower people, and encourage innovation in a connected world. Our diversity and multicultural workforce are key contributing factors to our success across the globe. We like to have fun while taking our culture seriously. jobs.description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Senior Backend Engineer on GitLab’s External Agents team, you’ll design and build integrations that bring GitLab agents into tools such as Slack and connect external solutions such as Claude Code or Codex with GitLab. You’ll take end-to-end ownership of complex features, help shape architectural patterns for how GitLab exposes its AI functionality, and collaborate with engineers across the Agent Foundations stage and adjacent AI engineering teams. This is a high-visibility area at the intersection of GitLab’s core platform and AI strategy.

What you’ll do

  • Develop, ship, and maintain secure, well-tested, and performant external agent integrations across the GitLab monolith backend.
  • Collaborate with Product Management, user experience, frontend, backend, and AI specialists to refine requirements and deliver high-quality improvements iteratively.
  • Design, implement, and review GraphQL and REST application programming interfaces (APIs) and related backend logic, with clear contracts for frontend clients.
  • Improve and extend automated testing, including RSpec and other frameworks, to strengthen quality, reliability, and developer feedback loops.
  • Share standards, patterns, and lessons with other engineers to support responsible AI integration and evidence-based engineering across the team.
  • Participate in Tier 2 on-call rotations, troubleshoot production issues, contribute to root cause analysis, and improve observability and resiliency.
  • Assess the competitive landscape and help GitLab build strong AI integrations as agentic technology evolves.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience building and maintaining production applications with Ruby on Rails, including background jobs, APIs, and data models.
  • Comfort working across the stack in a mature codebase.
  • Proficiency in designing or extending REST or GraphQL APIs with attention to scalability, maintainability, and backward compatibility.
  • Practical experience designing and shipping AI-powered backend features or integrations.
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with relational databases such as PostgreSQL, including efficient queries and data modeling.
  • Experience identifying and addressing performance bottlenecks at the application and, where relevant, infrastructure layers.
  • Openness to learning, collaborating in an asynchronous, distributed team, and applying transferable skills from related technologies or domains; familiarity with Python backends or Vue frontends is a plus.

About the team

External Agents is a functional team within the AI Catalog group. We will initially consist of three engineers across Europe, the Middle East, and Africa (EMEA) time zones, while the wider AI Catalog group includes more than eight engineers across Asia-Pacific (APAC), EMEA, and the Americas (AMER). Other teams in AI Catalog focus on agent creation and curation. Together, we partner with teams across AI engineering and GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone for AI features across the product.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

  • Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
  • Flexible Paid Time Off
  • Team Member Resource Groups
  • Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
  • Growth and Development Fund
  • Parental Leave
