Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. jobs.excerpt: About UsAt #paid, we’re on a mission to empower creators to do what they love—create.
jobs.description:
About Us

At #paid, we’re on a mission to empower creators to do what they love—create. Our marketplace connects vetted creators with some of the world’s most iconic brands, like McDonald’s, Samsung, and Disney, fostering authentic collaborations that drive real business results. We’ve built a marketplace that solves big challenges in the creator ecosystem, from fair pricing to algorithmic matching and content usage rights, ensuring every partnership is seamless and impactful.
With our proprietary technology and an unwavering commitment to trust and transparency, we’re revolutionizing the way brands and creators come together to make magic. Rated #1 for customer support and managed services, #paid is leading the creator marketing space. Through innovative technology and a team of ambitious humans, we're transforming the future of the creator economy.

The Role

You'll own the day-to-day execution of creator campaigns and roster management in our Creator Operations team. This role is foundational to how we deliver value to clients and scale our business—every accurate roster, clean data point, and timely communication directly impacts our ability to hit aggressive growth goals for 2027. You'll report to the Creator Operations lead and work directly with CSMs, Product, Finance, and RevOps to keep campaigns running smoothly.

Responsibilities

  • Build and manage creator rosters for assigned campaigns (post-sale), using established criteria and collaborative guidance from CSMs
  • Execute day-to-day campaign operations following SOPs and playbooks—managing ~20–30 campaigns per month at full ramp
  • Own campaign and creator data accuracy in real time, ensuring our CRM and internal tools reflect current information
  • Communicate with creators via our platform and support desk (Zendesk), using templates and guidelines to provide clear, empathetic responses
  • Identify and escalate issues appropriately, learning from patterns to improve processes over time
  • Collaborate cross-functionally—primarily with CSMs on rostering, plus product, finance, and RevOps teams on process improvements

To be successful, you'll need to

    Technical & Practical Skills

  • Baseline Excel and Google Sheets skills—comfortable with formulas, filtering, and data organization
  • Clear, prompt written and verbal communication, especially in customer-facing and peer interactions
  • Ability to work efficiently in our CRM and support-desk tools (we use Zendesk); prior exposure is a plus but not required

    • Experience & Background

  • 1–2+ years in operations, coordination, or high-volume task-management (e.g., agency, talent coordination, account management, or similar)
  • Demonstrated problem-solving and initiative—comfort taking on foundational work and finding efficiencies
  • A genuine understanding of creator economy fundamentals and the ability to assess creator/brand fit

    • How You Work

  • Bias to action: You move quickly and make decisions with incomplete information when needed
  • Positive intent: You assume good intent from teammates and creators, even in challenging situations
  • Takes feedback well: You implement constructive feedback without needing to be right; ego is secondary to the mission
  • Team-first mentality: You celebrate team wins and pitch in where needed, even outside your core responsibilities
  • Resilient with change: We're in a transformation year—you thrive in evolving processes, not just tolerate them

About you

    You're organized and detail-oriented, but you're not rigid. You see the value in getting data and process right, and you actually enjoy solving the operational puzzles that keep campaigns running. You're curious about how creators and brands connect, and you have good judgment about what makes a fit. You take initiative to suggest improvements and learn from mistakes without spiraling. You're comfortable working async and in remote environments, and you communicate clearly when you need help or have a blocker. You're genuinely excited to do the foundational work and grow into bigger responsibilities as the team scales.

Why #paid

  • We are a group of passionate and thoughtful people working together to fundamentally change the way brands are built while empowering creators to make a living doing what they love
  • We are growing quickly! Plus, #paid is the highest-rated platform on the popular G2 Crowd software review website
  • We have all the fun perks you’d expect—flexible vacation policy, competitive vision, dental and health benefits, team offsites and working hubs, and socials (yes, even remotely!)
  • We invest in our team members, with L&D budgets and RRSP/401K Matching Programs
  • We are proud of our culture and care about it deeply—we live by our team values and are always trying to make #paid a better company today than it was yesterday
  • We empower learning through meaningful career progression and the autonomy to test new ideas

jobs.excerpt: Here at Savista, we enable our clients to navigate the biggest challenges in healthcare: quality clinical care with positive patient experiences and optimal financial results.
jobs.description:
Here at Savista, we enable our clients to navigate the biggest challenges in healthcare: quality clinical care with positive patient experiences and optimal financial results. We partner with healthcare organizations to problem solve and deliver revenue cycle improvement services that enable their success, support their patients, and nurture their communities, all while living our values of Commitment, Authenticity, Respect and Excellence (CARE).

The Pro Fee Coder will review clinical documentation to assign and sequence diagnostic and procedural codes for specific patient types to meet the requirements of hospital data or physician data retrieval for billing and reimbursement. Coder I may validate APC calculations to accurately capture the diagnoses/procedures documented in the clinical record for hospitals. The Coder I performs documentation review and assessment for accurate abstracting of clinical data to meet regulatory and compliance requirements. Coder I may interact with client staff and providers.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Select and sequence ICD-10, and/or CPT/HCPCS codes for designated patient types which may include but not limited to: Ancillary (Diagnostic)/ Recurring; Hospital, Clinic; Physician Pro Fee; Technical Fee or Evaluation and Management, any associated chart capturing with any patient type.
  • Review and analyze facility records to ensure that APC assignments and/or Evaluation and Management codes accurately reflect the diagnoses/procedures documented in the clinical record.
  • Abstract clinical data from the record after documentation review to ensure that it is adequate and appropriate to support diagnoses, procedures and discharge disposition is selected.
  • Complete assigned work functions utilizing appropriate resources. May act as a resource with client staff for data integrity, clarification and assistance in understanding and determining appropriate and compliant coding practices including provider queries.
  • Maintain strict patient and provider confidentiality in compliance with all HIPPA Guidelines.
  • Participate in client and Savista staff meetings, trainings, and conference calls as requested and/or required.
  • Maintain current working knowledge of ICD-10 and/or CPT/HCPCS and coding guidelines, government regulations, protocols and third-party requirements regarding coding and/or billing.
  • Participate in continuing education activities to enhance knowledge, skills, and maintain current credentials.

SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Candidates must successfully pass pre-employment skills assessment. Required:
  • An active AHIMA (American Health Information Association) credential including but not limited to RHIA, RHIT, CCS, CCA, or an active AAPC (American Academy of Professional Coders) credentials COC (formerly CPC-H), CCS-P, or CPC or related specialty credential.
  • Two years of recent and relevant hands-on coding experience

Role Description

Dropbox is hiring a Senior Partner Marketing Manager, AI & ISV Ecosystem to help define how Dropbox shows up in the next generation of AI-powered work. As AI and productivity platforms rapidly reshape how people create, access, and collaborate around content, this role will lead some of Dropbox’s most important ecosystem marketing opportunities. You will develop joint go-to-market strategies and high-impact programs with strategic technology partners—including OpenAI, Anthropic, and other leading AI and productivity platforms—while unlocking new growth opportunities across Dropbox’s broader integration ecosystem.

You will lead and develop a small team of partner marketers, operating as a true player-coach: setting direction, prioritizing the biggest opportunities, creating the conditions for your team to do their best work, and helping them grow as strategic marketers, while also contributing to hands-on execution. You will also serve as a senior marketing partner across Business Development, Partnerships, Product, Product Marketing, Sales, and Communications, turning technical integrations and partnership opportunities into compelling customer stories, differentiated value propositions, and integrated programs that drive adoption, awareness, pipeline, and growth.

This role owns partner-specific go-to-market strategy, joint positioning, integrated activation, evergreen co-marketing, and performance optimization for Dropbox’s priority AI and ISV relationships; partner selection, commercial agreements, product-roadmap decisions, sales execution, and partner-systems administration remain owned by the corresponding Business Development, Product, Sales, and Operations teams.

This role is designed for a strategic builder, creative marketer, and people leader who thrives where technology, partnerships, and go-to-market intersect. You will identify where Dropbox can create disproportionate value across the ecosystem, shape joint strategies with influential external partners, and lead complex initiatives from early opportunity through launch, activation, measurement, and scale.

You will join Dropbox at a pivotal moment as AI changes how people interact with their content and where work gets done. This is an opportunity to help shape Dropbox’s position in the emerging AI ecosystem, work alongside some of the world’s most influential technology companies, build a high-impact team, and create the partner marketing models that will help define Dropbox’s next phase of growth.

AI is already embedded in this workflow. You will use approved AI tools to accelerate partner research, insight synthesis, campaign ideation, content development, launch planning, and performance analysis—and you will help build better AI-enabled workflows for the team while maintaining rigorous human judgment, review, and accountability.

Responsibilities

  • Set the strategy and build the roadmap:Closely partner with Business Development to define the partner strategy, and own Dropbox’s partner marketing strategy across priority AI and ISV partners, translate business and customer priorities into a clear portfolio of bets, and create the roadmap, prioritization criteria, and operating approach needed to execute against them.
  • Personally build and execute high-priority programs: Lead the most strategic and complex partner marketing initiatives from concept through launch and optimization, including developing joint value propositions, campaign briefs, go-to-market plans, content strategies, activation plans, and partner-facing deliverables—not simply directing the work from a distance. This manager personally leads programs that are highly ambiguous, executive-visible, or strategically consequential, while direct reports own defined partner programs end to end.
  • Create an evergreen co-marketing engine: Build repeatable programs that extend strategic partnerships beyond launch moments, including joint campaigns, customer stories, lifecycle activation, events, content, partner amplification, and other motions that drive sustained awareness, adoption, engagement, pipeline, and revenue objectives.
  • Turn strategy into scalable operating mechanisms: Design and implement partner segmentation, reusable launch frameworks and templates, decision rights, operating cadences, measurement approaches, campaign governance, andjoint investment planning that help the team move faster and scale successful programs across the ecosystem.
  • Lead partners and cross-functional execution: Build trusted relationships with strategic partners and work hands-on with Partnerships, Product, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to resolve dependencies, navigate competing priorities, make tradeoffs, and drive complex programs to completion.
  • Lead, coach, and work alongside the team: Manage and develop partner marketers while remaining close enough to the work to unblock execution, raise the quality bar, coach through difficult partner situations, model strong craft, and step directly into priority programs when senior-level ownership is needed.
  • Build AI-enabled ways of working: Use approved AI tools directly in partner research, synthesis, planning, content development, personalization, and analysis; identify and implement repeatable AI-enabled workflows for the team; and maintain clear human review and accountability for strategy, quality, partner commitments, and business outcomes.

Requirement

  • B2B marketing experience: 8+ years of B2B marketing experience, with significant experience in partner, ecosystem, platform, or strategic alliances marketing, with demonstrated ability to set strategy and then personally build the plans, programs, processes, and deliverables required to execute it.
  • Deep partner marketing craft: Demonstrated experience developing joint value propositions, go-to-market strategies, integrated campaigns, launch plans, and evergreen co-marketing programs with technology, SaaS, platform, AI, or ISV partners.
  • Strong execution under ambiguity: Proven ability to take an underdefined opportunity, create structure, determine what needs to be built, and drive work from initial concept through execution, measurement, iteration, and scale.
  • Analytical and data-informed decision-making: Strong analytical mindset with the ability to synthesize performance data, customer and partner insights, market signals, and qualitative inputs to evaluate opportunities, diagnose performance, make prioritization decisions, and determine what to scale, change, or stop.
  • Exceptional writing, messaging, and communication: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to develop, translate, and critically review joint messaging with partners; distill complex product and ecosystem concepts into clear customer value propositions; and communicate recommendations, tradeoffs, and decisions effectively to senior internal and external stakeholders.
  • Cross-functional influence and player-coach leadership: Experience building trust and driving decisions across partners, Product, Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing while managing and developing high-performing marketers, raising the quality bar, and stepping directly into complex work when senior ownership is needed.
  • AI-enabled operating mindset: Demonstrated experience applying AI or automation to real marketing or business workflows, with the judgment to use AI for leverage while validating outputs and retaining human accountability for strategic decisions, partner relationships, messaging quality, and business outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

  • AI and technology ecosystem experience: Experience working within AI, SaaS, productivity, collaboration, cloud, developer-platform, or other rapidly evolving technology ecosystems and with major strategic technology partners.
  • Zero-to-one program building: Experience creating a new partner marketing program, capability, operating model, or repeatable motion from the ground up rather than inheriting a fully established playbook.
  • Launch-to-evergreen expertise: Experience turning major integrations, announcements, or partner launches into sustained co-marketing programs that continue driving customer and business outcomes after launch.
  • Commercial and measurement fluency: Experience connecting partner marketing programs to adoption, engagement, pipeline, revenue, or other meaningful business outcomes and using performance signals to decide what to scale, change, or stop.
  • PLG + SLG experience: Experience using product adoption and customer signals alongside partner and Sales motions to drive user growth, pipeline, expansion, or revenue.

Durable Skills

AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technologycontinue to evolve:

  • Awareness:Understand yourself and others.
  • Judgment:Evaluate information and make decisions in complex situations.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Risk Operations team is looking for an experienced fraud analyst to join an industry-leading global fraud operations team. This position is responsible for writing and maintaining fraud rulesets to prevent transaction fraud, conducting data analysis to identify and mitigate fraud attacks, while minimizing impact to users, and working collaboratively with fraud, operations, and product stakeholders to proactively implement fraud strategies and controls. They should have a deep understanding of fraud patterns and typologies, advanced SQL proficiency, strong analytical abilities, and experience writing and managing fraud rulesets.

What you'll do

Did you know that only around 4% of the world's GDP comes from internet commerce? At Stripe, we believe that this represents a future with almost limitless potential for innovation, creativity, and global prosperity. While the promise of a global online economy is palpable, it doesn't come without significant risk. Each day, bad actors disrupt the trust and safety of the internet and increase the barrier of entry for online businesses. Before we can fully realize the potential of a global internet economy, we must first address the burgeoning problem of fraud.

We are looking for someone passionate about fighting fraud, identifying new trends and typologies, conducting complex data analysis, and working collaboratively with peers and partners in the fraud space. This position works closely with cross-functional stakeholders across product, engineering, data science, and operations to identify and mitigate risk from complex, distributed transaction fraud attacks.

The right candidate for this role will have a minimum of five years' experience conducting advanced data analysis using SQL, preferably within the fraud space across e-commerce, payments, or cryptocurrency. Candidates should have experience writing, maintaining, and analyzing complex fraud rulesets and demonstrated success minimizing fraud losses along with impacts to users. Candidates should also have experience working closely with product teams to implement risk controls and demonstrate a deep understanding of fraud typologies, controls, and ability to mitigate fraud risk.

Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain fraud rulesets to prevent transaction-level fraud losses, including ongoing monitoring and measurements of precision and recall
  • Conduct advanced data analysis of structured and unstructured data sets to proactively identify emerging fraud attacks impacting Stripe and its users
  • Collaborate closely with product, risk, and operations teams to proactively identify and mitigate fraud exposure
  • Investigate, conduct root cause analysis, and deploy remediations to prevent future complex and distributed fraud attacks
  • Investigate and take action against anomalous clusters of transactions based on account activity, processing volume, or other risk indicators while minimizing negative impacts to Stripe users
  • Respond to incidents involving complex fraud schemes to quickly mitigate exposure to Stripe, its users, and financial partners
  • Utilize analytics to identify and implement initiatives to automate manual processes and workload across the organization
  • Create visualizations, dashboards, and queries to drive visibility and oversight into impact, performance, loss risks, and user experience
  • Utilize Stripe tools and systems to enable systematic actioning of fraudulent merchants, maintaining an extremely high level of accuracy to prevent negative user experience

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • A minimum of five years of experience conducting advanced data analysis and managing transaction fraud rulesets
  • Advanced-level proficiency in SQL
  • Experience working closely with modeling, data science, and intelligence stakeholders to implement automatic and scaled controls and processes
  • Experience creating data visualizations and dashboards and presenting findings to technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
  • The ability to drive execution on projects working in a heavily cross-functional environment
  • Creativity, a team-focused mentality, and effective problem-solving skills
  • The ability and desire to question the status quo
  • The ability to approach challenges from a user perspective while being pragmatic and solutions-oriented

Preferred qualifications

  • Fraud experience in payments, e-commerce, fintechs, or cryptocurrency mitigating digital and card-not-present fraud
  • Experience investigating and mitigating card testing and account takeover attacks
  • Proficiency in Splunk, Python, Tableau, or other data visualization tools
  • Undergraduate or advanced degree in analytics, data science, or statistics
  • Experience with clustering, classification, and link analysis
  • Experience working in fast-paced and rapidly changing environments
  • Experience designing and implementing product-level fraud and risk controls

As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Will You Do?

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (all genders)
jobs.excerpt: Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations.
jobs.description:
Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest (Starbucks, KFC, La Tagliatella), Nordsee, Hermes or even big Testing Inspection and Certification bodies rely on Lumiform to keep standards consistently high across hundreds of locations.

Our position in the market is clear: we're building authority in answer engine optimization (AEO) for inspection and audit software. We want to be the company that AI systems recommend when people ask "what is the best inspection software?" or "What is the best software for restaurants to nail HACCP documentation" That focus is where we win. It's also where your role is essential.

You will shape how Lumiform gets discovered in large language models and answer engines. You'll work directly with our founders to sharpen our positioning and prove it through content depth, benchmark reports, and answers that LLMs actually cite. You'll execute this strategy hands-on alongside two content writers (this is not a hands off, strategy only role).

This is a strategic role for an executor. You think systematically about positioning and content architecture, then get your hands dirty building it.

Tasks

Your core mandate sits on three priorities.

1. AEO Foundation and Technical Health

  • Conduct an extensive AEO and content audit. This includes technical site audits covering infrastructure, loading times, crawlability, indexation, canonicalization, and how our site structure serves answer engines.
  • Review all content for cannibalization and duplicate content, then systematically eliminate it. Answer engines penalize sites that repeat the same answer across multiple pages.
  • Define the must-win AEO phrases and questions. These are the high-intent searches and prompts where we need to be the answer LLMs recommend. Not every keyword matters, only the ones where we can own the answer.
  • Measure and report on LLM visibility for core use cases and phrases, using tools like Peec ai and tracking how often Lumiform appears in ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other answer engines.

2. Content Strategy and Topic Preparation

  • Enrich and expand our existing use case pages with real depth. These pages need to be the most authoritative answer to "what is the best software for X?" Validate more sections, add different content formats, implement sub-use-case structures (e.g. "tire and wheel inspections for forklifts via app"), and optimize for quality and depth.
  • Prepare alternative and comparison pages for all major competitors, positioning Lumiform clearly against each
  • Audit and remove topic guides and listicles that do not drive visibility or that are outside our ICP and positioning. Create new listicle and comparison pages from our ideal use case list where answer engines will cite them.
  • Prepare content briefs for the writers. Tell them what to write, why LLMs should recommend it, how to structure it for answer engines, what questions and semantic patterns to answer, and what depth is required to be cited.

3. Benchmark Reports and Growth

  • This is your biggest bet. Design and build benchmark reports that prove our category leadership on inspection and audit software. Identify high-value research angles, design the study, research real user and organization data in depth, anonymize and aggregate until unidentifiable, and publish extraordinary reports that answer engines will cite and share with analysts. These become the proof points we need to establish authority.
  • Create videos for must-win questions. Show deep knowledge of topics like "what is the best inspection software" or specific use cases, and implement them on pages where answer engines will pick them up.

4. PPC Management and Optimization

  • Monitor PPC performance across Google and Microsoft Ads and other paid channels like ChatGPT Ads. Track ROI, conversion rates, and quality scores.
  • Work with our PPC freelancer on campaign optimization, bid management, and audience targeting. Ideally, take over PPC management completely and eliminate the dependency on external freelance support.

Requirements

Required

  • 5+ years of marketing experience, with at least 1-2 years managing people
  • Deep hands-on expertise in AEO and AI-powered search optimization. This is the most important requirement and you will not have the time to learn it on the job. You have run content strategies specifically for LLMs, analyzed how to structure content to get cited by answer engines, worked with prompt-driven discovery, or built content that wins in ChatGPT and similar systems. You understand how to write for AI consumption.
  • Strong fundamentals in how answer engines work. You understand how LLMs evaluate and cite sources, what makes content "rankable" in answer engines, and how positioning and authority factor into recommendations.
  • Proficiency with AEO and SEO tools. You navigate Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, Ahrefs, Keyword com, and AEO-specific tools like Peec ai with ease.
  • Analytical and systematic thinker. You audit, measure, prioritize and execute. You track what works in answer engines vs. what doesn't.
  • Comfortable with content operations and workflow. You can brief writers on answer engine strategy, provide feedback on depth and structure, and enforce quality standards.
  • A smart mind with a top university degree (or equivalent self-directed learning that proves it). We hire thoughtful people who can reason through complex positioning and strategy challenges.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience managing writers or editorial teams. You know how to guide research, structure and revision
  • Experience building benchmark reports or original research content
  • Familiarity with WordPress as a headless CMS or similar flexible content management systems
  • B2B SaaS marketing experience, especially in vertical software or inspection and operations software
  • Experience with PPC management and optimization

Benefits

About Lumiform

Lumiform is a specialized software for businesses with frontline teams to run inspections, audits and checklists at scale across distributed operations. Customers are mid-size and large companies such as multi-site retailers, restaurant chains, logistics fleets, warehouse operators, construction businesses and manufacturers. Companies like EDEKA, AmRest, Virgin Media and even testing, inspection and certification bodies rely on Lumiform. Rated 4.6 on G2, Lumiform is built in Europe, offering full data sovereignty and GDPR compliance.

Why working with us

  • You are part of a company that has a positive impact on society. We protect frontline workers and customers from preventable harm.
  • Join an ambitious, international team with flat hierarchies and real decision-making autonomy.
  • Shape a major growth channel from scratch. Benchmark reports and AEO strategy will drive significant value for the company
  • Work fully remote and choose where you get things done

If this sounds like you, let's talk. A CV or LinkedIn profile is enough.

Our Hiring Process

  • Screening call (30 minutes) with HR
  • First interview (general get to know call) with founder (30 minutes)
  • Second interview (deep dive interview) with founder
  • We ask you for 2 references and will conduct reference calls (as a final step)

The Network Operations Network Engineer I is a key element within the Rackspace Infrastructure team and is expected to provide a high level of technical expertise to ensure the uptime and maintenance of critical networking systems. A Racker in this role takes ownership of complex network issues and ensures they are resolved and/or successfully documented and handed off to an oncoming shift. The Network Engineer I actively monitors the Rackspace network at all levels, from top of rack to edge, using various tools and communicates and resolves issues identified or escalates them to the appropriate level. The Racker also responds to issues escalated to Network Operations via tickets and phone calls from internal customers and is expected to engage directly with external customers via public ticket comments and phone conversations to ensure problem resolution. Technical issues can include troubleshooting latency, packet loss, and poor performance; responding to DDoS attacks; identifying and resolving switch and router hardware and software failures; identifying and resolving configuration inconsistencies; conducting maintenances to ensure standardization and uptime; and managing Internet providers and connectivity.

The Network Operations Engineer will create and maintain customer loyalty by providing Fanatical Support above and beyond customer expectations.

JOB REQUIREMENTS:

Key Accountabilities

  • Provide exceptional customer support via the ticketing system and phone
  • Detect events in a timely manner using monitoring tools
  • Mitigates DDoS attacks to protect customer and shared infrastructure
  • Document planned and unplanned network events in appropriate tracking and turnover systems
  • Troubleshoot and resolve network events and create event documentation accordingly
  • Take ownership of level-appropriate customer requests and issues, seeing them through to resolution
  • Escalate support requests to next level engineers and communicate with Incident Management as appropriate
  • Escalate to vendors and follow up as needed to ensure problem resolution
  • Adhere to Change Management and Maintenance policy and process
  • Participate and provide input to Root Cause Analysis
  • Review, provide input, and sign off on defined policy and process standards

Key Performance Indicators

  • Ticket Contribution and Phone Availability: Provide correct and helpful expertise to resolve issues, maintaining high ticket evaluations results
  • High level of first pass yield and success on written, quality checked, tested, and executed maintenances
  • Prompt and correct responses to network events
  • Maintain proficiency in troubleshooting, tools, and technologies

PERSON SPECIFICATION:

The Network Operations Network Engineer I has an introductory to intermediate aptitude with:

  • All supported network platforms (Cisco 2900, 3500, 3700, 4900, 6500, ASR1k, ASR9k, Nexus 3k, Nexus 6k, Nexus 7k, Arista 7000, etc…)
  • All supported Layer 2 and 3 protocols and features (STP, HSRP, VLANs, CDP, port-channels, OSPF, BGP, MPLS, DWDM, etc…)
  • Monitoring systems (Arbor, Zenoss, Syslog, SolarWinds, WhatsUp Gold, etc…)

The Network Operations Network Engineer I is:

  • Able to handle multiple tasks and prioritize work under pressure
  • Detail-oriented in documenting information and able to own customer issues through resolution
  • Capable of demonstrating sound problem-solving skills coupled with a desire to take on responsibility
  • Passionate about technology and has a desire to expand technical knowledge

The ideal candidate possesses:

  • A minimum of 18 months of recent networking experience in a command-line oriented environment
  • CCNA-level aptitude
  • A minimum of 12 months of experience in a customer service role
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Critical thinking skills and the ability to provide solutions with precision during high-pressure situations
  • Schedule flexibility to include working a weekend day regularly and holidays as required by the business

We are the multicloud solutions experts. We combine our expertise with the world’s leading technologies — across applications, data and security — to deliver end-to-end solutions. We have a proven record of advising customers based on their business challenges, designing solutions that scale, building and managing those solutions, and optimizing returns into the future. Named a best place to work, year after year according to Fortune, Forbes and Glassdoor, we attract and develop world-class talent. Join us on our mission to embrace technology, empower customers and deliver the future.

Trusted Engineering That Matters

Engineering at VGS

Our vision is clear: VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. To achieve this, we build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.

Our Environment & Culture

  • Tooling as Leverage for Impact: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on building simple things that work, pushing boundaries, and delivering value faster.

We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most. Leading from the front means multiplying the impact of those around you so we win collectively.

  • Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline. We apply the same rigor, roadmap thinking, and speed to system health as we do to new features. In high-scale payments, reliability isn't background work; it is our product.

About the Role

We’re looking for builders. People who take ownership, go deep on hard technical problems, and care about the systems they put into production. At VGS, you’ll have the opportunity to work on infrastructure that sits at the heart of modern payments and operate at a scale where reliability truly matters.
You’ll own meaningful parts of our infrastructure stack, solving complex reliability and scaling challenges while making the systems our engineers rely on faster, more resilient, and easier to operate.
You’ll thrive here if you’re someone who loves solving hard problems, digs deep into the details, and isn’t afraid to challenge the status quo. You bring curiosity, sound technical judgment, and a strong sense of ownership and you care deeply about building reliable technology for our customers and the engineers who use it every day.
If you’re excited to work on meaningful infrastructure challenges alongside a team that cares deeply about engineering excellence, we’d love to meet you.

  • Build and scale critical infrastructure: Architect and evolve highly available, fault tolerant infrastructure that powers our distributed systems and global platform.
  • Own reliability when it matters most: Lead incident response and root cause analysis, drive fast resolution, and turn every incident into an opportunity to make our systems stronger.
  • Automate everything you can: Build intelligent monitoring, alerting, and automated healing systems that keep our infrastructure healthy, reduce toil, and minimize downtime.
  • Push performance and scale: Identify bottlenecks, tune systems, and develop capacity and scaling strategies that keep our platform fast and reliable as workloads grow.
  • Partner across engineering: Work closely with software engineers and platform teams to build more reliable systems and continuously improve how we ship.
  • Raise the engineering bar: Champion better deployment practices, performance testing, automation, and SRE principles across the organization.
  • Lead through technical influence: Mentor engineers, shape infrastructure strategy, and help establish technical standards and best practices that scale across the organization.
  • Bring your ideas: We want engineers who are curious, proactive, and willing to challenge assumptions. Your ideas and feedback will directly influence how we build a world class product.
  • Build with a great team: We believe in transparency, collaboration, grit, and humility, and in doing whatever it takes to do the right thing for our customers and our company. And yes, we believe you should have some fun along the way.

What You Bring

Required:

  • Own production reliability: Participate in on-call rotations for the services you own and operate, troubleshoot production issues, and help make those systems more reliable over time.
  • Bring deep infrastructure expertise: Proven experience in Infrastructure or SRE roles supporting complex, large scale production environments.

  • Build cloud native systems: Deep experience with Linux, Docker, Kubernetes/EKS, and cloud-native architecture, with strong familiarity across CI/CD, GitOps, APIs, authentication and authorization, Kafka/MSK, and AWS services.
  • Automate with code: Comfortable using Python, Go, Bash, or similar languages to automate infrastructure and eliminate operational toil.
  • Obsess over observability: Experience with tools like Prometheus, Grafana, and OpenTelemetry to understand system health, performance, and reliability.
  • Know databases: Database expertise is a strong plus, particularly experience operating and scaling production databases.
  • Lead through collaboration: Partner across engineering teams, drive reliability initiatives, mentor others, and communicate clearly.
  • Be ready when things break: Bring strong incident management and disaster recovery practices, and use every incident to improve the resilience of our systems.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, cryptology, or security products
  • BA/BS degree
  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

jobs.description:
About the Company

At Torc, we have always believed that autonomous vehicle technology will transform how we travel, move freight, and do business.

A leader in autonomous driving since 2007, Torc has spent over a decade commercializing our solutions with experienced partners. Now a part of the Daimler family, we are focused solely on developing software for automated trucks to transform how the world moves freight.

Join us and catapult your career with the company that helped pioneer autonomous technology, and the first AV software company with the vision to partner directly with a truck manufacturer.

Meet the Team

Accurate and highly available information about vehicle motion and position is fundamental to the safe operation of autonomous trucks. Core capabilities such as perception, prediction, planning, and control depend on reliable ego-motion and localization estimates to ensure safe and efficient vehicle behavior.

The Ego-Motion & Localization Team develops the ML models, state estimation algorithms, and production software responsible for estimating vehicle pose, velocity, and acceleration in real time. Our solutions fuse information from multiple sensors and maintain robust performance despite sensor imperfections, environmental challenges, and system degradation. As part of this team, you will develop and deploy production-ready localization and sensor fusion solutions and help solve the challenges of bringing autonomous vehicle technology to real-world commercial applications.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and deploy production ML models for ego-motion estimation and localization, including learned pose estimation, sensor extrinsic calibration, map matching, and sensor fusion using camera, LiDAR, radar, and other vehicle sensors.
  • Develop scalable training and evaluation workflows using PyTorch, distributed training infrastructure, and large-scale real-world datasets.
  • Design and improve state estimation and sensor fusion algorithms for robust vehicle pose, velocity, and acceleration estimation.
  • Analyze large-scale vehicle data to characterize performance, identify failure modes, and drive model and system improvements.
  • Develop robust, efficient production software in modern C++ and Python across the full development lifecycle.
  • Define evaluation, verification, and validation strategies to ensure localization quality, robustness, and safety across diverse operating conditions.
  • Make technical design and architecture decisions, balancing model performance, computational efficiency, robustness, and production constraints.
  • Collaborate with perception, mapping, planning, controls, and platform teams to deliver integrated autonomous driving capabilities.
  • Provide technical leadership through design reviews, code reviews, mentoring, and development of engineering best practices.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Robotics, or a related field with 6+ years of relevant industry experience, or a Master’s degree with 3+ years of relevant industry experience, or a PhD with 1+ year of relevant industry experience.
  • Experience with AV or robotics localization systems (e.g., LiDAR-based localization, visual odometry, SLAM, or map-based pose estimation).
  • Strong experience developing and deploying ML models for perception, localization, or sensor fusion domains.
  • Proficiency with PyTorch and modern ML tooling for training, inference, and optimization.
  • Solid understanding of 3D geometry, probabilistic estimation, coordinate transforms, and robotics fundamentals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with large multimodal datasets and build scalable pipelines for processing, labeling, and evaluation.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals in Python and C++, including algorithms, data structures, testing, debugging, and performance optimization.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to work effectively on cross-functional teams.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with state estimation techniques such as factor graphs, Kalman filtering, nonlinear optimization, or related probabilistic estimation methods.
  • Familiarity with distributed computing tools such as Ray, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration frameworks.
  • Knowledge of embedded and real-time constraints for on-vehicle deployment.
  • Experience in simulation, synthetic data generation, and uncertainty-aware ML modeling.
  • Contributions to open-source robotics, perception, or ML frameworks.
  • Familiarity with functional safety standards and automotive development processes, including ISO 26262.

Work Location: For this position, we are open to hiring in Ann Arbor, MI (U.S.) office work locations in a hybrid capacity. We are also open to hiring Remote in the United States.

Perks of Being a Full-time Torc’r

Torc cares about our team members and we strive to provide benefits and resources to support their health, work/life balance, and future. Our culture is collaborative, energetic, and team focused. Torc offers:

  • A competitive compensation package that includes a bonus component and stock options
  • 100% paid medical, dental, and vision premiums for full-time employees
  • 401K plan with a 6% employer matchFlexibility in schedule and generous paid vacation (available immediately after start date)Company-wide holiday office closures

We celebrate the uniqueness of our Torc’rs and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, veteran status, or disabilities.

Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications listed for this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

The Role We Need

PadSplit runs on data, from Growth and Operations to Product and Finance, and we need someone who can turn that data into clear, trustworthy decisions. We're looking for a Senior Data Analyst to own analyses end to end, build durable reporting infrastructure, and help shape how the company measures its business. This person will work daily across our modern data stack (Snowflake, dbt, and Hex) to answer high-impact questions and raise the analytical bar across the team.

The Person We Are Looking For

We're looking for someone with 5+ years of analytics experience who is equally comfortable writing expert-level SQL and translating ambiguous business questions into rigorous, well-documented analysis. This person is a strong communicator who can defend their methodology to technical and non-technical audiences alike, and who brings sound judgment about when to lean on AI tools versus when to verify. They're curious, detail-oriented, and take ownership seriously, from scoping a question through to following up on the outcome.

Here's What You'll Be Doing Day-to-Day:

  • SQL & Analysis: Write, optimize, and maintain complex SQL against our Snowflake warehouse to answer business questions accurately and efficiently.
  • dbt Modeling: Build and maintain dbt models that transform raw data into well-documented, tested, and reusable datasets.
  • Dashboards & Reporting: Build dashboards, apps, and reporting in Hex that leaders trust and use to run the business.
  • Stakeholder Partnership: Partner with teams to define metrics, scope analyses, and translate ambiguous questions into clear analytical work.
  • Anomaly Investigation: Investigate anomalies in key metrics, identify root causes, and communicate findings with clear recommendations.
  • Documentation: Maintain documentation across dbt and Hex so metric definitions stay consistent across teams.
  • Data Quality: Validate sources, pressure-test assumptions, and flag gaps before they reach decision-makers.
  • AI-Assisted Work & Mentorship: Use AI tools to accelerate analysis and reporting while verifying outputs, and mentor other analysts on best practices.

Here's What You'll Need to Be Successful:

  • Analytics Experience: 5+ years of experience in data analytics or a closely related field.
  • Expert SQL: Advanced skills in window functions, CTEs, query optimization, and large, complex datasets.
  • Snowflake Expertise: Hands-on experience with Snowflake as a primary data warehouse.
  • dbt Experience: Building and maintaining dbt models in a production analytics environment, including tests and documentation.
  • Hex/Notebook Reporting: Experience building reporting in Hex or a similar notebook-based analytics platform.
  • End-to-End Ownership: A track record of owning analyses from scoping through delivery and follow-through.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain technical findings to non-technical audiences and defend your methodology.
  • AI Fluency & Judgment: Working familiarity with AI tools in analytics, paired with sound judgment on when to verify outputs and how to handle sensitive data.

The Interview Process:

  • Your application will be reviewed for possible next steps by a real human being from the PeopleOps team.
  • If you meet eligibility requirements, the next step would be a video interview with a member of the PeopleOps team for about thirty (30) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video interview with our Head of Business Intelligence for forty-five (45) minutes.
  • If warranted, the next step would be an SQL assessment through Coderbyte.
  • If warranted, the next step would be a video panel interview with key stakeholders at PadSplit for one and a half (1.5) hours.
  • If warranted, we move to offer!

  • Fully remote position - we swear!

  • National medical, dental, and vision healthcare plans
  • Company provided life insurance policy
  • Optional accidental insurances, FSA, and DCFSA benefits
  • Unlimited paid-time (PTO) policy with eleven (11) company-observed holidays
  • 401(k) plan
  • Twelve (12) weeks of paid time off for both birth and non-birth parents
  • The opportunity to do what you love at a company that is at the forefront of solving the affordable housing crisis

The Associate Vice President (AVP), Service Excellence – Channel Partner, is responsible for managing day-to-day service execution and operational performance for an assigned portfolio of Channel Partner accounts. Reporting to the Senior Vice President for Service Excellence, the AVP executes established service strategies, monitors operational performance, identifies trends and service gaps, and coordinates corrective actions with internal teams, channel partners, and subcontractors.

This position serves as an operational liaison for assigned Channel Partners and provides data, analysis, and recommendations to senior leadership regarding service performance, resource needs, process improvements, and partner concerns. Material contractual, financial, strategic, and customer-impacting decisions are escalated to the SVP for Service Excellence or appropriate leadership.

This role requires a hands-on, data-driven leader who can effectively coordinate distributed operations, develop actionable insights from operational data, support teams in meeting established performance expectations, and drives continuous improvement within a assigned area of responsibility.

Remote based position with a requirement to travel up to 50% of the time. Must be located within the contiguous United States and local to an airport in order to meet the travel requirement.

Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day service delivery and operational performance for an assigned portfolio of channel partners accounts in accordance with established Service Excellence strategies, policies, and performance expectations.
  • Monitor service performance against established service level agreements (SLAs), key performance indicators (KPIs), contractual requirements, and internal operating standards.
  • Identify service performance gaps and coordinate corrective actions with internal teams, Channel Partners, subcontractors, and other stakeholders. Track operational and contractual service requirements for assigned accounts and escalate significant compliance, contractual, financial, or customer-impacting risks to the Senior Vice President for Service Excellence.
  • Serve as an operational point of contact for routine service delivery issues and escalations within the assigned portfolio, coordinating resolution across appropriate functional teams.
  • Escalate significant or recurring partner concerns, contractual disputes, material service failures, and matters requiring strategic or executive-level decisions to senior leadership.

  • Support quarterly and other recurring Channel Partner business reviews by preparing service performance data, identifying key trends, documenting action items, and coordinating follow-up activities.
  • Partner with Channel Partner Sales and other internal stakeholders to support partner retention efforts through consistent service execution and timely resolution of operational concerns.
  • Maintain productive working relationships with assigned Channel Partners and serve as a resource regarding day-to-day service delivery matters.
  • Assess operational workflows, staffing utilization, scheduling requirements, and training needs within the assigned portfolio and provide recommendations to Service Excellence leadership.
  • Coordinate resource and scheduling requirements for assigned Channel Partner accounts within established staffing plans, budgets, and organizational priorities.
  • Work collaboratively with field operations, technical support, sales, implementation, training, and other functional teams to address operational issues affecting Channel Partner service delivery.
  • Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service quality, consistency, and partner experience through data analysis and continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Recommend process improvements to Service Excellence leadership and coordinate implementation of approved changes.
  • Measure and report on the effectiveness of implemented process improvements and corrective action plans.
  • Document and maintain standard operating procedures, workflows, process documentation, and other materials supporting Channel Partner service delivery.
  • Provide operational data, service requirements, and subject matter input to support proposals, renewals, partner agreements, and other business initiatives as requested.

  • Provide day-to-day leadership, coaching, and performance feedback to assigned employees, as applicable, consistent with established organizational policies and leadership direction.
  • Support employee development by identifying training opportunities, reinforcing established performance expectations, and assisting employees in resolving operational challenges.
  • Partner with senior leadership on significant employee relations, staffing, organizational, disciplinary, compensation, and other personnel decisions in accordance with established company processes.
  • Support Service Excellence onboarding and training of new site technicians by developing job-related content, identifying operational training needs, and assisting with training events.
  • Apply data analytics, continuous improvement practices, and systems-thinking principles to identify opportunities to improve service delivery and operational performance.
  • Utilize available technology, including Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Copilot, and other approved AI-enabled productivity tools, to improve reporting, analysis, documentation, and operational efficiency.
  • Maintain knowledge of Service Excellence policies, Channel Partner requirements, operating procedures, and applicable contractual service expectations.
  • Travel to Channel Partner and customer locations as necessary to support service reviews, operational assessments, issue resolution, training, and other business needs.

You will be responsible for responding quickly to new enquiries, understanding the customer's requirements, qualifying opportunities and booking suitable appointments for the sales team.

You will also manage follow-ups, assist with Instagram enquiries and ensure the CRM remains accurate and up to date.

  • Respond to new inbound enquiries within 1–3 minutes wherever possible.
  • Engage professionally and naturally with U.S. homeowners.

    • Project requirements
    • Budget
    • Timing
    • Decision-maker availability
  • Set appropriate expectations around typical project budgets without providing final pricing.
  • Book qualified onsite appointments or route suitable enquiries for remote quoting.
  • Follow up with leads who have not responded.
  • Follow up on open quotes and opportunities.
  • Manage conversations through Instagram DMs and convert suitable enquiries into phone conversations.
  • Maintain accurate customer records and notes within the CRM.
  • Keep pipeline stages, tasks and follow-ups up to date.
  • Escalate pricing questions, discounts, design decisions, unusual projects and other matters requiring management input.
  • Provide a short daily summary of activity, opportunities and follow-ups.
  • Maintain a high standard of customer service throughout every interaction.

Requirements

Essential

  • 2–5 years of experience in appointment setting, inbound sales, lead qualification, customer service or a similar role.
  • Exceptional spoken English with a clear, neutral and easy-to-understand accent.
  • Warm, natural and confident communication style.
  • Comfortable speaking with U.S. customers, particularly affluent homeowners.
  • Strong ability to qualify leads rather than simply book appointments.
  • Excellent listening and questioning skills.
  • Strong CRM and administrative discipline.
  • Ability to work independently with limited supervision.
  • Excellent follow-up and organisational skills.
  • Comfortable discussing project budgets in the region of $1,500–$3,000+ without being pushy or providing final pricing.
  • Comfortable working 18:00–02:00 SAST, Tuesday–Saturday.
  • Reliable internet, electricity and a suitable home working environment.

  • Home services
  • Construction
  • Roofing
  • Solar
  • Landscaping
  • Trades
  • Property services
  • Home improvement
  • Consumer services
  • Field-service businesses

Experience with Jobber or another field-service CRM would also be advantageous.

  • Focus on quality appointments rather than appointment volume.
  • Be highly organised with CRM and follow-up tasks.

  • Be comfortable working independently.
  • Have a genuine interest in developing within a growing business.

Dynata is seeking a Senior AI Architect for Semantic Layer & Algorithm Architecture to lead the design of the foundationalarchitecturesthatpowerthe company's next-generation data, analytics, and AI ecosystem. 

This Senior AI Architect will define the technical patterns, governance frameworks, and integration standards that connect Dynata's lakehouse, semantic layer, feature ecosystem, and machine learning capabilities into a scalable and reusable platform. Working at the intersection of data architecture, governance, and AI enablement, the Senior AI Architect will ensure that data assets are discoverable, interoperable, and optimized for analytics, machine learning, and emerging AI applications. 

Reporting to the VP, Research & Data Science, this role will partner closely with product, engineering, and platform teams to establish the architectural standards that support Dynata's evolving portfolio of data products, AI capabilities, and enterprise decision-support systems.

Semantic Layer & Data Architecture

Data Contracts & Governance Standards

Cross-Functional Collaboration

jobs.description:
About SecurityScorecard:

SecurityScorecard is the global leader in cybersecurity ratings, with over 12 million companies continuously rated, operating in 64 countries. Founded in 2013 by security and risk experts Dr. Alex Yampolskiy and Sam Kassoumeh and funded by world-class investors, SecurityScorecard’s patented rating technology is used by over 25,000 organizations for self-monitoring, third-party risk management, board reporting, and cyber insurance underwriting; making all organizations more resilient by allowing them to easily find and fix cybersecurity risks across their digital footprint.

Headquartered in New York City, our culture has been recognized by Inc Magazine as a "Best Workplace,” by Crain’s NY as a "Best Places to Work in NYC," and as one of the 10 hottest SaaS startups in New York for two years in a row. Most recently, SecurityScorecard was named to Fast Company’s annual list of theWorld’s Most Innovative Companies for 2023 and to the Achievers 50 Most Engaged Workplaces in 2023 award recognizing “forward-thinking employers for their unwavering commitment to employee engagement.” SecurityScorecard is proud to be funded by world-class investors including Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV and Riverwood Capital.

About the Role:

SecurityScorecard is looking for a stellar, empathetic, and results-oriented Senior UX Manager who leads people the way great designers craft products: with intention, empathy, and an uncompromising results orientation. This is a player-coach role for someone who has mastered the senior IC craft — end-to-end product design, design systems, accessibility-first execution, AI-native workflows — and is now ready to multiply that excellence through a team.

You’ll own team health, design velocity, and process — including running Agile scrum ceremonies that keep design planned, visible, and delivered on cadence with Product and Engineering. You’ll spearhead the operating system of the design organization: structured workflows, transparent tracking, a governed Design System, and a feedback culture where critique is direct, kind, and elevating in both directions.

We’re looking for someone human-led and empathy-driven who is also relentlessly accountable to outcomes — an excellent feedback giver and taker who brings their best self, meets people where they are, and moves the whole team in the same direction. You’ve done the work you’ll be managing. Now you’ll set the standard — and bring others up with you.

What You’ll Do

  • People Leadership & Team Health: Directly manage a team of designers at a healthy span of control. Conduct meaningful 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations. Lead with empathy, own team morale and retention with measurable targets, and cultivate a culture of transparency where every designer knows where they stand and where they’re headed.
  • Agile Design Process Leadership: Run and continuously improve Agile ceremonies for the design team — sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, and design reviews. Integrate design seamlessly into scrum cycles alongside Product and Engineering, ensuring design work is planned, visible, estimated, and delivered on cadence — never a bottleneck, never a black box.
  • Hands-On Design Excellence: Stay close to the craft. You can own a feature end-to-end when needed — from discovery and wireframes through high-fidelity UI and production handoff — and you review, critique, and elevate the team’s output daily. Your feedback raises the bar; your example sets it.
  • Stakeholder Management & Cross-Functional Partnership: Serve as the primary design liaison to Product Management, Engineering, and business stakeholders. Translate between design intent and business priorities fluently. Participate in roadmap planning, negotiate scope with clarity and directness, and build the cross-functional trust that makes design a strategic partner — not a service desk.
  • Research & Data Integration: Ensure the team synthesizes usability testing and behavioral analytics (FullStory, Pendo) into design iterations. Partner with UX Research to translate findings into personas, journey maps, and design decisions grounded in evidence — not opinion.
  • AI-Native Team Enablement: Champion AI-augmented design workflows across the team — Figma AI, Claude, and emerging tooling — to compress design cycles without sacrificing quality. Set adoption goals, share best practices, and model an AI-by-Design mindset.
  • Talent Development & Feedback Culture: Build professional growth plans for every direct report with clear markers for success. Give feedback that is direct, kind, and actionable — and receive it the same way. Stretch senior designers toward promotion and expanded scope, and make this team known as a place where great designers grow.

Required Qualifications:

  • 8+ years of experience in UX/Product Design, including 3+ years directly managing designers — with a portfolio and track record demonstrating both craft excellence and team leadership.
  • Hands-on experience running Agile scrum ceremonies in some capacity — sprint planning, standups, retrospectives, backlog grooming — and integrating design into agile product development cycles.
  • Full command of the senior IC toolkit: end-to-end product design ownership from discovery and wireframing through high-fidelity UI and production handoff. You’ve done the job you’ll be managing — at a high level.
  • Deep proficiency in Figma, including component architecture, auto-layout, variables, and prototyping. You think in systems, not just screens — and you can teach others to do the same.
  • Hands-on experience building, governing, and scaling Design Systems that measurably accelerate design and engineering velocity.
  • Strong understanding of accessibility standards (WCAG 2.2) and experience embedding inclusive design practices into team workflows.
  • Experience synthesizing behavioral analytics (FullStory, Pendo, Amplitude, or similar) and usability testing into design decisions — and coaching teams to do so.
  • Proven stakeholder management skills — you communicate design rationale persuasively to Product, Engineering, and executive audiences, and you negotiate priorities with clarity and directness.
  • Human-led and empathy-driven: you put people first, listen deeply, and build psychological safety — while staying relentlessly results-oriented and accountable to outcomes.
  • An excellent feedback giver and taker: you deliver critique that is direct, constructive, and inspiring — and you actively seek, welcome, and act on feedback about your own leadership.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field. Equivalent professional experience accepted.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Formal Agile training certification (CSM, PSM, SAFe, or equivalent), OR robust experience serving as a scrum master or agile lead for a design and/or tech team.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, cybersecurity, or enterprise platform products with complex workflows and data-dense interfaces.
  • Track record of improving team health, morale, and retention metrics in design organizations — with measurable evidence.
  • Experience implementing JIRA-based or equivalent tracking systems for design teams.
  • Familiarity with AI-augmented design workflows and integrating AI tooling into team processes at scale.
  • Experience leading teams through organizational transformation, process change, or leadership transition.

Why Join Us

  • Lead and Still Create: This is a player-coach role. You’ll shape people, process, and culture — while staying close enough to the craft that your design instincts stay sharp.
  • Define the Operating System: You’re not inheriting a process — you’re building it. The agile design motion, the JIRA-for-Design mechanism, the feedback culture: yours to spearhead.
  • Direct Strategic Access: You report directly to the SVP, Experience Strategy & Product Design and serve as the operational partner translating strategy into daily execution.
  • A Team Built to Win: You’ll work alongside a UX Architect, UX Researcher, and senior designers — a deliberately constructed team where every role raises the others.
  • Values-Led Culture: We set the standard high, bring others up with us, lead with transparency and empathy, and stay direct. If you lead that way — this is your team.
  • World-Class Backing: SecurityScorecard is funded by Silver Lake Waterman, Moody’s, Sequoia Capital, GV, and Riverwood Capital, and recognized as one of the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

Benefits:

Specific to each country, we offer a competitive salary, stock options, Health benefits, and unlimited PTO, parental leave, tuition reimbursements, and much more!

In addition to base salary, employees may also be eligible for annual performance-based incentive compensation awards and equity, among other company benefits.

jobs.description:
Q ENERGYs Ziel ist es, eine nachhaltige Welt mit grüner Energie zu ermöglichen. Unsere Unternehmenswerte - Verantwortung, Partnerschaft, Inklusive and "Changemaker" - sind die Grundlage für unser Handeln. Als Europas führender Anbieter von grünen Energielösungen sind wir ein vertrauenswürdiger Partner für das gesamte Spektrum der erneuerbaren Energien. Unser Ziel ist es, die Welt mit Solar-, Wind- und Hybridkraftwerken, innovativen Speicherlösungen und visionären grünen Wasserstoffprojekten neu zu definieren. 

Begleite uns auf dieser spannenden Reise, um unseren Planeten nachhaltig zu verändern.

Für unser Team suchen wir eine engagierte Projektmanager (m/w/d), die die erfolgreiche Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekten von der ersten Standortidee bis zur Genehmigungsreife und Übergabe in die Realisierung verantwortet.

Ziel der Rolle ist es, wirtschaftlich attraktive, genehmigungsfähige und technisch umsetzbare Projekte zu identifizieren und gezielt voranzutreiben. Dabei übernimmst Du die ganzheitliche Steuerung der Projekte sowie die Koordination aller relevanten internen und externen Stakeholder und stellst die Einhaltung von Zeit-, Kosten-, Qualitäts- und Entwicklungszielen sicher.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Projektakquise und Standortentwicklung: Identifikation, Bewertung und Sicherung geeigneter Standorte und Flächen für Wind-, PV- und BESS-Projekte einschließlich Machbarkeitsanalysen und Flächensicherung.
  • Projektentwicklung und Genehmigung: Entwicklung und Optimierung von Projekten, Steuerung der Genehmigungs- und Planungsverfahren sowie Koordination von Gutachtern, Planern, Behörden und weiteren Projektpartnern.
  • Technische und wirtschaftliche Entwicklung: Bewertung von Netzanschlussmöglichkeiten, Projektlayouts und Wirtschaftlichkeit sowie Steuerung von Kosten, Terminen, Risiken und Projektbudgets.
  • Stakeholder- und Projektmanagement: Aufbau und Pflege von Beziehungen zu Grundstückseigentümern, Kommunen, Behörden, Netzbetreibern und Geschäftspartnern sowie Koordination der internen und externen Projektbeteiligten.
  • Projektabschluss und Übergabe: Vorbereitung der Projekte für Finanzierung, Vermarktung, Verkauf oder Übergabe in die Bau- und Realisierungsphase.

Requirements

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation im technischen oder energiewirtschaftlichen Umfeld.
  • Berufserfahrung in der Projektentwicklung im Bereich erneuerbare Energien, der Netzintegration oder der Netzanschlussplanung.
  • Gute Kenntnisse regulatorischer- und Grundkenntnisse netztechnischer Anforderungen.
  • Analytische, strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.
  • Sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und starkes Schnittstellenmanagement.
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf professionellem Niveau sowie fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse werden vorausgesetzt.

Benefits

  • Flexibler Arbeitsort: Du hast die Möglichkeit, remote von zu Hause aus zu arbeiten. Zusätzlich steht dir unser modernes und nachhaltiges Büro in Berlin-Südkreuz zur Verfügung, das eine gute Anbindung und eine angenehme Arbeitsumgebung bietet.
  • IT-Ausstattung: Wir stellen dir einen Laptop, Monitor, Kopfhörer und, falls erforderlich, ein Diensthandy zur Verfügung.
  • Work-Life-Balance: Deine Zeit ist wertvoll! Gestalte deine Arbeitszeiten flexibel, damit du persönliche Termine wahrnehmen, früher ins Wochenende starten oder einfach das Leben besser mit der Arbeit in Einklang bringen kannst. Du entscheidest.
  • Spendit Card: Monatlich 50 € zusätzlich zum Gehalt, die du für dein tägliches Mittagessen nutzen oder unbegrenzt ansparen kannst.
  • Großzügige Urlaubsregelung: Genieße 31 Urlaubstage pro Jahr, um dich zu erholen, neue Energie zu tanken und die Welt zu entdecken.
  • Onboarding: Mit einem strukturierten Onboarding-Prozess sorgen wir für einen reibungslosen Start und begleiten dich von Tag eins an, damit du dich gut aufgehoben fühlst.
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge: Wir leisten einen monatlichen Beitrag von 13,29 € zu deiner Altersvorsorge.
  • Versicherungsschutz: Unfall- und Lebensversicherung sind inklusive – für deine Sicherheit und ein gutes Gefühl, sowohl im Job als auch privat.
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte: Über unser Corporate Benefits-Programm erhältst du exklusive Rabatte auf zahlreiche Marken und Produkte.
  • Firmenwagen: Falls du berechtigt bist und dein Job es erfordert, steht dir ein Firmenwagen zur Verfügung.
  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement: Deine Gesundheit steht an erster Stelle! Profitiere von unserem Gesundheitsmanagement, inklusive Vorsorgeuntersuchungen, um fit und leistungsfähig zu bleiben.

Q ENERGY ist ein international tätiges Unternehmen – bei uns arbeiten Menschen aus verschiedenen Nationen, Kulturen und Standorten partnerschaftlich zusammen und tauschen ihre Erfahrungen und Werte in einer offenen und kollegialen Atmosphäre aus.
