jobs.description:
Overview

JOB TITLE: JCIS Business & Policy Analyst

GOVERNMENT AGENCY: DOJ LESIS (Law Enforcement Services & Information Sharing)

POSITION INFORMATION: Full-Time Position; Government contractor supporting DOJ LESIS

LOCATION: Remote

POSITION TIMING: Position requires DOJ Public Trust clearance; candidate can start once complete (2-4 weeks)

BENEFITS: Health, Dental and Vision, 401(k), Flexible Spending Account (FSA), 11 Paid Federal Holidays, PTO, education reimbursement

ITC Federal, LLC (ITC) connects technology advancements in automation and AI, customer experience, and financial services to solve government mission challenges, enabling smoother operational efficiency and bolstering national security. We leverage the latest technology innovations and proven approaches to better serve the mission and support the DHS, DOJ, and DoW workforce, customers, and programs, regardless of scale or complexity. ITC is located in Fairfax, VA and offers outstanding compensation and benefits plan and a challenging and rewarding professional work environment.

ITC is seeking a JCIS (Justice Criminal Information Services) Business Policy Analyst to join our LESIS team supporting the Department of Justice. This individual will provide technical and management oversight, along with policy focused solutions, in support of JCIS for the broader law enforcement community.

Department of Justice (DOJ) Office of the Chief Information Officer (OCIO) Law Enforcement Services and Information Sharing (LESIS) Section serves as the FBI Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) Systems Agency (CSA) for hundreds of DOJ, as well as other Federal and Tribal public safety agencies and entities. It is responsible for establishing and administering an information technology security program across its User Agencies while providing the technical capabilities to access national crime information systems for authorized criminal and non-criminal justice purposes.

Responsibilities

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Strategizes with Service Owner and program stakeholders to explore new biometric business and technical requirements, opportunities, customer issues and needs, and develops fiscal year roadmaps.
  • Manage technical support operations for biometric systems, including troubleshooting, coordination with engineering teams, prioritization of issues, and resolution tracking to maintain system reliability and service continuity. Provide management oversight of vendor performed operational support services, ensuring compliance with contractual requirements, service-level agreements, and federal biometric standards.
  • Serve as a subject-matter expert on biometric standards, EBTS, NIST, and FBI NGI changes—conduct technical research, provide briefings, draft white papers, and advise on implementation impacts.
  • Facilitates, and/or leads customer liaison coordination meetings to improve customer and service issues and derive new requirements.
  • Participate in criminal and civil services related Task Forces and Working Groups, develop white papers, and presents program strategic roadmaps to senior leadership.
  • Analyze and evaluate existing policies to ensure alignment with U.S. Codes, Code of Federal Regulation (CFR), Executive Orders (EO), Departmental policies, organizational goals, objectives, and legal requirements. Assist with drafting new policies and amendments.
  • Perform in-depth policy reviews to confirm alignment with NIST SP 800-63, ANSI/NIST standards, and CJIS Security Policy with DOJ and federal regulations.
  • Engage and establish a strong working relationship with FBI CJIS leadership and technical team to enhance services and information sharing with Law Enforcement community
  • Define, document, and present strategic roadmaps for future biometric integrations (e.g., facial recognition, palm, iris), aligning business needs and technical feasibility.
  • Ensure projects align to business goals.
  • Assists with managing, monitoring, and delivering program requirements (SLAs and Deliverables).
  • Aligns service management processes to ISO 27/20K controls.
  • Performs project planning, monitoring and control to include task resourcing, and deliverable management.
  • Manages vendor relationships to ensure compliance with contracts.
  • Oversees and manages projects to system releases, deliverables, and data calls.
  • Review, triage and analyze support tickets; identity trends and solutions
  • Coordinates and facilitates the resolution of emergent operational support issues.

Qualifications

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 10+ years of experience in IT focused in ITSM, System Auditing and Policies
  • 5+ years of Program Management and Leadership experience
  • Significant understanding of project management fundamentals and ability to work within project constraints
  • Experience using automation/tools to collect and analyze system and program metrics.
  • Demonstrated ability to use MS Office Suite to include Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Project, and include SharePoint
  • Experience with biometric standards, including knowledge of Electronic Biometric Transmission Specification (EBTS), ANSI/NIST ITL biometric standards, and CJIS Security Policy (preferred). Excellent analytical, problem solving, and presentation skills
  • Excellent customer relationship management skills
  • Prior Law Enforcement exposure or familiarity with federal/state law enforcement or DOJ IT program exposure, preferred
  • Ability to coordinate and manage multiple tasks and priorities
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills for effective stakeholder management
  • Proficiency in project management tools and software i.e. Microsoft Project, strongly preferred.
  • Experience utilizing and working in Dynamics.

SECURITY CLEARANCE REQUIREMENTS:

Ability to obtain a DOJ public trust clearance; candidate selected will be subject to a Government Public Trust security investigation and must meet eligibility requirements for access to the customer's Current clearance is not required, but selected individual cannot start the assignment until the required security clearance is granted by the customer.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Must be able to function in general office environment.

jobs.excerpt: Who We AreOnYourMark Education is a high dosage virtual tutoring service providing individualized virtual literacy instruction grounded in the science of reading.
jobs.description:
Who We Are

OnYourMark Education is a high dosage virtual tutoring service providing individualized virtual literacy instruction grounded in the science of reading. We partner with schools as a supplement to the literacy instruction already in place to ensure students get the foundational reading skills they need to excel! A randomized controlled trial conducted in SY 2022-23 by Stanford University's National Student Support Accelerator (NSSA) proves that OnYourMark's live virtual tutoring for K-5 significantly improves student reading skills. OnYourMark students gained 24 extra days learning letter sounds (K) and 51 extra days in decoding (1st grade).

Why We Exist

OnYourMark exists to ensure that the students we serve have a strong foundation to become thriving readers. We also believe that spreading an understanding of the science of how children learn to read can be transformative for tutors, teachers, children, and families. Getting foundational literacy skills right early will support children to read on grade level and diminish the need for schools to remediate at their current levels.

Why Apply

When you join the OnYourMark team, you commit to supporting students to become lifelong readers with the foundational reading skills to tackle future school and life challenges and adventures. Joining the OnYourMark team is right for you if you are invested in having an impact on the lives of young people, are committed to learning, and are inspired to be a part of eradicating educational inequities. Being a part of a founding team requires thriving in ambiguity and fully embracing OnYourMark’s start-up mantra, “find a need and fill the need.”

Position Overview

The Manager of Sales Development is an individual-contributor, revenue-generating role responsible for outbound and inbound lead generation, prospect qualification, and pipeline nurturing within the K-12 education sector. This person uses HubSpot and other sales tools daily to manage prospecting and outreach activity but isn't responsible for administering, configuring, or overseeing the platform itself.

This role is focused on top-of-funnel lead generation with a marketing-support lens. The Manager of Sales Development conducts outbound prospecting and nurture campaigns, qualifies leads based on engagement and fit, supports marketing program execution, engages in social selling and digital outreach, and shares feedback on campaign and messaging effectiveness.

Key Responsibilities

  • Use HubSpot and other sales tools (e.g., GovSpend) to log activity, track leads, manage campaigns, and keep pipeline data accurate and up to date.
  • Contribute data and insights toward sales dashboards and reports that help track pipeline health and key sales metrics.
  • Collaborate with marketing, sales, program, partnerships, and other cross-functional teams to align on go-to-market strategies, lead generation initiatives, and sales enablement resources.
  • Generate new leads through research, outbound campaigns, and networking; qualify prospects to ensure strong fit and readiness for engagement.
  • Support the RFP process by gathering initial information and assisting with cross-department coordination as needed.
  • Nurture early-stage opportunities, providing education and value to prospects, and manage the pipeline through the initial sales stages.
  • Ensure a smooth and timely handoff of qualified opportunities to the closing sales team or partnership team, maintaining clear documentation and communication.
  • Identify and share process improvement ideas to increase personal and team productivity

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 2-3 years of experience in sales development, business development, or a related outbound/prospecting role; experience in Ed-Tech or nonprofit sales is a plus.
  • Experience using HubSpot for prospecting, activity logging, and pipeline tracking.
  • Demonstrated ability to analyze data, generate insights, and present actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent organizational, project management, and communication skills.
  • Proven track record of cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience in lead generation, prospect qualification, and pipeline management

Working at OnYourMark

Join a national team that is dedicated to building OnYourMark in service of our tutors and young readers across the country!

All OnYourMark teammates are fully remote and enjoy the flexibilities that come with that. We work hard and thrive in a supportive environment that is really “All In” as required in a startup while centering each teammate as a whole person with real life needs and responsibilities (like picking kids up from school, going to the doctor, working out etc.) beyond our professional commitments.

One of our key mantras is “find a need and fill the need.” In practice this means often stepping outside the lanes of our job descriptions to lend a hand to whatever task is most pressing across the organization, from helping to interview tutor candidates, to getting students set up with the technology needed to be able to connect for sessions. There really is no job too big or too small for any teammate.

Problem-solvers and self-starters thrive at OnYourMark. There are natural ebbs and flows to the work that often mean long hours at the start of sessions and then role specific flexibilities that center around a more traditional work week. We also work across the country so early mornings or later evenings are possible depending on a teammate’s timezone and where the schools we serve are located.

Expected compensation 75,000 annually, commensurate with experience.

Salary: 75,000

jobs.description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview

Instacarts Detection Engineering team sits at the core of our Security organization, building and operating the systems that identify, surface, and respond to threats across one of North America's largest grocery technology platforms. We own the full detection lifecycle, from telemetry collection and signal design to automated response, across a complex, cloud-native environment spanning endpoint, cloud, container, and SaaS.

As a Senior Detection Engineer II, you'll be a technical anchor on the team: developing high-fidelity detection logic, hunting for novel attacker techniques, and raising the bar for how we think about coverage, quality, and scale. You'll work closely with Engineering, Red Team, Incident Response, Fraud, and Trust & Safety to ensure our detections reflect real-world adversary behavior; not just signatures.

We operate with a detection-as-code mindset: everything we build is versioned, tested, and deployed through repeatable pipelines. We care deeply about reducing noise, improving analyst efficiency through automation and SOAR, and continuously evolving our coverage as the threat landscape shifts.

If you're energized by hard forensic problems, enjoy translating attacker TTPs into durable detection logic, and want to help shape the future of a growing security function, this role is for you.

About the Job

  • Develop, tune, document, and maintain detection logic across multiple log sources including endpoint, cloud, container, and SaaS products.
  • Assist in cyber forensic investigations across a variety of log sources
  • Optimize log ingestion pipelines and telemetry collection to ensure high-quality, actionable security data while managing volume and cost
  • Design and build SOAR playbooks and automation workflows to streamline detection triage, enrichment, and response actions
  • Mentor junior security analysts and detection engineers on threat hunting methodologies, detection logic development, and investigation techniques

About You

Minimum Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in a detection engineering, incident response, or offensive security role.
  • Experience with 1 or more public cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Deep understanding of attacker TTPs across modern zero trust environments, including identity compromise, token theft, and abuse of trust boundaries
  • Proficient understanding of macOS internals and telemetry available to identify macOS specific threats
  • Experience implementing detection-as-code workflows including version control, peer review processes, automated testing, and CI/CD deployment pipelines
  • Basic proficiency with Python, Golang, or other programming languages
  • Relevant certifications: GCFA, GCFE, GNFA, GREM, OSCP, GCIA, or similar

Preferred Qualifications

  • Background in offensive security or red teaming
  • Knowledge of machine learning for threat detection

Location: Brasil

The Associate Director of Development (ADOD) I, Latin America, will work in partnership with the Senior Associate Director of Development for Latin America, TNC Relationship Managers (RMs) and fundraising leaders across TNC to discover, cultivate, solicit and steward donors for major or principal gifts that contribute to Latin America’s conservation and fundraising goals – specifically TNC´s work in Brazil.

They can articulate all global priorities of TNC and work within a campaign at an advanced level. They understand organizational budgets and are proficient utilizing this knowledge to build proposal budgets. They have an advanced knowledge of international charitable giving, particularly in the areas of private foundations, operating foundations, and Donor Advised Funds, and can discuss complex charitable options with donors. They will work across chapters and programs and manage a referral network. The ADOD I will staff Latin America leadership on trips. They will lead diverse activities, project outcomes, and initiate solutions to improve effectiveness. The ADOD I leverages constructive and effective relationships with a wide range of people, including donors, executives, senior management, public and private sector colleagues, and partners including staff across the organization. They liaise with diverse teams across the organization delivering TNC’s global conservation work, including the Regional Managing Director of Latin America, Principal Gifts, Global Priorities, Planned Giving, Business Unit Directors, Directors of Development, global conservation leadership and local development and conservation teams. They will be required to use the Conservancy’s donor database.

RESPONSIBILITIES & SCOPE

  • Assist in achieving the “raised for” goal of US $40M (FY27) with the goal of doubling philanthropic revenue by 2030.

  • Execute strategies to engage RMs, Business Units, Divisions and other Regions to support them in discovery, cultivation and stewardship of international prospects and donors with the capacity to give over US $100,000 to TNC’s work in Latin America – especially in Brazil.

  • Support donor and leadership engagement opportunities in Brazil including (but not limited to) donor meetings, donor trips to the region, in-person donor events, or TNC leadership visits and trips for the international and local portfolio.

  • Manage a portfolio of 25 to 50 RMs who manage major donors or prospects with the capacity to give over US $100,000. Responsible for 25 to 50 visits with relationship managers and 75 to 150 moves annually.

  • Financial responsibility for setting and meeting fundraising objectives, evaluating results, and developing corrective strategies.

  • Project manage TNC internal review processes needed at the local, regional and global level for international solicitations / gifts for their assigned country market.

  • Work with the Donor Communications team in drafting personalized correspondence for donors such as (but not limited to) donor proposals, stewardship notes and reports.

  • Support the design and implementation of collaborative, complex, and diversified fundraising projects, coordinating the work of other development professionals, and ensuring accountability.

  • Use TNC’s donor database to update donor information, produce reports, perform analysis, and track and cultivate donors.

  • Persuasively convey the mission of TNC to diverse groups important to the organization’s overall prosperity.

  • Share and reinforce the organization's policies and procedures related to travel and events to ensure consistent, best in class engagement experiences for all TNC donors and chapters, and to minimize organizational risk.

  • Ensure compliance with TNC policies and procedures and external (donor/legal/IRS) requirements; be alert to ethical compliance issues.

  • Maintain confidentiality of frequently sensitive and emotionally charged information.

  • Travel domestically and/or internationally frequently and on short notice, work long hours and weekends as needed.

  • Work environment involves only infrequent exposure to disagreeable elements and minor physical exertion and/or strain.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Experience building and maintaining long-term relationships with major and principal gift donors, volunteers and staff. Experience in asking for and closing gifts of $100,000 or more is a plus.

  • Experience designing and implementing fundraising strategies, including cultivation, solicitation and recognition strategies.

  • Strong project management skills including coordinating activities led by others and managing deadlines.

  • Ability to determine an individual’s interests, capacity and potential for helping the Conservancy meet its goals, and act appropriately to tie those interests with the Conservancy’s work.

  • Experience, coursework, or other training in current and evolving trends in charitable giving, particularly in the areas of capital campaigns, major gifts and planned giving.

  • Experience and ability to work across departments and multiple teams.

  • Demonstrated experience using listening, diplomacy, and tact to build strong relationships and motivate donors and volunteers.

  • Proven ability to negotiate complex, high profile or sensitive agreements.

  • Experience generating reports and analyzing and interpreting the data.

  • Familiarity with the Latin America Region.

The Nature Conservancy’s mission is to protect the lands and waters upon which all life depends. As a science-based organization, we create innovative, on-the-ground solutions to our world’s toughest challenges so that we can create a world in which people and nature thrive. Since 1951, TNC has been doing work you can believe in. Thanks to more than 1 million members, over 400 scientists, and the dedicated efforts of our diverse staff and partners, we impact conservation around the world!

Virtualitics is the category leader in AI-native readiness applications for defense, government, and critical infrastructure. Founded on a decade of Caltech research in partnership with NASA/JPL, we are led by scientists, strategists, and servicemembers united by a single mission: to solve the world’s most complex, mission-critical challenges with AI.

Our Readiness AI solutions deliver operational certainty — giving leaders and operators a clear picture of what’s ready, what’s at risk, and what to do next. By identifying risks early, diagnosing root causes, and recommending prioritized actions with transparent, explainable AI, we help organizations move from data complexity to decision advantage.

Behind that impact is relentless innovation. Inventors at heart, we hold 15+ U.S. patents and are leading the shift toward agent-driven readiness. But what truly sets us apart is our culture — relentless about results, grounded in transparency, and driven by compassion for the mission and the people it serves.

If you’re motivated by impact, inspired by technical depth, and ready to build AI that performs where it matters most — you’ll find your mission here.

Our team is excited to find our next Account Based Marketing Manager to join the company.

What you will be doing:

  • Own and execute account-based marketing programs for Virtualitics' priority public sector account pods: U.S. Navy, U.S. Marine Corps, U.S. Air Force, U.S. Space Force, U.S. Army, NatSec, COCOMs, and Federal Systems Integrators (FSIs).

  • Partner with GTM stakeholders to build account based marketing plans that align messaging and content to each pod's mission priorities and procurement cycle.

  • Plan and run integrated ABM campaigns across prioritized marketing channels tailored to named accounts within each pod.

  • Represent Virtualitics at government/defense-focused events, including flagship/service-level events [e.g., AFA Air, Space & Cyber, Sea-Air-Space, AUSA], managing pre/onsite/post-event activations and amplification.

  • Maintain a shared view of account engagement and pipeline influence in Salesforce Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, and report program performance to GTM stakeholders.

  • Develop tailored content and enablement assets, including one-pagers, case studies, presentations, etc., in partnership with GTM, tech/product, mission success teams to support pod-specific sales conversations.

  • Work with the Marketing Director to prioritize account coverage and adjust program investment based on pipeline stage and account tier.

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in account-based marketing, field marketing, or public sector marketing, ideally supporting defense, intelligence, or federal civilian audiences.

  • Demonstrated experience building and running multi-channel ABM programs against named account lists.

  • Working knowledge of the public sector buying process and the mission priorities of DoW service branches, COCOMs, or NatSec organizations.

  • Experience partnering directly with GTM stakeholders to align marketing investment with pipeline goals.

  • Willingness to travel to industry conferences and events [up to 25%].

  • Strong industry writing and communication skills, with the ability to translate technical capabilities into compelling mission-relevant value propositions for multiple personas.

What are our preferred requirements:

  • Prior experience at a company serving defense, national security, or critical infrastructure customers.Experience marketing to or within Federal Systems Integrators (FSIs).

  • Familiarity with Salesforce and Account Engagement (Marketing Cloud), or equivalent CRM and marketing automation platforms.

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • Must provide one writing sample during interview process

  • Candidates based near our West Coast (CA) or East Coast (NOVA) offices are preferred.

What are some valued skills:

  • Skilled at building relationships across the business to influence ideas, manage competing priorities across account pods, and drive buy-in on marketing best practices and recommendations.

  • A data-driven approach to measuring ABM program impact on pipeline and revenue.

  • Comfort operating independently in a remote, fast-moving environment.

  • Fluency in the operational and mission context of defense and national security customers.

What we offer you

At Virtualitics, you’ll join a high-performance team of scientists, strategists, and servicemembers building AI that operates in the world’s most demanding environments. The problems we solve matter — and so does the opportunity to grow while solving them.

You’ll have meaningful ownership from day one, with the ability to accelerate your career alongside a company scaling rapidly in national security and critical infrastructure.

We offer highly competitive compensation, meaningful equity participation, and fully paid medical, dental, and vision coverage for you and your dependents. Our benefits also include unlimited PTO and flexible work arrangements, with remote flexibility and hybrid options for team members based in the Los Angeles or Washington, DC areas.

About the Role

We're looking for a short-form video editor who lives and breathes TikTok and Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ad creative. This isn't a "make it look pretty" editing role — it's a performance editing role. You understand that the first 3 seconds decide everything, that a single video can be recut into 10 winning variations, and that the difference between a scroll and a sale is the hook and the angle.

You'll take our existing footage, UGC, product clips, and past creative — and turn it into thumb-stopping ads that convert.

What You'll Do

  • Edit high-retention, high-engagement short-form videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and Meta Ads
  • Write and cut strong hooks (visual + text) and test multiple hook variations per concept
  • Develop and execute different creative angles for the same product (problem/solution, social proof, UGC, listicle, "TikTok made me buy it," etc.)
  • Clip, repurpose, and remix existing videos and older creative into fresh, native-feeling ads
  • Cut multiple variations of winning ads for A/B testing (hook swaps, different intros, aspect ratios, lengths)
  • Add captions, sound design, trending audio, on-screen text, and pacing that keeps viewers watching
  • Stay current on TikTok/Meta trends, formats, and what's working in the ad account
  • Collaborate with the media buying / marketing team, iterating quickly based on ad performance data
  • Deliver on fast turnaround timelines with a high volume of creatives

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience editing for TikTok and/or Meta Ads (please share a portfolio, reel, or examples of ads you've cut)
  • Deep understanding of hooks, angles, and retention — you can explain why a video works, not just edit it
  • Strong grasp of what makes short-form content native and scroll-stopping (not corporate or overproduced)
  • Ability to repurpose and reframe existing footage into new, high-performing clips
  • Proficiency in editing tools (CapCut, Premiere Pro, After Effects, or equivalent)
  • Fast, self-directed, and comfortable producing a high volume of creative
  • Bonus: experience editing direct-response / DTC e-commerce ads, working with UGC creators, or a track record of ads that actually drove results

Nice to Have

  • Basic understanding of ad performance metrics (hook rate, hold rate, CTR, ROAS)
  • Experience with home décor, lifestyle, or product-based brands
  • Ability to source trending audio and formats before they peak
Salary: $15-$20/HR

jobs.excerpt: BASE COMPENSATION: $170,000 - $190,000 annually WORKPLACE SETTING: Remote POSITION SUMMARY The Solution Architect at 10X Health paves the road for every major initiative: shaping the solution from business intent through product and system architecture, proving it in working code, and handing development teams specifications precise enough to build fast and build right.
jobs.description:
BASE COMPENSATION: $170,000 - $190,000 annually
WORKPLACE SETTING: Remote

POSITION SUMMARY
The Solution Architect at 10X Health paves the road for every major initiative: shaping the solution from business intent through product and system architecture, proving it in working code, and handing development teams specifications precise enough to build fast and build right. This is emphatically not a paper architecture role. The Solution Architect validates designs by building them, typically delivering the first 50-60% of an initiative as working reference implementation before development teams take it to completion. In an organization where AI agents have largely solved the mechanics of writing code, the scarce skill is upstream: defining granular, unambiguous, development-ready specifications ahead of time. This role owns that discipline, owns the overall technology roadmap, and spans the full surface of our platforms, including web, cloud, integrations, and mobile. The role reports to the Chief Technology Officer.

ABOUT 10X HEALTH SYSTEM
10X Health System is a pioneering company at the forefront of the health and wellness industry, dedicated to revolutionizing the way individuals approach their personal health and well-being. With a philosophy rooted in the principle that optimal health is the foundation for a life lived to the fullest, 10X Health provides cutting-edge solutions and personalized health plans designed to empower individuals to achieve and maintain peak physical and mental performance.

The company's comprehensive approach to health combines the latest advances in medical science, nutrition, fitness, and technology to offer a suite of services that include state-of-the-art diagnostic testing, individualized treatment protocols, and ongoing support from a team of world-class health professionals. 10X Health's commitment to innovation and results has established it as a leader in the health optimization space, catering to those who strive to push the boundaries of what is possible in their health journey.

OBJECTIVES

  • Own solution design for each company initiative end to end: from business intent to product architecture, system architecture, integration design, and buildable specifications
  • Prove architecture in code by building reference implementations, scaffolding, and the riskiest vertical slices, typically the first 50-60%, before handing to development teams
  • Produce granular, development-ready specifications, designed so that developers and AI coding agents can execute rapidly with minimal ambiguity or rework
  • Own product architecture alongside system architecture: how capabilities compose into products, member journeys, and revenue lines, not just how services talk to each other
  • Own and maintain the overall technology roadmap, keeping it aligned with company strategy, sequencing initiatives, and making dependencies and tradeoffs visible to leadership
  • Design integration solutions across commercial SaaS platforms, owned services, laboratory and clinical partners, and data systems
  • Set the architectural direction for mobile alongside web and cloud, ensuring one coherent platform across surfaces
COMPETENCIES
  • Remains genuinely hands-on: prototypes, codes, and ships working software as the primary method of validating architecture
  • Translates ambiguous business intent into precise technical specifications, closing the gap between what stakeholders ask for and what teams can build
  • Demonstrates deep expertise in enterprise architecture, scalable system design, and modern API and microservices patterns
  • Designs mobile application architecture (native or cross-platform) and understands the operational realities of app store delivery, offline behavior, and device data
  • Develops scalable integration solutions across platforms, applications, and data systems, including vendor and partner systems with imperfect interfaces
  • Applies DevOps and CI/CD best practices so reference implementations land in production pipelines, not in slide decks
  • Maintains strong focus on security, compliance, and data protection standards, including HIPAA obligations in a healthcare context
  • Communicates architecture clearly to executives, product stakeholders, and engineers alike, adjusting altitude without losing precision
AI and Agentic Engineering
  • Uses AI coding agents such as Claude Code as a core working method, both to build reference implementations at high speed and to pressure-test whether specifications are truly unambiguous • Designs specifications and architecture artifacts for an AI-accelerated delivery model, where granular specs are the input that lets agents and developers produce correct code fast
  • Designs and ships AI product features end to end, including model API integration, agent orchestration, retrieval augmented generation, structured tool use, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP) for connecting agents to internal systems
  • Builds evaluation and quality systems for AI features, including automated evals, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop review, so AI behavior stays measurable and controllable in production
  • Applies responsible AI practices in a healthcare context, balancing model autonomy with human oversight and keeping AI features aligned with HIPAA, FTC, and broader consumer protection standards
EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE
  • 12+ years of software engineering experience, including significant experience as a hands-on architect on complex, multi-system initiatives
  • Proven record of taking initiatives from concept to production, personally building foundational implementations that other engineers then extended
  • Strong expertise in cloud infrastructure, APIs, microservices, integrations, and scalable architecture; Microsoft Azure experience preferred
  • Experience architecting and shipping production mobile applications alongside web and backend systems
  • Experience writing detailed technical specifications and driving spec-first development across internal and offshore teams
  • Experience owning or heavily shaping a technology roadmap across multiple products or initiatives
  • Hands-on experience building and shipping production AI or LLM-powered product features, such as agentic workflows, RAG systems, copilots, or content generation pipelines
  • Practical experience using AI coding agents such as Claude Code, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot in real engineering work, ideally including building custom agent skills, MCP integrations, or automated pipelines on top of them
  • Healthcare, health-tech, SaaS, eCommerce, or consumer platform experience preferred
PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS
  • Ability to spend prolonged periods working on a computer and communicating with patients and team members
  • Ability to interact with patients virtually and occasionally in person
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform essential job functions
COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY
As an equal opportunity employer committed to meeting the needs of a multigenerational and multicultural workforce, 10X Health System recognizes that a diverse staff, reflective of our community, is an integral and welcome part of a successful and ethical business. We hire local talent at all levels regardless of race, color, religion, age, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, or disability, and actively foster inclusion in all forms both within our company and across interactions with clients, candidates, and partners. If you require any accommodations during the application process or have any questions, please contact

SOLICITATION POLICY
10X Health does not accept unsolicited resumes, calls, or communications from staffing agencies or third-party recruiters. Any such submissions will be considered the sole property of 10X Health and will not obligate the company to pay any fees. Please refrain from contacting us regarding this posting.

jobs.excerpt: About VGSVGS is the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce.
jobs.description:
About VGS

VGS is the world's leader in payment tokenization, trusted by the most innovative AI and Fortune 500 companies, merchants, banks, and fintechs to power modern payments and agentic commerce.

We tokenize over 9 billion tokens and process more than 10 billion monthly interactions, touching a third of all e-commerce. That scale isn't incidental. It's why leading companies embed our universal token vault and credential management platform directly into their stack, taming the complexity of payment data so they can move faster.

We’re helping businesses unlock new possibilities in an industry that never stops moving. And that takes exceptional people.

Trusted Engineering That Matters

Engineering at VGS

Our vision is clear: VGS is building the platform powering agentic commerce and global payments infrastructure. VGS Engineering is the pillar that supports that vision. We create a platform that is an indispensable, ubiquitous component of our partners' payments and security infrastructure. To achieve this, we build and operate high-scale, reliable, and resilient systems that manage mission-critical payment data across the globe. We don't just participate in the payments ecosystem; we power it.

Our Environment & Culture

  • Tooling as Leverage for Impact: We value speed and impact. To ensure nothing slows you down, we arm you with a highly consistent modern stack (e.g. AWS, Kubernetes, Java, TypeScript, Python) and world-class AI-augmented SDLC tooling. We strip away the friction so you can focus on building simple things that work, pushing boundaries, and delivering value faster.

  • Impact Over Input: Scaling global payments infrastructure requires individuals who take personal ownership of outcomes from day one. We look for builders who combine high agency with deep strategic alignment; channeling their urgency and relentless iteration into what matters most. Leading from the front means multiplying the impact of those around you so we win collectively.

  • Mission-Critical Accountability: We power payments infrastructure for global market leaders, making system trust and integrity our core deliverable. We don't treat compliance (PCI, SOC2, ISO27001), security patching, and platform maintenance as administrative overhead—we engineer them with first-class product discipline. We apply the same rigor, roadmap thinking, and speed to system health as we do to new features. In high-scale payments, reliability isn't background work; it is our product.

Learn More: See how our engineering practices drive trust and innovation in our official blog and our reliability practices.

About the Role

As a Staff Infrastructure Engineer, you will serve as a technical leader on our Platform Engineering team. You will architect, scale, and fortify global cloud infrastructure designed to handle mission-critical, high-throughput payments applications with zero downtime.

You will take ownership of key platform foundations powering our core payments infrastructure. Rather than executing against a rigid task list or holding blanket ownership over the entire platform, you will drive the technical strategy, architecture, and reliability standards for your designated domains within our multi-region AWS environment. We are looking for high-agency engineers who want to own complex distributed system challenges end-to-end and elevate how the entire engineering team operates.

If you thrive on solving complex distributed systems problems, building automated resiliency, and driving modern SRE practices, we want to build the future with you.

What You'll Do

  • Build Immutable, Self-Healing Systems: Design, build, and optimize multi-region, high-availability AWS infrastructure. You will drive our evolution from hand-crafted environments to a standardized, globally scalable fleet managed entirely through code.

  • Drive Resiliency & Automation: Replace manual toil with self-healing, automated infrastructure using GitOps, modern CI/CD pipelines, and IaC.

  • Deep Observability & Resiliency: Build end-to-end telemetry (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to proactively spot bottlenecks. You will own incident management and conduct blameless post-mortems to continuously harden our reliability baseline.

  • Force-Multiply Engineering Velocity: Partner closely with Product, Security, and Core Engineering teams and lead from the front by designing "Golden Paths" that strip away friction for feature teams. You will influence company-wide engineering practices and mentor the organization on how to move fast with high alignment.

  • Customer Impact: Architect and operate high-performance, low-latency private connectivity to optimize the experience for external customers. Partner strategically with internal engineering teams at the design and architectural level for platform enablement and adoption.

What You Bring

  • Ownership at Scale: 8+ years of experience taking personal ownership of outcomes in complex, large-scale distributed systems within mission-critical environments.

  • AWS & Infrastructure-as-Code: Advanced proficiency in AWS ecosystems leveraging Terraform to build reproducible environments.

  • Containerization & Orchestration: Strong, hands-on experience with Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, and GitOps workflows (Flux, Argo, GitHub Actions).

  • Automation & Scripting: Strong coding skills in Python, Go, or Bash to automate infrastructure and build operational tools.

  • Observability Expertise: Deep experience implementing Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry at scale.

  • Security & Networking Foundations: Solid understanding of cloud security, API Gateways, load balancing, and network isolation, viewing security as a fundamental engineering constraint, not an afterthought.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with tokenization, payment processing, cryptology, or security products

  • BA/BS degree

  • A knack for out-of-the-box thinking that thrives in a fast-paced startup environment

  • Experience managing distributed data streaming platforms like Kafka (MSK).

  • Database performance tuning and query optimization skills.

  • Familiarity with Java / Spring Framework services.

Remote Resourcer – Tutors
180 recruitment, candidate side | Qualified teachers and online tutors
Job title Remote Resourcer, Tutors (known internally as Remote Worker)
Division Education
Team Tutors
Reports to Remote Team Manager
Works alongside Tutors consultants and the wider Education division
Location Fully remote, working from a private home office outside the UK
Hours 08:00 – 16:30
Model 180 recruitment, candidate side only.
Purpose of the role
The Remote Resourcer owns the tutor journey from first contact to the point a tutor is fully compliant, interviewed, briefed and ready to teach. The consultant then takes that tutor to market and manages the client relationship. Tutors work one to one or in small groups, often online and often with vulnerable learners, so the quality of the screening and the accuracy of the compliance file directly affect the safety of children and the reputation of the business. This is a role where getting the detail right matters more than moving quickly.
Key responsibilities
Tutor attraction and sourcing
▪ Source qualified teachers, early career teachers, experienced tutors and subject specialists through job boards, the CRM database, social media, tutor communities, referrals and advertising.
▪ Recruit across the subjects and key stages in live demand, including English, maths, science, SEN and exam intervention work.
▪ Write and post role adverts that reflect live demand from the consultants you support.
▪ Run daily proactive outreach by phone, email and message to build a pipeline ahead of demand rather than in reaction to it.
▪ Re engage lapsed and dormant tutors already held in the CRM.
▪ Keep a live map of tutor availability by subject, key stage, exam board, online or in person delivery and hours available.
Screening and interviewing
▪ Carry out a structured telephone initial call then a video registration call following a set interview structure.
▪ Establish and record full employment history, including the reason for any gap of more than one month.
▪ Verify teaching background: QTS or teaching qualification where held, subjects, key stages, exam boards and recent classroom or tuition experience.
▪ Assess suitability for tuition rather than classroom work: ability to plan for an individual learner, build rapport quickly, work without a school behaviour system behind them and report on progress.
▪ Assess suitability for online delivery: confidence with the tuition platform, camera and microphone quality, reliable connection, quiet and private teaching space and an appropriate background.
▪ Assess safeguarding awareness in a one to one and online setting specifically, not just in a classroom.
▪ Confirm availability including after school and weekend hours, travel radius for in person work, hourly rate expectations and any restrictions.
▪ Decline unsuitable tutors promptly and professionally, and record the reason.
Compliance and vetting
▪ Verify identity and address using original or certified documentation to the standard set out in the compliance procedure.
▪ Confirm the right to work in the UK and record document type, expiry and share code where applicable.
▪ Process an enhanced DBS check with a children’s barred list check, or verify a suitable existing certificate registered with the DBS Update Service, and carry out a status check.
▪ Complete prohibition from teaching, prohibition from management (section 128) and any sanction or restriction checks required for the role.
▪ Obtain and verify a minimum of two references covering the most recent employment or tuition work involving children, taken up in writing from a senior person at the organisation and verified by telephone or verified email domain.
▪ Obtain overseas police clearance or a certificate of good conduct for any period lived abroad, in line with the compliance procedure.
▪ Complete an online presence check on shortlisted tutors and record the outcome.
▪ Verify qualifications, QTS status where relevant, degree and subject qualifications and any specialist training certificates.
▪ Obtain a health and medical fitness declaration and escalate anything requiring occupational health input.
▪ Ensure safeguarding, Prevent, online safety and any mandatory training is completed and in date before release.
▪ Ensure the tutor has read and signed the one to one and online tuition code of conduct before any session is delivered.
▪ Chase outstanding documents daily and keep the tutor informed of exactly what is still needed.
▪ Maintain compliance records to audit standard so that a file can be produced on request for a client, an inspection or an external audit at any time.
▪ Escalate every discrepancy, gap, unexplained absence or concern to the Remote Team Manager. Never resolve a compliance query by assumption.
Getting tutors work ready
▪ Brief the tutor on how the agency works, expected conduct, timekeeping, absence reporting, session cancellation and safeguarding responsibilities.
▪ Complete platform onboarding so the tutor can run a session, record attendance and submit session notes without support.
▪ Run a short test session or technology check before the first booking for anyone delivering online.
▪ Ensure payroll and personal details are set up and correct before the first booking.
▪ Confirm the tutor understands their rate, how timesheets and session claims work and who to contact.
▪ Produce a clear, accurate tutor profile in company format, covering subjects, key stages, exam boards, availability and delivery method, that a consultant can send to a client without rework.
▪ Confirm the tutor is genuinely available and still interested before handover.
▪ Ensure all details are in the CRM.
Handover to the consultant
▪ Hand over only tutors who are fully screened, fully compliant, platform ready and briefed.
▪ Provide the consultant with a short written summary covering subjects and levels, availability, strengths, any client sensitivities and the compliance status.
▪ Answer consultant questions on the tutor and support them with any follow up information required.
▪ Track handed over tutors through to placement and feed back anything learned into future screening.
Systems and administration
▪ Record every call, message, document, interview and decision in the CRM on the day it happens.
▪ Keep tutor records, subject coverage, availability and compliance status accurate at all times. The CRM is the single source of truth.
▪ Maintain the compliance tracker and flag expiring documents before they lapse.
▪ Provide daily and weekly activity reporting to the Remote Team Manager.

  • Customer Integrations, Deployments, and Enablement
    Own the design and delivery of integrations that connect SentinelOne products into customer environments. Often this is work you will do alongside the customer's engineers, shaping both the solution and the knowledge transfer that goes with it. Produce the runbooks, integration docs, and executive-level technical communication that let customers operate independently.
  • Upstream Contributions to the Core Product
    When something needs fixing or improving in the core platform to make a customer whole, you go do it. Partner with platform teams to get contributions reviewed and supported long-term, and know when to invest in the long-term fix versus the near-term unblock. Along the way, build the tooling that codifies repeatable patterns and scales the whole Forward Deploy function.
  • Technical Leadership and Mentorship
    Raise the bar for the Forward Deploy Engineering team. Mentor Senior Forward Deploy Engineers, set standards for how engagements are scoped and delivered, and shape how the team operates as it grows.
  • Build and Review Technical Specifications
    Architect end-to-end solutions for complex problems with loose definition, sometimes spanning multiple codebases and owning teams. Document trade-offs and critical implementation details; review and provide meaningful feedback on other specs, understanding broader patterns and downstream/upstream dependencies.
  • Code Review
    Champion code quality, security, and efficiency. Your keen eye for detail will guide you in reviewing and elevating our codebase– including the codebases you're visiting.
  • Support and Team CollaborationRespond to ad-hoc customer and internal escalations promptly (no regular on-call rotation). Assist your colleagues, share constructive feedback, and contribute to weekly syncs and daily Slack standups.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

We do not require a perfect match with everything below; however, the more this describes you, the better of a fit you will be for this role.

  • Experience
    • Solid computer science background with 6+ years engineering experience including both backend and frontend.
    • Proven expertise designing and operating distributed systems or data-intensive services.
    • Track record of leading substantial pieces of work end-to-end, under ambiguity, with multiple stakeholders.
    • Experience working directly with customers or senior stakeholders to shape technical solutions.
  • Technical Mastery
    • Deep proficiency in at least one production language (Java strongly preferred; 5+ years) and working comfort in at least one additional language.
    • You value elegant code that is concise and readable.
    • You'll pick up new tools and codebases as the work demands, and will likely end up working with modern Java, React, TypeScript, Kafka, Redis, GraphQL, Node.js, SentinelOne's own platform, and more.
    • You enjoy writing modern Java (we love lambdas) and prefer composition to inheritance.
    • You're comfortable weighing in on CAP theorem considerations, and are energized by selecting the data structure with the perfect trade-offs for a problem at hand.
  • Domain Familiarity
    • Experience in the cybersecurity domain is strongly preferred. (think SIEM, EDR/XDR, log pipelines, detection engineering, threat hunting, etc.).
  • A Collaborative, Curious, and Practical Mindset
    • You're energized by walking into an unfamiliar codebase and being genuinely useful in a week, and by leading others through the same kind of work.
    • You believe a vague customer request is an interesting technical problem waiting to be reframed, and that "a problem well-stated is half-solved."
    • You can translate between engineers and non-engineers (customers, executives, sales, product, etc.) without losing precision in either direction.
    • You'd rather ship a well-thought-out 80% that solves the real problem than a perfect 100% six weeks late. And you can teach others when to customize for one customer versus producing a general solution.
    • You take mentorship seriously and enjoy seeing other engineers grow in their ability to solve harder problems.
    • You take pride in clear written communication — tickets, design docs, customer runbooks, and executive briefings alike.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

jobs.description:
Head of Growth - Performance Media Buyer & Creative Strategist (eCommerce)

Full-time · Fully remote · Possible equity upside for strong performance

About us

We are Folqs, a fast-growing D2C supplement brand in the United States focused on colostrum + beef organs.

We're looking for a Head of Growth aka killer performance media buyer/creative strategist who is already operating at a high level in eCommerce. This isn't a role for someone who wants to learn how to scale an eCommerce brand. We want someone who has already done it.

Our goal is simple: bring in someone who can jump in, take ownership of our growth engine, and take Folqs to the next level.

What you'll own

  • Paid media: Own and scale Meta as the primary acquisition channel, with additional experience across Google and/or TikTok Paid
  • Creative strategy: Identify winning customer angles, hooks, messaging, formats, and concepts based on performance data and customer research
  • Creative testing: Build and manage a systematic testing pipeline and rapidly identify winning creatives
  • Full-funnel performance: Analyze and optimize the entire journey from ad advertorial/landing page offer conversion
  • Research: Mine customer reviews, surveys, Reddit, competitor ads, Meta Ads Library, and other sources for new angles and opportunities
  • Creative production: Brief and manage UGC creators, editors, and designers - while remaining hands-on with scripts, hooks, copy, and creative direction
  • Performance analysis: Make daily decisions around what to scale, iterate, or kill based on CPA, ROAS, CTR, hook rate, thumbstop rate, CVR, contribution margin, and other relevant metrics
  • Scaling: Take proven creative and media-buying strategies and turn them into significant increases in profitable spend
  • Funnels: Work on advertorials, landing pages, VSLs, offers, and other conversion assets to improve overall acquisition efficiency
  • AI: Use AI aggressively to accelerate research, creative ideation, scripting, production, analysis, and workflows

What success looks like

We don't measure activity; we measure results. This is a 100% performance role focused on scaling spend while maintaining CAC ceiling.

Success means:

  • Scaling paid spend while maintaining healthy unit economics
  • Improving ROAS and reducing CPA
  • Increasing creative win rate and testing velocity
  • Finding new winning angles and audiences
  • Improving conversion rates across the funnel
  • Building a repeatable creative and media-buying system
  • Ultimately, taking Folqs to the next level

You are

  • 4–6+ years of experience creating performance creatives for D2C/eCommerce brands or eCommerce agencies (not B2B, not a generalist)
  • A proven Meta media buyer who has personally scaled campaigns, not just overseen them (at least $50k/month in ad spend)
  • Equally strong on creative strategy and performance marketing
  • Deeply experienced with direct-response advertising and customer psychology
  • Able to look at an ad account, creative performance, and funnel data and immediately identify what needs to change
  • Experienced scaling DTC/eCommerce brands - not B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or general marketing
  • Hands-on with creative: you can write or heavily edit hooks, scripts, headlines, briefs, and landing page copy
  • Experienced managing creative production with UGC creators, editors, and designers
  • An operator, not a consultant. You don't just make recommendations - you execute, test, learn, and scale
  • Comfortable working directly with founders and taking significant ownership with minimal hand-holding
  • AI-native: you use AI daily to accelerate research, creative development, analysis, and execution
  • Fast-moving, highly analytical, and obsessed with finding what works

Strong bonus points

  • Experience scaling supplements, health, wellness, beauty, or other DTC consumer brands
  • Experience with advertorials, VSLs, or aggressive direct-response funnels
  • Experience with TikTok Paid / Spark Ads
  • Experience with Outbrain or Taboola
  • Experience with tools such as Triple Whale, Northbeam, Motion, Foreplay, or similar
  • Strong understanding of FTC/FDA considerations for supplement advertising

Important: Who this role is NOT for

This is not a fit if:

  • You've managed less than $50K/month in ad spend
  • Your background is primarily organic social or influencer marketing
  • You're primarily a creative strategist who doesn't understand media buying
  • You're primarily a media buyer who relies on someone else for all creative strategy
  • You've worked mainly in B2B, SaaS, lead generation, or non-eCommerce environments
  • You're looking for a role where someone else tells you what to do

We want someone who can walk into an eCommerce brand, look at the numbers and the creative, figure out what's broken, and start making it better immediately.

Schedule

  • Fully remote
  • Full-time
  • Minimum 6-hour overlap with US Eastern Time (10:00 AM–4:00 PM ET)
  • Direct collaboration with the founders
  • Significant ownership and autonomy
  • Possible equity upside for strong performance

The Recruiter plays a critical role in ensuring Entegris has the talent needed to meet current and future business demands.   • You have experience with an ATS and HRIS system

More specifically, the Specialist, Human Resources & Talent Acquisition must:

  • Provide administrative and coordination support throughout the employee lifecycle (onboarding, training logistics, contract changes, relocations, offboarding).
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date data in the Human Resources Information System (HRIS) and support employees/managers with first-level inquiries.

Talent Acquisition

  • Manage the full cycle recruiting process from job posting to offer, ensuring a smooth and positive candidate experience.

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

Experience

  • 1–3 years of HR experience, with exposure to both recruitment and HR operations; full-cycle recruitment experience preferred.

Our company

OUR COMPANY

The work environment

In this position, you will be eligible for the following perks:

  • Flexible work schedule

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology and Rheumatology. Based in Montreal, Innovaderm continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

The mission of Patient Access Operations is to facilitate organizational excellence within SmithRx through the delivery of high-impact process improvements, meticulous data and system maintenance, and the flawless execution of operational workflows for our Drug Pathway Engine.

jobs.excerpt: Job Description• The Senior Director, Data & Digital Product Architecture is responsible for designing and industrializing the enterprise’s data and digital product solutions — turning bespoke, one-off work into reusable, production-ready assets built on a centralized, enterprise-agnostic Silver model.
jobs.description:
Job Description

  • The Senior Director, Data & Digital Product Architecture is responsible for designing and industrializing the enterprise’s data and digital product solutions — turning bespoke, one-off work into reusable, production-ready assets built on a centralized, enterprise-agnostic Silver model.
  • This role leads Data Architecture as part of its umbrella, owning the enterprise solution architecture that binds data and digital product capabilities together and weaving AI and automation across modeling and solutioning to compress the modeling cycle that has historically slowed the path to production. The Senior Director directs the design of the scalable, enterprise-agnostic data model and partners closely with Data Engineering, Data Analysis & Products, Digital Product, and Analytics teams to architect reusable solutions and refactor raw work onto governed, shared sources.
  • This role is a critical counterpart to the Data Engineering pillar of the DataOps team. The role provides hands-on leadership across data architecture, solution design, AI-accelerated modeling, product integration, and automation so that architectural intent and engineering investment result in reusable, adopted, and scalable data and digital product assets.

Key Responsibilities

Data Architecture Leadership

  • Lead the Data Architecture function, owning the design of the scalable, flexible, enterprise-agnostic data model that underpins the enterprise medallion architecture.
  • Set architectural direction, standards, and reference models that Data Engineering and Analysis teams build against.
  • Direct the ingestion, structuring, and layering strategy in partnership with IT and Data Engineering to ensure a durable, reusable foundation.

Solution Architecture & Design

  • Own the end-to-end solution architecture that connects data and digital product capabilities to the centralized, enterprise-agnostic medallion architecture models.
  • Design reusable, scalable solution blueprints and reference patterns aligned to the enterprise medallion architecture rather than siloed, point builds.
  • Translate architectural intent into buildable, production-ready solution designs that engineering and product teams can execute against.

AI-Accelerated Modeling & Solution Industrialization

  • Weave AI and automation across modeling and solutioning to compress modeling time — the historic inhibitor to reaching production.
  • Refactor raw, bespoke solutions onto the centralized, agnostic Silver layer so value is captured once and reused many times.
  • Establish repeatable patterns and accelerators that turn learning-stage work into durable, production-ready assets.

Data & Digital Product Integration

  • Integrate data and digital product solutions onto shared, reusable sources, ensuring alignment with the enterprise medallion model rather than siloed builds.
  • Partner with Digital Product and Analytics teams to embed automation and AI into product workflows where combined capabilities produce stronger outcomes.
  • Ensure integrated solutions are designed for reuse across multiple use cases, not bespoke consumption.

Reusability, Standards & Enablement

  • Centralize AI-assisted modeling patterns, templates, and reusable components so every asset compounds the value of the next.
  • Establish standards for how data architecture, solution design, AI, and automation are applied across engineering and solutioning to ensure consistency and scale.
  • Enable Data Engineering and Analysis teams to adopt architectural patterns and automation accelerators effectively within their workflows.

Required Experience & Capabilities

  • Senior leadership experience in data architecture, solution architecture, data modeling, data/analytics solution delivery, automation, or applied AI within an enterprise data environment.
  • Demonstrated experience leading a data architecture function and designing scalable, enterprise-agnostic data models.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and industrializing bespoke or prototype solutions into reusable, production-ready assets.
  • Strong knowledge of medallion architecture (Bronze/Silver/Gold), reusable modeling, and enterprise-agnostic data design.
  • Hands-on understanding of CI/CD pipelines, automated code evaluation, and controlled promotion to production.
  • Proven ability to apply AI and automation to accelerate modeling, integration, and solutioning while preserving quality and governance.
  • Strong communication, influencing, and change leadership skills; experience in complex, regulated enterprises preferred.

Measures of Success

  • The enterprise data model and architecture are scalable, reusable, and consistently adopted across use cases.
  • Solution designs are consistently reusable, scalable, and aligned to the enterprise medallion architecture.
  • Modeling and solution cycle time is measurably reduced through AI and automation.
  • Bespoke and raw solutions are consistently refactored onto reusable, agnostic Silver sources.
  • Data and digital product assets reach production faster through governed, automated pipelines.
  • Acceleration is achieved without compromising governance, quality, or security controls.

    • A healthy, accurately forecasted top-of-funnel pipeline at all times

jobs.description:
Albert's mission is to Digitalize the World of Chemistry, using data and machine learning to drastically accelerate the invention of new materials. Our platform helps R&D organizations achieve a structured data foundation, digitalize their formulation and testing processes, and empower scientists to innovate faster, smarter, and at scale.

About the role

We are looking for an ambitious and results-driven Scientific Solutions Architect to join our growing team. This role is critical to driving successful outcomes for Albert's most strategically important customers, from the fuzzy front end of a deployment through to realized value. You'll bridge the gap between scientific R&D workflows and enterprise digital strategy, acting as a trusted advisor who brings structure to ambiguous environments and champions the customer's long-term success. If you're passionate about cutting-edge technology and thrive in a fast-paced, mission-driven environment, we want to hear from you.

What you'll do

Solution to Value Alignment

  • Serve as the first Albert point of contact in the scientific deployment process, navigating ambiguous customer environments to define scope, surface priorities, and establish a clear path forward before formal delivery begins.
  • Design and deliver complex, enterprise-grade scientific solutions that translate customer R&D workflows into Albert OS, ensuring measurable value at each stage of the customer journey.
  • Act as a trusted scientific advisor to customer executives and technical stakeholders, shaping digital transformation strategy and aligning Albert's capabilities to long-term business goals.
  • Guide customers in mapping legacy tools and workflows into unified data workflows within Albert, including integrations with existing systems.
  • Identify and develop high-impact use cases early in the deployment cycle, translating complex scientific requirements into clear, actionable delivery plans.

Business Case Analysis & Value Capture

  • Collaborate with sales and technical teams to craft compelling business cases, quantifying outcomes tied to cost savings, process efficiency, innovation speed, and risk reduction.
  • Translate customer R&D needs and pain points into actionable technical solutions aligned to business goals, relaying and prioritizing requirements to internal teams to drive timely delivery.
  • Drive platform adoption by demonstrating measurable success in both pre-sales and post-implementation contexts.
  • Partner with R&D and non-R&D customer teams to implement and scale successful pilots and deployments, connecting value to business goals across project types including innovation, product development, product maintenance, and operational excellence.

Sales Support

  • Support enterprise sales by delivering technical presentations, leading exploratory discussions, mapping laboratory workflows to Albert, and constructing architectural and data flow diagrams.
  • Develop presentation materials that emphasize the value of Albert's solutions to customer business needs, and manage key partnership discussions to help shape effective, scalable engagements.
  • Partner with Sales Enablement to provide input on customer engagement strategies that support successful, long-term solution implementation and value alignment.

Leadership & Impact

  • Mentor and develop junior scientific staff, raising the team's capability in both scientific domain knowledge and customer-facing delivery.
  • Represent Albert in strategic customer conversations and technical workshops, acting as the voice of the customer within Albert to help shape product offerings and service delivery.
  • Support change management efforts within customer organizations, guiding stakeholders through the adoption of new digital workflows and ways of working.

You will have

  • Master's degree or higher in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Polymer Science, or a related scientific or engineering discipline.
  • 5+ years of industry experience, preferably in chemical or materials R&D or digital transformation.
  • Experience in front-end innovation, product development, or R&D management, with familiarity moving from concept to market-ready product.
  • Deep understanding of how scientists conduct work across a range of laboratory settings, including familiarity with the systems and tools they rely on daily — such as electronic lab notebooks (ELN), laboratory information management systems (LIMS), inventory management platforms, analytical and process development workflows, and regulatory data systems.
  • Strong background in scientific coding with Python; AWS experience is a plus.
  • Demonstrated ability to engage at the executive level and navigate complex enterprise environments.
  • Proven track record of operating independently in ambiguous, early-stage customer engagements where scope and priorities must be defined from the ground up.
  • Experience leading change management within enterprise customer organizations.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to engage with technical and non-technical audiences alike.
  • Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across teams and time zones.
  • Willingness and ability to travel 30–50% of the time, primarily domestically within the US, to support customer engagements and on-site deployments.

Key competencies

Systems Thinking: Ability to visualize and design how scientific workflows, data systems, and business processes connect — and to bring structure to environments where those connections are not yet defined.

Grit: Self-starter who thrives in startup environments, willing to develop new skills — whether in executive communication, IT scoping, or implementation strategy — in service of the customer outcome.

Empathy: Strong active listening across multiple personas and cultures; able to understand and articulate customer needs at both the bench and the boardroom level.

Leadership: Ability to lead initiatives and drive projects to completion with little or no oversight, including mentoring junior team members and raising overall team capability.

Adaptability: Comfortable operating in dynamic, evolving customer and company environments where priorities shift and playbooks are still being written.

Innovator: Passionate about improving customer outcomes through digital tools and scientific rigor; continuously seeks better ways to deliver and demonstrate value.

Collaboration: Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, building trust and rapport with clients and stakeholders at all levels.

Why Albert?

We have a huge impact. Albert is a growing team with a big reach. Our platform facilitates the invention of materials for tens of thousands of companies and hundreds of thousands of applications — from coatings used on rockets to adhesives used in electric vehicles to 3D printed medical devices. We love distributed teams. Albert's home-base is in the California Bay Area, but we have multiple offices and employees sprinkled around the globe. In fact, over 50% of our employees work outside of California. An international remote culture is in our DNA. We care about you. Albert works hard to create a positive environment for our employees, and we think your life outside of work is important too. We work hard and we play hard. We value diversity. Growing and maintaining our inclusive and diverse team matters to us. We are committed to being a company where our employees feel comfortable bringing their authentic selves to work and have the ability to be successful — every day. We're always looking for humble, sharp, and creative folks to join the Albert team. If you think you might be a fit, please apply.
