WHO WE ARE:

Quartile, the world's largest retail media optimization platform, is a trusted partner for multichannel e-commerce success. Through unmatched expertise and patented AI technology, we fuel growth for 5,300+ brands and sellers worldwide and manage an annual ad spend exceeding $2 billion. The award-winning platform covers major marketplaces and ad channels for optimal reach. The result is unprecedented granularity, smarter budgeting, and bespoke solutions for retailers.

Quartile is proud to be an equal opportunity employer with employees stemming from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. As a business, we value the enrichment that diversity brings to our organization and are committed to a culture that creates a sense of inclusion and belonging. We welcome new perspectives and affirm that all employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, age, familial or marital status, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy, gender identity or expression, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law.

OVERVIEW:

We're looking for a DSP Strategist to join our growing team. In this role you'll be exposed to all facets of the business and encouraged to develop skills both within and beyond your remit, working alongside passionate, high-performing colleagues.

You'll own campaign strategy, launch, management, insights, reporting, and support client-facing communications — including presenting strategies and growing client media investment. The ideal candidate is a flexible team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment, communicates with clarity and confidence, navigates challenging client situations with poise, and applies data-driven decision-making. You'll use data to build compelling narratives that align with our strategies and the growth path we believe each client's business should take.

REQUIREMENTS:

  • 3+ years of experience in digital marketing, retail media, or e-commerce advertising
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with Amazon DSP (broader programmatic/display experience — DV360, Meta, Google Ads — is a plus)
  • 2+ years in a client-facing role, preferably managing small and medium-sized brands
  • Analytical by nature; BI or data-analytics experience is a strong differentiator
  • Fluent written and spoken English

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Certification in Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC), Meta, DV360, Google Ads, or Google Analytics
  • Hands-on experience with Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) for audience building and measurement
  • Experience advising clients on display/programmatic strategy and performance
  • Track record of using data to craft narratives and drive decision-making
  • Experience building reports and presenting them to customers alongside other deliverables
  • Intellectual curiosity and a strong desire to learn and experiment in a rapidly changing industry
  • Experience in a fast-paced, startup environment
  • Background in e-commerce or product-focused advertising

WHAT YOU’LL DO:

This role centers on hands-on account optimization and management. You'll execute strategy adjustments and monitor performance across a substantial portfolio of assigned DSP accounts. Our DSP platform is continuously evolving, and you'll play a pivotal role in shaping it by surfacing feedback and insights from your client work.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Lead assigned accounts. Act as the primary strategist across multiple DSP accounts, managing and monitoring performance while partnering closely with our Customer Strategy Manager (CSM) team to drive client success.
  • Develop media strategies. Create comprehensive media plans that account for seasonality, high- and low-season periods, and key shopping dates. Identify new audience segments and design campaigns that grow client business across the full purchase journey.
  • Execute campaigns. Own the full campaign lifecycle — from initial strategy discussions with clients through campaign development (audience targeting, campaign structure, creative alignment), launch, and ongoing reporting.
  • Optimizeperformance. Analyze account performance to identify optimization opportunities, recommend strategic adjustments, and communicate value to clients. Execute campaign changes per client requests with clear communication of expectations and likely outcomes.
  • Own pacing and retention. Manage monthly spend pacing and account MRR (Monthly Recurring Revenue) retention as core measures of success, delivering consistent results against these key indicators.
  • Supportclient relationships. Attend weekly or bi-weekly customer calls as requested by the CSM, participating in performance recaps, addressing ad hoc requests, and managing follow-ups. For high-churn-risk accounts, actively defend strategy, educate clients on our methodology, and keep them engaged on account progress.
  • Diagnose and communicate. Understand each client's business and goals to formulate account strategy. Diagnose performance issues independently and communicate findings and recommendations with clarity and confidence.
  • Surface insights. Continually capture product and user-experience feedback from client interactions and surface it to internal teams, helping shape the roadmap of Quartile's DSP product based on real client needs.
  • Stay current. Maintain awareness of industry trends and platform updates. Regularly attend Quartile platform trainings and collaborate with product leadership to leverage new capabilities.
  • Contribute to the team. Help train and mentor teammates and influence the development of internal processes and best practices for DSP strategy and execution.

jobs.title: Senior Design Manager - Core Experiences
jobs.excerpt: When Apple developed the original Macintosh, the team wasn’t simply designing a new computer.
jobs.description:
When Apple developed the original Macintosh, the team wasn’t simply designing a new computer. They were establishing a new vocabulary for interacting with one: windows, menus, icons, pointing, dragging, selecting. Many of those ideas existed elsewhere, but the achievement was turning them into a coherent language that people could understand and carry from one application to another.

We’re at another interesting moment in the evolution of interfaces. Software can increasingly understand intent, converse, adapt, anticipate, and act on someone’s behalf. That creates an opportunity to reconsider some of the assumptions that have defined product design for decades.

At Mercury, we want to do more than add AI to interfaces designed for another era. We want to thoughtfully evolve how Mercury feels to use, creating experiences that are intelligent without being inscrutable, proactive without being intrusive, and distinctly Mercury.

You’ll lead the product designers responsible for some of Mercury’s core experiences and establish a point of view for how our interfaces should evolve as the possibilities of software change. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, and Design Systems to turn emerging interaction ideas into coherent, reusable patterns, while building a team known for exceptional product thinking and craft.

Our design organization consists of 40+ people who love solving complex problems through design and are equally passionate about cultivating, guiding, and inspiring one another.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve Mercury’s interaction philosophy, with a particular focus on how AI-native, conversational, adaptive, and proactive experiences should work across our products
  • Set an exceptional bar for product quality across the Interfaces organization, helping teams like mobile, dashboard and our agentic product understand not only whether an experience works, but why it feels right
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of product designers, creating an environment where designers can take creative risks, develop strong points of view, and consistently produce exceptional work
  • Shape product strategy alongside Product and Engineering rather than waiting for requirements to arrive. Bring design into ambiguous problems early and help teams identify the right problems to solve
  • Stay close to the work. Use critique, prototyping, exploration, and hands-on collaboration to push ideas further and help teams turn ambitious concepts into thoughtful, pragmatic experiences
  • Help raise the craft and product-thinking bar of Mercury’s broader Design organization, sharing frameworks, perspectives, and emerging ideas that make everyone around you a stronger designer

You should:

  • Have exceptional product taste: You have unusually strong judgment about how great software should behave and feel. You can move beyond subjective critique to articulate why an interaction works, where it falls short, and how to make it substantially better. You bring strong visual and interaction design fundamentals and inspire a higher standard of craft in others
  • Have a strong point of view on AI-native interfaces: You think deeply about how AI is changing the relationship between people and software. You’re actively experimenting with conversational, adaptive, intelligent, and proactive interaction models and have opinions about where these patterns create genuine value and where they don’t. You don’t need to have spent your career building AI products, but you should be intensely curious about what comes next
  • Be a craft-obsessed design leader: You’ve successfully led and developed product designers without becoming distant from the work. You know how to recognize what makes individual designers exceptional, give clear and thoughtful feedback, and create an environment where a team can experiment boldly while maintaining a very high quality bar
  • Think about interactions as systems: You see beyond individual screens and features to the patterns, information architecture, behaviors, and principles connecting them. You can turn excellent individual solutions into reusable ideas that make the broader Mercury experience more coherent without making it formulaic
  • Be a strategic cross-functional partner: You’re a genuine thought partner to Product and Engineering. You bring design thinking into strategy and roadmap conversations, collaborate comfortably on unfinished work, understand technical constraints, and earn trust through judgment and execution
  • Operate independently with a strong point of view: You thrive when the problem matters but the answer isn’t obvious. You can create structure where none exists, develop a perspective with incomplete information, and move work forward without significant coaching or prioritization. You balance conviction with curiosity and pragmatism and know when a great idea is worth fighting for

Experience designing AI-powered or consumer software, strong prototyping skills, close partnership with Design Systems, or deep motion and interaction expertise would all be especially relevant, but we care more about the quality of your thinking and work than checking every box. These qualifications and the role's emphasis on interaction quality, AI thinking, leadership, independence, and taste come directly from the role profile.

This is an opportunity to help define the future of Mercury’s product experience. You’ll have the autonomy to develop new ideas about how our interfaces should behave, the team to turn those ideas into excellent products, and the opportunity to create interaction patterns that can ultimately influence how Mercury builds software across the company.

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

Mercury values diversity & belonging and is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All individuals seeking employment at Mercury are considered without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other legally protected characteristic. jobs.title: Senior Platform Engineer
jobs.excerpt: Let’s Tango!  Where Innovation Meets Impact. At Tango Analytics, we’re all about helping businesses make smarter decisions through powerful technology, insightful data, and a whole lot of collaboration.
jobs.description:
Let’s Tango! Where Innovation Meets Impact.

At Tango Analytics, we’re all about helping businesses make smarter decisions through powerful technology, insightful data, and a whole lot of collaboration. Whether you are a creative thinker, a strategic planner, a tech wizard, or a customer champion, there's a place for you on our team. We believe work should be meaningful and fun — so if you're ready to make a difference while enjoying the journey, come join us and let's Tango!

We are looking for an Senior Platform Engineer to join our dynamic and growing Platform Engineering team.

Role Summary:

We are building a platform engineering function from the ground up and this role is at the center of it. As a Senior Platform Engineer you will be a founding team member with a clear, three-part mission: fully rearchitect and codify our cloud estate on AWS and Azure, stand up a world-class SRE and observability practice, and build an Internal Developer Platform with golden paths that make shipping software fast, safe, and self-service. This is a high-ownership individual contributor role. You will work directly with the Platform Engineering Manager to translate strategy into production infrastructure, drive adoption across engineering teams, and set the technical bar for how the platform is built and operated.

If you have strong opinions about infrastructure-as-code, love building things other engineers depend on every day, and want genuine end-to-end ownership — this role is for you.

Key Responsibilities:

Cloud Modernization — Rearchitect & Codify

  • Migrate all existing AWS and Azure infrastructure to OpenTofu/Terraform and Ansible; establish module standards, remote state, and GitOps-based plan/apply pipelines — no unmanaged resources
  • Audit the cloud estate against the AWS and Azure Well-Architected Frameworks; produce a remediation backlog and drive it to completion across networking, IAM, landing zones, account structure, and cost governance
  • Implement policy-as-code (OPA/Conftest, AWS SCPs, Azure Policy) to enforce security, tagging, and compliance guardrails at the platform layer — governance embedded, not bolted on
  • Build and maintain reusable Terraform modules for compute (EKS, AKS, EC2), networking, storage, databases, and identity as shared building blocks for all engineering teams
  • Define FinOps standards: tagging taxonomy, cost allocation dashboards, rightsizing recommendations, and reserved capacity planning across both clouds

SRE & Observability

  • Design and implement the full observability stack: metrics (Prometheus/Datadog), logs (Loki/OpenSearch), traces (Tempo/Datadog APM), and dashboards (Grafana) — instrumented end-to-end via OpenTelemetry
  • Define SLIs and SLOs for all platform shared services and critical applications; build error budget dashboards and burn-rate alerting — alert on symptoms, not raw metrics
  • Establish the SRE practice from scratch: incident runbooks, post-incident review templates, and at least one chaos engineering exercise (AWS FIS or equivalent)
  • Partner with engineering teams to instrument their services, define meaningful alerts, and build operational dashboards — reliability is a shared responsibility, not a platform team tax
  • Build capacity planning models for compute and storage so engineering leadership can make data-driven scaling decisions

Internal Developer Platform & Golden Paths

  • Deploy and operate a developer portal (Backstage, GitHub or equivalent) as the single front door: service catalog, scaffolding templates, runbooks, API docs, and on-call ownership all in one place
  • Build and maintain golden paths for the highest-frequency developer workflows: new service creation, Kubernetes deployment, database provisioning, secrets management, and CI/CD pipeline setup - opinionated defaults with escape hatches for legitimate edge cases
  • Own the CI/CD platform layer: standardized pipeline templates (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI), reusable workflow libraries, container image build and scan pipelines, and environment promotion workflows with security scanning (SAST, Snyk) built in by default
  • Own Kubernetes platform operations: EKS and/or AKS cluster lifecycle, Helm chart standards, admission controllers, RBAC, network policies, and service mesh (Istio or Linkerd)
  • Build the self-service provisioning layer — Backstage scaffolder actions and Terraform automation so developers can provision approved resources without raising a ticket
  • Measure adoption and run regular feedback sessions with engineering teams; iterate on golden paths based on real friction, not assumptions

Cross-Cutting Responsibilities

  • Partner with peer managers and teams to plan and support migration of existing workloads onto the platform; provide hands-on migration support, not just documentation
  • Embed security by default across all platform work: IaC scanning (Checkov, tfsec), secrets management (Vault, AWS Secrets Manager, Azure Key Vault), RBAC, and container image hardening
  • Write clear technical documentation, architecture decision records (ADRs), and runbooks; raise the documentation bar for the whole team
  • Mentor and support more junior platform engineers; contribute to architecture reviews and build-vs-buy decisions alongside the Platform Engineering Manager

Required Skills:

  • 5+ years in platform, infrastructure, or DevOps engineering with direct production ownership on AWS and/or Azure
  • IaC: Deep OpenTofu/Terraform proficiency: module authoring, state management, workspace strategy, remote backends, and CI/CD integration; Terramate a plus
  • Kubernetes: Strong Kubernetes operations: EKS and/or AKS cluster lifecycle, Helm, admission controllers, RBAC, network policies, and autoscaling
  • Observability & SRE: Hands-on observability experience with two or more of: Prometheus, Grafana, Loki, Tempo, Datadog, or OpenTelemetry — including SLI/SLO definition and alert engineering
  • CI/CD: CI/CD platform experience: GitHub Actions pipeline authoring, reusable workflow design, and container build/scan pipeline ownership
  • GitOps: GitOps: ArgoCD or Flux for Kubernetes continuous delivery; progressive delivery patterns (canary, blue-green) a strong plus
  • IDP: IDP experience: Backstage or equivalent developer portal, GitHub, scaffolding templates, service catalog design, or self-service provisioning tooling
  • Security: Security-first mindset: policy-as-code, IaC scanning, secrets management, container hardening, and shift- left security practices
  • Strong communication and documentation skills; comfortable presenting architecture decisions to engineering peers and leadership

Nice to Have

  • SRE background: chaos engineering (AWS FIS, Chaos Monkey), error budget management, incident command, and capacity planning
  • Service mesh depth: Istio or Linkerd — mTLS, traffic management, and observability integration
  • FinOps tooling (Kubecost, CloudHealth) and reserved capacity planning experience
  • Familiarity with AI/ML infrastructure basics: LLM API integration or model serving, as the platform will need to support these workloads
  • Certifications: AWS Solutions Architect Associate/Professional, CKA/CKAD, Azure Administrator/Solutions Architect, HashiCorp Terraform Associate
  • Python or Go for platform tooling and CLI development

What We Offer

We’re committed to creating an environment where you can thrive—professionally and personally. Our offerings include:

  • Competitive Compensation We recognize and reward your contributions with a salary package that reflects your value.
  • Comprehensive Benefits Including health, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, and generous paid time off to support your well-being.
  • Flexible Work Environment Whether remote, hybrid, or in-office, we support work arrangements that promote productivity and balance.
  • Inclusive & Collaborative Culture We foster a workplace where diverse perspectives are valued, teamwork is encouraged, and everyone has a voice.

Tango is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, ethnicity, religion, parental status, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, disability, or veteran status.

Base pay offered is contingent on qualifications and other operational considerations. Base pay is just one piece of the full compensation structure offered at Tango. If this pay range is outside of your expectations, we still encourage you to apply and have a conversation with us.

Base pay offered for this position is: $140,000 - $175,000

*Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. for any employer.

*We cannot sponsor employment-based visas at this time.

jobs.excerpt: The CompanyServing the People Who Serve the PeopleGranicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together.
jobs.description:
The Company

Serving the People Who Serve the People

Granicus is driven by the excitement of building, implementing, and maintaining technology that is transforming the Govtech industry by bringing governments and its constituents together. We are on a mission to support our customers with meeting the needs of their communities and implementing our technology in ways that are equitable and inclusive. Granicus has consistently appeared on the GovTech 100 list over the past 5 years and has been recognized as the best companies to work on BuiltIn.

Over the last 25 years, we have served 5,500 federal, state, and local government agencies and more than 300 million citizen subscribers power an unmatched Subscriber Network that use our digital solutions to make the world a better place. With comprehensive cloud-based solutions for communications, government website design, meeting and agenda management software, records management, and digital services, Granicus empowers stronger relationships between government and residents across the U.S., U.K., Australia, New Zealand, and Canada. By simplifying interactions with residents, while disseminating critical information, Granicus brings governments closer to the people they serve—driving meaningful change for communities around the globe.

Want to know more? See more of what we do here.

Job Summary

Granicus is seeking a Cybersecurity Operations Engineer to operate, monitor, and continuously improve the cybersecurity controls protecting a mission-critical SaaS product.

Granicus provides purpose-built cloud technology and services that help government organizations deliver more accessible, effective, and trusted digital experiences for the communities they serve.

As a global organization, Granicus supports customers and operations across North America, the United Kingdom, Europe, Australia, and New Zealand, delivering cloud platforms that power critical digital services for government agencies and public sector organizations worldwide.

The Cybersecurity Operations Engineer will be one of two hands-on individual contributors responsible for preserving the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of a Granicus SaaS product hosted in Amazon Web Services (AWS) and subject to FedRAMP and Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) security requirements. The role will operate endpoint protection, centralized security logging and analytics, vulnerability management, and related cloud security controls; monitor the environment; triage and investigate security events; support incident response; execute operational activities for the Granicus data protection program; and contribute to other cybersecurity initiatives. The position reports to the Cybersecurity Operations Lead within the Global Cyber Defense organization led by the Senior Director, Global Cyber Defense. This role must be based in the United States and must possess or be able to obtain and maintain the personnel screening and access authorization required for CJIS-regulated environments.

What Your Impact Will Look Like

Essential Function

  • Regulated SaaS Security Operations
    • Perform day-to-day security operations and security engineering for the designated SaaS product and its supporting AWS environment.
    • Execute security controls and operating procedures that preserve the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of the product and its data.
    • Apply FedRAMP, NIST SP 800-53, the CJIS Security Policy, and Granicus security requirements in daily operational and technical activities.
    • Complete assigned continuous monitoring, control testing, audit evidence, corrective action, and authorization maintenance activities in partnership with Governance, Risk, and Compliance, Product, Cloud Engineering, Site Reliability Engineering, and system owners.
    • Identify control gaps, configuration deviations, and emerging technical risk; resolve issues within assigned authority and promptly escalate material concerns.
  • Security Platform and Control Operations
    • Operate and maintain endpoint detection and response, centralized security logging and analytics, vulnerability scanning and management, and related cloud security capabilities supporting the product.
    • Verify that in-scope assets are inventoried and monitored, security telemetry is collected and retained, agents and sensors remain healthy, and coverage gaps are corrected.
    • Onboard and maintain security log sources, including parsing, normalization, enrichment, alert routing, retention, access, and data quality.
    • Execute vulnerability scans, validate findings, prioritize risk using exploitability and asset context, coordinate remediation, track exceptions, and verify corrective actions.
    • Build and maintain dashboards and operational reporting for asset coverage, control health, vulnerability exposure, alert trends, response performance, compliance posture, and residual risk.
    • Maintain integrations between security capabilities and cloud, engineering, service management, and collaboration systems to improve data quality, response speed, and operational consistency.
  • Monitoring, Detection, Investigation, and Incident Response
    • Monitor security alerts and telemetry, triage events, manage cases, and ensure assigned work is handled consistently and within established response expectations.
    • Investigate identity, endpoint, network, application, and cloud activity; correlate evidence to determine event scope, impact, root cause, and required action.
    • Develop, test, and tune detections, correlation logic, and investigative queries for threats relevant to the product environment while reducing false positives.
    • Perform or support incident response activities including scoping, evidence preservation, containment, eradication, recovery, root-cause analysis, and corrective action tracking.
    • Execute incident response playbooks, escalation paths, notification procedures, exercises, and post-incident reviews suitable for FedRAMP- and CJIS-regulated operations.
    • Maintain complete, accurate, and auditable investigation records, incident timelines, evidence, decisions, and required reports; participate in after-hours response when required.
  • Operational Readiness and Team Collaboration
    • Work closely with the Cybersecurity Operations Lead and the other Cybersecurity Operations Engineer to provide dependable monitoring, investigation, and incident response coverage.
    • Follow and continuously improve runbooks, operating procedures, quality standards, service metrics, shift handoffs, and escalation practices.
    • Maintain cross-training and backup capability for the team's core responsibilities, take ownership of assigned work, and support teammates during periods of elevated demand.
    • Escalate complex, high-severity, or time-sensitive issues promptly and provide clear technical context, evidence, impact analysis, and recommended actions.
    • Contribute to a culture of technical excellence, sound judgment, collaboration, accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement.
  • Data Protection Program Operations
    • Execute assigned operational activities for the Granicus enterprise data protection program under the direction of the Cybersecurity Operations Lead.
    • Support controls for data discovery, classification, handling, access, encryption, monitoring, retention, and secure disposal across relevant environments.
    • Monitor, triage, and investigate suspected data leakage, misuse, or policy violations in coordination with incident response, Privacy, Legal, and business processes.
    • Maintain data protection workflows, evidence, metrics, dashboards, exception records, and remediation tracking that demonstrate control coverage and effectiveness.
    • Partner with Privacy, Legal, Information Technology, Product, Engineering, and business stakeholders to implement protective controls, manage exceptions, and reduce data risk.
  • AI, Automation, and Continuous Improvement
    • Use approved AI-assisted analysis and automation throughout monitoring, investigations, vulnerability management, data protection, compliance evidence, reporting, and engineering workflows.
    • Automate repetitive activities such as alert enrichment, case creation, evidence collection, asset reconciliation, vulnerability prioritization, notification, and status reporting.
    • Validate AI-generated insights and apply human-in-the-loop safeguards so sensitive data is handled in accordance with security, privacy, customer, and regulatory requirements.
    • Use scripting, APIs, query languages, and workflow orchestration to improve the speed, consistency, scalability, and auditability of security processes.
    • Propose, test, document, and measure improvements to detections, tooling, workflows, and controls based on operational outcomes, reliability, and controlled risk.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Cybersecurity Projects
    • Partner with Product, Engineering, Cloud, Compliance, Privacy, and business teams supporting the designated SaaS product and data protection program.
    • Provide practical security input for architecture decisions, platform changes, releases, remediation plans, risk decisions, and customer assurance activities.
    • Communicate findings, incident status, priorities, tradeoffs, and program performance clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Support other cybersecurity projects and operational activities as assigned by the Cybersecurity Operations Lead or Senior Director, Global Cyber Defense.

You Will Love This Job If You Have

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Distinguished Architect, you will be tasked with anchoring our federated enterprise architecture function and serving as a horizontal connector across IT, enterprise applications, enterprise AI, and Security, and all related delivery functions. You will set the standards, forums, and tools that enable embedded delivery teams to design consistent, high-quality solutions without centralizing design authority. Your goal is to create the conditions for consistent architecture, acting as a standard-setter and facilitator rather than a bottleneck.

What Will You Do?

  • Own and publish the quarterly organization-wide technology radar detailing approved, trial, and retiring technologies.
  • Chair the monthly Architecture Review Board (ARB) to provide a feedback forum for cross-cutting decisions.
  • Run the Architecture Community of Practice across all embedded architects across the four delivery functions.
  • Own the Architecture Decision Record (ADR) process, define review thresholds, and maintain the shared repository.
  • Develop and publish AI architecture blueprints—pre-approved patterns teams can adopt—in partnership with Enterprise Data & AI.
  • Define organization-wide architecture standards including API design, data classification handling, identity integration, and security-by-design.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

  • Extensive experience in enterprise architecture, specifically operating in a federated or embedded architectural model.
  • Proven ability to lead Architecture Review Boards (ARB) and foster a Community of Practice.
  • Deep understanding of architecture standards spanning API design, identity integration, and security-by-design.
  • Technical experience developing AI architecture blueprints and managing technology radars.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

jobs.description:
Experience: 5+ years in Platform Engineering, Infrastructure, DevOps or Site Reliability Engineering.

About the Role

We are building an Internal Developer Portal at Natera, and we are looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to help build it. This is a hands-on software engineering role: you will write the portal, the golden paths that run on it, and the integrations underneath, not just configure someone else’s tooling.

It is a genuine build, but not a blank page. A great deal of capability is already in production, reached today through hand-triggered GitLab pipelines, purpose-built internal UIs and wiki pages that carry the steps and the caveats. A significant part of this role is bringing that capability into the portal as first-class golden paths, re-envisioned rather than wrapped. A new interface over an old workflow does not get adopted. You will join an established Infrastructure Provisioning team inside a larger Platform Engineering organization, building alongside the engineers delivering it and working with the senior engineers who set technical direction.

Success is measured by one thing above all others: Developer adoption.

What You'll Do

Build the Internal Developer Portal

  • Platform Foundation: Contribute to the implementation of the portal platform, then take a major hand in developing and operating it as a product with real users, measured adoption and a roadmap.
  • Service Catalog: Build a reliable system of record for our services and infrastructure, with ownership, relationships, and automated ingestion from source-of-truth systems rather than manual upkeep. A catalog nobody trusts is a catalog nobody uses.
  • Integrations and Extensibility: Build the integrations that connect the portal to our cloud accounts, CI/CD systems, secrets management and internal APIs, and help document the patterns so other engineers can contribute integrations of their own.

Build Golden Paths, and Help Others Build Theirs

  • Work Within the Framework: Help shape the golden path framework and build within it, using the templates, scaffolding, standards and guardrails the team defines, with networking, security, observability and compliance pre-wired in so every path inherits them.
  • Build the Provisioning Paths: Be one of the main builders of the Infrastructure Provisioning golden paths. They are also the reference implementations other teams copy, so the quality of your work sets what others follow.
  • Support Other Teams: Many golden paths will be built by the teams that own the domain. Help them do that well through worked examples, documentation, pairing and reviewing their contributions.
  • Incorporate What Exists: Reimagine today’s pipelines, internal UIs and documented procedures as portal-native journeys, some built here, many by the owning teams. Start from how they are actually used, not how they are written up.
  • Retire the Old Path: Work with the teams who built these tools, since their buy-in decides whether a path is used or bypassed and they are often the right owners of the replacement. Decommission what it supersedes so the platform gets simpler over time.
  • AI-native Platform: Help make the platform readable by AI coding agents as well as people, with structured metadata, documented interfaces and tooling agents can consume, so AI-assisted development meets Natera standards by default.

Drive Adoption

  • Adoption First: Prove the first golden paths against real high-frequency workflows, support teams through onboarding, and prioritize on measured friction rather than preference.
  • Measurable Standards: Help build the scorecards that make platform and compliance expectations visible, and work with consuming teams to close the gaps they surface.

What You Bring

  • Platform Expertise: 5+ years in platform engineering, infrastructure, DevOps or SRE, including work on shared services used by more than one team. Solid AWS (IAM, multi-account, EKS), Terraform and Kubernetes, and experience building reusable CI/CD pipelines.
  • Software Engineering: Strong programming ability in at least one modern language. You build and maintain production software with the testing, review and operational discipline that implies, not just scripts and configuration.
  • Portal or Transferable Experience: Experience building or extending an internal developer portal, developer platform or comparable self-service tooling. Failing that, closely transferable automation experience plus clear motivation to take this on.
  • Improving What Exists: Experience turning scattered internal capability into something more coherent and self-service, and the judgement to see when a workflow should be redesigned rather than wrapped in a new interface.
  • Application Engineering: TypeScript and React, or equivalent application development experience in another modern language and framework. Prior exposure to this specific stack is not required. A strong engineer from another ecosystem who demonstrably picks up unfamiliar languages and frameworks quickly is equally well suited.
  • Ownership Within a Team: You take a feature or workstream from design through to production and support it afterwards. You ask for input early, give useful code review, and work well with the teams whose systems you are changing.
  • AI-Native Practice: Fluent day-to-day use of AI coding assistants and agentic tooling, interest in agent-accessible protocols such as MCP, and sound judgement about where AI accelerates platform work and where it does not.
  • Platform as a Product: Treating internal engineers as customers, caring about adoption, and working in a regulated environment where change control, access review and audit evidence are encoded into automation rather than process.
  • Communication: Clear writing. Design documents, ADRs and operational documentation others can act on.

Bonus Points

  • Hands-on experience with tools like Backstage or Port: catalog modelling, templating and scaffolding, custom actions, plugin development.
  • Experience migrating or consolidating established internal tooling onto a common platform, including the deprecation work that follows.
  • Docs-as-code systems such as TechDocs and MkDocs, and platform search integration.
  • Operating a stateful web application in production (PostgreSQL, schema migrations, caching), and internal-platform authN/authZ with an external identity provider.
  • Contributions to open-source platforms or developer-experience projects.

Natera™ is a global leader in cell-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women’s health, and organ health. jobs.description:
Waymo is an autonomous driving technology company with the mission to be the world's most trusted driver. Since its start as the Google Self-Driving Car Project in 2009, Waymo has focused on building the Waymo Driver—The World's Most Experienced Driver™—to improve access to mobility while saving thousands of lives now lost to traffic crashes. The Waymo Driver powers Waymo’s fully autonomous ride-hail service and can also be applied to a range of vehicle platforms and product use cases. The Waymo Driver has provided over ten million rider-only trips, enabled by its experience autonomously driving over 100 million miles on public roads and tens of billions in simulation across 15+ U.S. states.

The Software Quality Operations (SWQOPS) team is at the heart of ensuring the safety, reliability, and quality of the Waymo Driver. Our mission is to build an adaptable and scalable operation, increasingly powered by AI, to deliver the crucial insights necessary to confidently deploy and grow Waymo's autonomous vehicle service.

Waymo is experiencing unprecedented growth, rapidly expanding into new cities and launching new vehicle platforms. SWQOps, particularly our TechnicalSpecialists, are critical to this expansion, enabling us to scale safely and efficiently.

Why this team is Essential to Waymo's Success:

In this role you will:

  • Partner with Engineering to design, test, and deploy cutting-edge Machine Learning (ML) and Generative AI (Gen-AI) models and tools to drive step-change improvements in issue discovery & detection, triage efficiency, and quality assurance.
  • Leverage AI-powered insights and traditional triage signals to proactively identify emerging on-road issue trends, new risk scenarios, and edge cases. Develop and refine data-driven strategies for issue discovery and monitoring, enhanced by ML model outputs
  • Serve as the key link between AI/ML development and operational execution. Define and document new policies, guidelines, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) that integrate AI tools and insights into daily vendor workflows.

Requirements

MarketPro has partnered with a multi-billion-dollar global leader in corporate payments and expense management in the search for its next Chief Product Officer. This executive will lead the transformation of the company’s Spend Management division into a world-class, software-led platform—combining exceptional scale, proprietary data, broad distribution, and sophisticated payments infrastructure with intuitive customer experiences, rapid innovation, and intelligent automation.

Build the product engine that defines the next era of business spend.

This is an enterprise-level build mandate for a technical, customer-obsessed product executive who can translate ambitious ideas into elegant software, establish a modern product operating model, and enable teams to prototype, learn, and deliver at exceptional speed.

The Opportunity

A multi-billion-dollar, publicly traded global leader in corporate payments and expense management serves hundreds of thousands of business customers worldwide. Strong growth and an accelerating strategic focus on corporate payments and spend management create a highly visible opportunity to combine exceptional scale, proprietary data, broad distribution, and sophisticated payments infrastructure with a best-in-class software experience.

Within the Spend Management division, the company brings commercial cards, accounts payable automation, expense workflows, controls, reconciliation, mobile capabilities, and reporting together across an integrated product portfolio. The next chapter is to unify these capabilities around a modern, AI-powered platform that finance teams and employees genuinely prefer to use.

The Leadership Mandate
  • Set a category-defining product vision.Create a differentiated, multi-year strategy that anticipates customer needs, establishes new sources of value, and positions the company among the most innovative B2B fintech and spend-management platforms.
  • Make software experience a competitive advantage.Champion a simple, coherent, and highly intuitive user experience across web and mobile—reducing friction for finance teams, employees, administrators, and partners.
  • Build a high-velocity product operating model.Establish the rituals, decision rights, architecture partnership, and metrics that enable rapid prototyping, frequent releases, disciplined learning, and reliable delivery.
  • Embed AI into the product—and the way products are built.Identify practical, high-value applications of AI across automation, controls, reconciliation, insights, fraud prevention, service, and product-development workflows.
  • Connect product choices to enterprise value.Own a product portfolio and roadmap measured by customer adoption, retention, revenue, margin, speed, and strategic differentiation.

What You Will Own
  • Define and communicate the end-to-end product vision, strategy, portfolio priorities, and roadmap for the Spend Management division.
  • Translate customer problems, market shifts, competitive dynamics, and the company’s distinctive assets into focused product bets with clear business cases.
  • Lead the evolution toward a unified, scalable SaaS platform spanning expense management, commercial cards, accounts payable automation, mobile workflows, controls, and analytics.
  • Partner deeply with engineering leadership on platform architecture, technical trade offs, delivery capacity, quality, security, and the transition from third-party support to durable internal product-engineering capability.
  • Create an AI product agenda that improves customer outcomes and operational leverage while applying appropriate governance, data discipline, and risk controls.
  • Raise the standard for product discovery, design, UX research, experimentation, prototyping, roadmap governance, and release management.
  • Establish a transparent product scorecard spanning activation, engagement, adoption, retention, customer satisfaction, delivery velocity, quality, revenue contribution, and profitability.
  • Work across sales, operations, technology, finance, marketing, risk, compliance, and service to ensure product strategy becomes coordinated execution and compelling customer value.
  • Develop a strong point of view on build, buy, partner, and integrate decisions; contribute product leadership to M&A evaluation and integration where relevant.
  • Represent the product vision with executive leadership, strategic customers, partners, and the broader market.

Build the Organization

The CPO will inherit a small, capable product team and expand it thoughtfully from approximately 5–7 to 10–15 people. The mandate is to elevate and enable the existing organization while adding the critical product, design, analytics, and technical-product capabilities required for the next stage.

  • Clarify roles, decision rights, career paths, and standards of excellence across product management, product ownership, design, and product operations.
  • Recruit builders who combine technical fluency, customer empathy, commercial instinct, and a bias for action.
  • Create a culture where teams challenge assumptions, combine data with bold judgment, and move from insight to shipped value quickly.
  • Coach leaders and individual contributors to think beyond incremental features and solve the underlying customer and business problem.

Benefits

The Executive We Are Seeking

The strongest candidate will bring an engineering-first foundation or deep technical fluency, paired with a record of helping a disruptive B2B software company create new market value and out-innovate established competitors. Relevant backgrounds may include a CPO, Head of Product, product-oriented CTO, former software architect, or engineering leader who has successfully advanced into enterprise product leadership. Experience building exceptional software products, operating with speed, and translating technology into commercial advantage will be central to success.

Experience and Qualifications
  • Approximately 15+ years of progressive experience across product, software engineering, architecture, or adjacent technical leadership, including significant ownership of enterprise B2B software products.
  • A record of building or reinventing SaaS platforms with exceptional UI/UX, strong customer adoption, and measurable commercial impact.
  • Demonstrated success operating in high-growth or disruptive environments where teams prototype rapidly, ship frequently, and learn directly from customer behavior.
  • Technical depth sufficient to engage credibly on architecture, APIs, data, integrations, platform scalability, security, quality, and engineering tradeoffs.
  • Practical experience applying AI to customer-facing products and/or the product-development lifecycle; able to separate meaningful value creation from novelty.
  • Experience scaling product organizations and attracting high-caliber product, design, and technical talent while strengthening an existing team.
  • Strong business judgment, including the ability to connect roadmap and investment decisions to revenue, retention, economics, customer value, and competitive advantage.
  • Enterprise product experience involving complex workflows, permissions, controls, integrations, analytics, or regulated environments. Payments or fintech expertise offers added context, while success in disruptive B2B software environments provides the essential foundation.

Leadership Characteristics
  • Builder’s mindset.Energized by creating the team, operating systems, product strategy, and capabilities required to accelerate growth.
  • Sharp and unconventional.Forms independent, data-backed points of view and is willing to challenge comfortable assumptions.
  • Technically credible.Earns the confidence of engineers while keeping technology choices anchored in customer and business outcomes.
  • Customer obsessed.Looks past feature requests to understand workflows, friction, behavior, and unmet needs.

jobs.excerpt: COMPANY OVERVIEWDoes the idea of applying your talents at a company that assists people in understanding how to obtain additional health care benefits and compensates well for doing so, inspire you?
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Does the idea of applying your talents at a company that assists people in understanding how to obtain additional health care benefits and compensates well for doing so, inspire you? We call it “Doing good while doing well” and invite you to apply to join us and begin moving forward along a beneficial career path – one built on providing solutions by helping others navigate through the complex world of health care benefits.

Here at BeneLynk, our mission is to improve lives and positively impact social determinants of health barriers by providing our healthcare partners with the information they need, and people with the advocacy they deserve. We are laser-focused on our longstanding area of expertise in the healthcare world. We fully understand barriers and surface solutions, then provide the advocacy that changes lives and improves outcomes. Everything we do, from the systems we build, to our government relations, to our outreach operations, is in service of this one central vision.

WHO WE ARE

We are big-hearted people, passionate about serving our health plan clients, their members, and each other. We are a team in every sense of the word, striving toward a common mission – that is the goal of everyone at BeneLynk. Every day, we are relentless in helping people who need essential resources to make their lives easier and healthier. The members we serve call us "miracles," "kind," "professional," "human," and "compassionate," and all with "service that gets the job done." We pride ourselves on creating a healthy environment for our employees to thrive in their ability to assist others.

UI/UX PRODUCT DESIGNER

POSITION SUMMARY

Benelynk is building the technology platform that powers Veteran Directed Care (VDC), a VA program that gives veterans the flexibility to direct their own long-term in-home care, including hiring and managing their own caregivers. We are looking for a UI/UX Designer to be the connective tissue between the people who use this platform and the engineers who build it.

BeneLynk’s Engagement Advocates engage Veteran’s enrolled in VA’s Veteran Directed Care (VDC) to help ensure that the Veteran has the tools and support needed to coordinate the care they need at home. These Advocates/Agents utilize an internal and proprietary platform (i.e., Veteran choose) to guide them through the process from onboarding, caregiver engagement, time submission/approval, payroll and reporting. This platform is designed to support BeneLynk Enrollment Advocate; however, it also has a self-service module to enable the Veteran, Case Manager, and the Direct Care Worker to access the system directly to perform the functions they require and to access their unique actions and reports. This role owns the process of turning the “voice of the user” — veterans, family caregivers, Direct Care Workers, Enrollment Advocates (case managers), and partner agencies (ADNAs) — along with input from subject matter experts, internal stakeholders, and engineering, into clear wireframes and interactive prototypes. These wireframes/prototypes will be rapidly created through the intersection of research (Outside In and Inside Out), useability expertise and the use current tools (e.g., AI, Claude, Figma). At BeneLynk, this role is a key to address usability issues and to proactively design an intuitive user experience within an Agile development process, collaborating with leadership to define and execute on its strategic vision. Because this platform serves veterans (many of whom are elderly or non-technical), family caregivers, professional Direct Care Workers, and internal operations staff, this role requires designing distinct, appropriately simple experiences for several very different audiences within a single connected system.

The candidate hired for this position will be both strategist and tactician. At BeneLynk we know that innovation does not come without rolling up our sleeves and getting the work done. The UI/UX Product Designer will be an integral piece in driving efficiency to executing existing product development processes/priorities and bringing new products to market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Represent BeneLynk’s Customers: This function is listed first, because we always want to be thinking of how best to serve our internal and external customers.
  • Oversee Product Development:The UI/UX Product Designer will work with the Operations team, development team, sales team, and all other appropriate stakeholders to prioritize and deliver solutions on time.
  • Set Product Strategy:In conjunction with the senior management team, the Product Owner and Veteran Choose team, the UI/UX Product Designer will inform and help to define the product strategy for the company.
  • To accomplish this goal, the Designer will need to develop and maintain excellent working relationships with the Product Owner and the heads of relevant departments within BeneLynk and maintain a deep and current understanding of the work of such departments.
  • The UI/UX Product Designer will be expected to challenge other members of the management team, to ask the difficult questions and execute with disciple that will lead to more rapid innovation.
  • Anticipate Opportunities:The UX Product Designer will be responsible for developing and maintaining a cutting edge understanding intuitive design principles as well as all the industries that BeneLynk touches. The Designer will use this knowledge to bring new products to market.

This position is both tactical and strategic reflecting the small, but growing, size of BeneLynk as a company. All of us, including our senior management team are on the front-line doing what needs to be done to establish BeneLynk as the nation’s financial management services for Veterans.

Additional Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Partner with subject matter experts and internal stakeholders to translate complex program rules — eligibility, service authorizations, budgets, timesheets, payroll, and compliance — into workflows that are simple and error-resistant for end users.
  • Produce user flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes using a combination of standard design tools and AI-assisted design/prototyping tools, applying design judgment to refine AI-generated output into production-ready, on-brand designs.
  • Facilitate design-alignment workshops and structured reviews with product, engineering, compliance, and operations stakeholders to drive the team to consensus on system design and resolve open questions quickly.
  • Translate approved designs into detailed, developer-ready specifications, interaction notes, and edge-case documentation so engineering can build directly from your artifacts with minimal back-and-forth.
  • Design and maintain a consistent design system and component library used consistently across all user-facing roles and modules of the platform.
  • Plan and conduct user research (interviews, contextual inquiry, usability testing) with veterans, family caregivers, Direct Care Workers, Enrollment Advocates, and partner agency staff, and synthesize findings into clear personas, journey maps, and problem statements.
  • Design for accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA or higher) as a baseline requirement, given the platform's elderly, low-tech, and non-native-English-speaking user populations.
  • Run usability testing on new and existing flows, and iterate designs based on user feedback, support/complaint themes, and product analytics.
  • Maintain clear documentation of design decisions and rationale to support audit readiness and compliance traceability (e.g., HIPAA, VA program requirements).
  • Stay embedded with engineering through implementation, reviewing built screens against design intent and resolving fidelity gaps.

Required Skills/Abilities/Experience:

  • Bachelors/Associates degree and 2 - 5+ years in healthcare with 5+ years in UI/UX Product Design
  • Experience in Agile business/software development lifecycle process and methodologies.
  • Excellence in the integration of expertise and experience with the use current tools (e.g., AI, Claude, Figma) to rapidly build wireframes and prototypes
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills
  • End user workflow experience.
  • Excellent Interpersonal and relationship management skills
  • Strong judgment and decision-making skills
  • Strong leadership and problem-solving skills
  • Adaptability, communication, empathy, problem-solving and teamwork. As a UI/UX designer, it’s important that you can collaborate effectively with those around you—from clients and stakeholders to developers and fellow designers, all the way through to the end user.

PreferredSkills/Abilities/Experience

  • Value based care providers and related entities

Physical Requirements:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time.
  • Must have a stable internet connection.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is a remote position.

POSITION TYPE/ EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK

Full-time/Exempt – This is a salaried position

SALARY

Based on Experience; Up to $150k annually

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

We offer competitive salaries and benefits here at BeneLynk, as we truly value our employees and the amazing work that they do each day. Please see below for a list of some of our awesome employee benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Employee Assistant Program Benefits
  • 401K Match
  • 15 Paid Days Annually
  • Excellent Growth & Advancement Opportunities

EMPLOYEE PERKS

Work hard, play hard!Having an engaged workforce and positive work environment is one of our top priorities here at BeneLynk. We do so through numerous initiatives that can be found below. We like to call our virtual work community, “The Bene-Verse”. We also have an internal Culture Ambassador committee dedicated to ensuring all employees have a pleasant and exciting work experience.

  • Monthly Company Town Hall Events:We love the opportunity to come together as a company. Join us monthly as we discuss exciting company updates, internal promotions, internal awards, upcoming events, and more!
  • Monthly Internal Mental Health Newsletters:Our Culture Ambassadors spearhead an internal newsletter centered on mental health topics. Our employees’ overall wellbeing is our top priority, so we like to provide support whenever it is needed through this uplifting internal newsletter.
  • Monthly Streaming Services Perk:Yes- we pay YOU to enjoy the television shows that you enjoy! We pay up to a $12 per month for any streaming service subscriptions that you currently have.
  • Tickets at Work Perk:Enjoy discounted movie tickets, hotel stays, and more through our company’s ‘Tickets at Work’ perk!
  • Monthly Lunch & Learn Events:Meet key members of our Senior Management team through engaging Lunch & Learn sessions on a monthly basis. Lunch is on us for those employees that sign up!
  • Monthly Bene-Verse Events:We put on awesome monthly events for our employees including virtual trivia, team building exercises, guided painting sessions, and more!

EEO STATEMENT

At BeneLynk, we don’t just accept differences; we celebrate, support, and thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our products, and the communities that we serve. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling this company’s unwavering commitment to equal employment opportunity. BeneLynk is an equal opportunity employer, and as such, employment here is solely based on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to their professional expertise.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any preemployment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR team.

E-VERIFY

BeneLynk participates in E-Verify. We will provide the U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employer’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

Associate Managing Editor

Job Purpose

The Associate Managing Editor is responsible for the end-to-end management and development of assigned journals, ensuring timely publication, operational excellence, and strong stakeholder engagement. The role works closely with editors, authors, reviewers, societies, and internal teams to support journal growth, publication quality, indexing objectives, and overall portfolio performance.

Key Responsibilities

Journal & Portfolio Management

  • Manage the end-to-end publication process for assigned journals, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of issues.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for journal-related operational matters and escalations.

  • Coordinate closely with editors, editorial boards, authors, reviewers, and internal stakeholders to ensure efficient journal operations.

  • Ensure a seamless transition of newly acquired journals from the acquisitions stage to editorial management.

  • Monitor publishing schedules and proactively address delays to maintain publication timelines.

Stakeholder Management

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with journal editors, authors, reviewers, society partners, and internal teams.

  • Liaise regularly with Sage India, UK, and US colleagues to address editorial, production, and operational requirements.

  • Provide high-quality service and support to editors, societies, and contributors.

Journal Development & Performance

  • Identify opportunities to enhance journal performance, visibility, and impact.

  • Work closely with editors on manuscript flow, turnaround times, editorial planning, and publication strategies.

  • Drive initiatives related to journal indexing, abstracting, Impact Factor acquisition, and overall portfolio growth.

  • Educate and guide editors on indexing criteria, citation performance, and Impact Factor improvement strategies.

  • Identify and implement journal-specific development plans to improve performance and reach.

Marketing & Promotion

  • Collaborate with the Marketing team to develop and execute journal-specific promotional activities, including:

    • Call for Papers campaigns

    • Impact Factor announcements

    • Special Issue promotions

    • Article-level marketing initiatives

    • Conference and event promotional support

Reporting & Analysis

  • Prepare and present journal performance reports and publisher reports for internal and external stakeholders.

  • Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) and operational metrics.

  • Maintain accurate journal records, reports, and portfolio documentation.

  • Prepare personal performance reports aligned with departmental objectives.

Contract & Business Management

  • Support drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and managing journal contract renewals and addenda.

  • Develop an understanding of publishing business models and contractual frameworks.

  • Support onboarding, maintenance, and renewal of new publishing products and content solutions.

Continuous Improvement

  • Stay updated on industry developments, publishing trends, and emerging technologies.

  • Contribute to process improvements and operational excellence initiatives.

  • Work independently to achieve departmental objectives while escalating issues appropriately when required.

Key Accountabilities

  • Effective management of assigned journal portfolios.

  • Delivery of publication schedules and service-level commitments.

  • Enhanced journal visibility through indexing and abstracting achievements.

  • Strong stakeholder satisfaction and relationship management.

  • Accurate reporting and performance tracking.

  • Successful implementation of journal development initiatives.

  • Compliance with publishing standards, contracts, and internal policies.

Skills, Qualifications & Experience

Essential Qualifications

  • Postgraduate degree in Life Sciences, Medical Sciences, Publishing, or a related discipline.

Experience

  • 2-3 years of experience in scholarly journal publishing within an editorial or journal management environment.

  • Experience managing journals throughout the publication lifecycle.

  • Hands-on experience with journal development activities, indexing applications, and editorial workflows.

Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of:

    • Scholarly publishing processes

    • Peer review management

    • Journal management and development

    • Publishing contracts and business models

    • Abstracting and Indexing (A&I) databases

    • Impact Factor and journal performance metrics

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly:

    • Excel

    • PowerPoint

    • Outlook

    • Teams

    • SharePoint

  • Experience with peer review management systems is preferred.

Competencies

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.

  • Analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

  • High attention to detail and organizational skills.

  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced publishing environment.

Success Measures

  • Timely publication of assigned journals.

  • Improved journal performance and indexing outcomes.

  • High editor, author, reviewer, and society satisfaction.

  • Achievement of departmental and individual KPIs.

  • Effective management of journal portfolios and stakeholder relationships.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion

At Sage we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive team that is representative of all sections of society and to sustaining a culture that celebrates difference, encourages authenticity, and creates a deep sense of belonging. We welcome applications from all members of society irrespective of age, disability, sex or gender identity, sexual orientation, color, race, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief as creating value through diversity is what makes us strong.  As a business and as an organization with an increasingly agile workforce, we're open to flexible working arrangements where appropriate.

We are seeking an experienced PeopleSoft PeopleTools Developer responsible for the architecture, installation, configuration, upgrade, and ongoing technical operation of enterprise PeopleSoft environments. In this role you will own the technical backbone of the PeopleSoft platform — including PeopleTools upgrades, image applications, security configurations, search server operations, and integration with cloud and middleware platforms. The ideal candidate will combine deep PeopleTools and PeopleSoft administration experience with strong fundamentals in Oracle database, Linux/Unix, and modern DevOps practices. In this role you will work closely with cross-functional partners — product, design, engineering, operations, and business stakeholders — to translate ambiguous requirements into well-engineered solutions, and will be expected to raise the bar through code review, design review, and mentorship of more junior engineers. The successful candidate brings strong engineering discipline, a clear communication style, and a track record of shipping meaningful work that holds up well in production.

  • Install, configure, and operate PeopleSoft environments across development, test, training, and production.
  • Lead PeopleTools upgrades, PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM) image applications, and patch deployments.
  • Manage application servers, process schedulers, web servers (WebLogic), and the integration broker gateway.
  • Administer Elasticsearch / OpenSearch (or Verity legacy) deployments supporting PeopleSoft search.
  • Perform PeopleSoft system copies, refreshes, and clones across environments, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Implement and tune database connectivity, including Oracle Database administration tasks in partnership with DBA teams.
  • Configure PeopleSoft security at the application, web, and infrastructure layers.
  • Operate PeopleSoft Cloud Manager or equivalent automation tooling where applicable.
  • Design and operate HA/DR strategies for PeopleSoft environments, applying disciplined engineering practices and partnering closely with stakeholders to ensure outcomes are durable, well-documented, and aligned with broader team and platform standards.
  • Develop automation tooling using shell, Python, or Ansible to reduce operational toil.

  • Provide hands-on post-go-live and hypercare support, working closely with operations teams to triage incidents quickly, identify root causes, and drive durable fixes that improve long-term system stability.
  • Maintain comprehensive, current technical documentation — including architecture diagrams, design decisions, configuration references, runbooks, and operational procedures — so that the system remains supportable, auditable, and easy to onboard new engineers onto over time.
  • Mentor and coach junior and mid-level engineers through code review, design review, pair programming, and structured knowledge sharing, helping the broader team grow in technical maturity and confidence over time.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Five or more years of PeopleSoft PeopleTools administration experience.
  • Hands-on experience with PeopleTools upgrades and PeopleSoft Update Manager (PUM).
  • Strong experience with WebLogic, Tuxedo, and PeopleSoft application/process scheduler servers.
  • Experience administering Elasticsearch / OpenSearch in support of PeopleSoft.
  • Working knowledge of Oracle Database administration.
