Role Title: 360° Video Recorder (Insta360 / GoPro MAX)

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging 360° Video Recorders (Insta360 / GoPro MAX) to contribute to a customer's project by capturing immersive, high-quality footage with leading 360° camera equipment. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

We are looking for individuals to collect video of themselves performing natural, everyday activities across a variety of indoor, outdoor, and vehicle environments.

Collection may include third-person recordings of everyday activities as well as vehicle navigation tasks.

Camera Requirements

You must already own or have access to a compatible camera with:

- A minimum 170° field of view (FOV)

- A minimum recording resolution of 720p

Compatible camera examples include:

  • Insta360 X3, X4, X5, X6

- DJI Osmo 360

  • GoPro MAX, MAX2
  • Other action or 360° cameras that meet the minimum 170° FOV and 720p requirements

Mounting Equipment

You do not need to already own the required mounting equipment to apply.

Depending on the task, you may need:

  • A rigid backpack, harness, or similar third-person mounting rig with an extension arm or pole
  • A secure vehicle camera mount for vehicle navigation recordings

Already owning a compatible backpack or vehicle mount is a plus and may allow you to begin collecting sooner.

Reasonable equipment costs for required mounting hardware may be reimbursed.

Examples of compatible third-person mounting rigs include:

  • Insta360 Third-Person Backpack Mount and other harness-mounted extension system

Third-Person Camera Setup

The camera must be:

- Mounted above and behind you

- Angled slightly downward

  • Positioned far enough back to keep your entire body consistently visible
  • Stable enough to maintain the required third-person perspective during normal movement

If using a camera with less than 360° FOV, the mounting setup must position the camera far enough away to keep your entire body in frame while also capturing the surrounding environment.

Your full body should remain visible throughout normal movement without frequently leaving the frame.

Handheld selfie sticks, chest mounts, shoulder clips, and stationary tripods do not meet the required third-person perspective.

Expected Recording Tasks may include:

- Natural everyday activities

- Indoor and outdoor activities

  • Walking and moving through different environments
  • Vehicle navigation and driving-related recordings
  • Other similar real-world activities provided in the collection instructions

For vehicle navigation tasks, the camera must be securely mounted to the vehicle.

Recording Requirements

  • Capture a variety of activities and environments
  • Each continuous clip must be at least 60 seconds long

- Record at a minimum resolution of 720p

  • Follow the required camera position for each assigned task
  • Keep the relevant activity and surrounding environment consistently visible
  • Follow all provided recording and safety instructions

Compensation

jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

ArsenalOS is Anduril's unified production systems platform — the digital backbone for our manufacturing operations spanning PLM, MES, WMS, and supply chain systems. We're building modern, integrated solutions that enable us to scale hardware production with software velocity.

In the ArsenalOS future state, users will not experience the lifecycle as disconnected silos. A design change will propagate into the bill of materials, planning systems, work instructions, quality workflows, and supplier-facing systems with minimal lag. A production issue will immediately surface to the teams responsible for design, manufacturing, supplier performance, and sustainment. Field signals will flow upstream fast enough to influence the next build of a product, not the next quarterly review. ArsenalOS will turn the Build Chain into a continuous learning system.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are looking for a experienced Senior PLM Software Engineer with strong Teamcenter expertise to join the ArsenalOS PLM team. As a PLM Software Engineer on ArsenalOS, you will be architecting and implementing mission-critical Teamcenter customizations, integrations, and solutions that enable engineering teams to design, manage, and deliver complex hardware products at scale.

This is not a traditional "maintain legacy PLM" role. We want builders. As a member of ArsenalOS PLM, you will help architect and develop next-generation Engineering Backbone from the ground up — integrating CAD, ERP, MES, manufacturing, and engineering systems into scalable modern platforms. You'll be developing custom ITK services, SOA integrations, Active Workspace customizations, and enterprise integrations that serve engineering teams across multiple product lines. We spend time with engineering teams, then provide solutions for the challenges they face managing product data, BOMs, change management, and configuration management.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on, deeply technical Teamcenter Software Engineer who thrives in fast-moving, greenfield environments. You combine strong software engineering foundations with Teamcenter expertise, while avoiding the "this is how PLM has always been done" mindset. We value curiosity, speed, ownership, clean architecture, and pragmatic execution over heavyweight process or legacy baggage.

You should be equally comfortable with:

  • Teamcenter internals and workflows
  • APIs and distributed systems
  • CI/CD and cloud-native architecture
  • Integration patterns and event-driven services
  • Data modeling and scalable engineering platforms

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and deliver complex Teamcenter customizations and integrations for ArsenalOS PLM (ITK, SOA, BMIDE, Active Workspace)
  • Build high-performance integrations between Teamcenter and other ArsenalOS systems (ERP, MES, change management, requirements management, CAD)
  • Design and implement scalable data models, business logic, and workflow solutions while minimizing upgrade friction
  • Contribute to improving the platform observability (Datadog, etc) and reliability
  • Set the bar for engineering excellence — raise standards through opinionated technical decisions, architectural guidance, and high-quality code contributions
  • Leverage frontier AI tooling (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, etc.) for rapid development and serve as a model for how the team should work at speed
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with systems architecture, software product and design, change management, requirements management, and manufacturing teams
  • Define architecture standards for scalable growth and move quickly from concept → prototype → production

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role building products, ideally in a fast-paced environment
  • 3+ years of hands-on Teamcenter development experience including:
    • ITK (Integration Toolkit) development in C/C++
    • BMIDE (Business Modeler IDE) data modeling and customization
    • SOA (Service Oriented Architecture) services and handlers
    • Active Workspace (AWC) customization and development
    • Teamcenter architecture, database schema, and administration
  • Strong programming skills in Java, C++, and C#
  • Experience with modern software development practices: version control (Git), CI/CD, automated testing, code review
  • Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, etc.) and ability to leverage them for rapid, high-quality development
  • Experience working with large enterprise applications and platforms with high availability requirements
  • Database experience (SQL, Oracle or SQL Server, data modeling, query optimization)
  • Strong opinions about code quality, architecture, and engineering best practices — you're a bar raiser
  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Electrical Engineering or related field
  • U.S. Person status is required as this position needs to access export controlled data

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience with Teamcenter upgrades/migrations (14.x → 2506/25.x) and cloud deployment architectures
  • Experience with CAD integrations (NX, SolidWorks) and other PLM platforms (Windchill, Aras, Enovia)
  • Experience in hyper growth startup-like environments or aerospace/defense manufacturing
  • Understanding of PLM adjacent systems: ERP (Oracle, SAP), MES, WMS, CAD, BOM management
  • Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
  • Knowledge of manufacturing processes, product development lifecycle, and engineering change management
  • Experience with web technologies (JavaScript/TypeScript, React, REST APIs)
  • Eligible to obtain and maintain a U.S. Secret/Top Secret Security clearance
US Salary Range
$126,000—$194,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers.   • What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to . Data Privacy

POS-11886

Application deadline: Tuesday, September 8th at 9am ET.

Role Summary

Our mission at HubSpot is to help millions of organizations grow better. HubSpot Media is a fast-growing digital media business reaching more than 70 million people monthly through newsletters, podcasts, and YouTube channels. As Senior Marketer, Paid Ads, you'll own paid media across HubSpot Media and broader full-funnel campaigns, connecting investment decisions to subscriber growth, qualified pipeline, and revenue. You'll directly plan, buy, optimize, and measure campaigns while partnering across teams to turn performance insights into business outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Own paid media strategy, planning, budget allocation, optimization, and performance across HubSpot Media properties and broader full-funnel campaigns.
  • Drive subscriber, lead, pipeline, and revenue growth by connecting paid media investments to measurable downstream business outcomes.
  • Plan, execute, and optimize self-serve campaigns across paid social, paid search, influencer, newsletter, podcast, review site, and emerging paid channels.
  • Lead paid media strategy for product launches and demand generation campaigns, including audience strategy, channel orchestration, and budget allocation.
  • Make real-time pacing, optimization, and budget reallocation decisions based on campaign performance and business priorities.
  • Design and run experiments across creative, audiences, landing pages, offers, devices, and channel mix, documenting hypotheses, success metrics, and learnings.
  • Build performance reporting that gives stakeholders clear visibility into investment efficiency, subscriber quality, pipeline, revenue, and other business outcomes.
  • Partner across brand, direct response, creative, copy, video, analytics, lifecycle, GTM, and MarTech teams to improve campaign performance and apply AI and automation to accelerate analysis and optimization.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on paid media experience personally planning, launching, optimizing, and measuring campaigns.
  • Direct experience buying and optimizing campaigns across Facebook, Google, and LinkedIn.
  • Experience supporting an owned media property, publisher, subscription product, or content brand, with an understanding of both audience development and demand generation.
  • Experience owning meaningful paid media budgets, including pacing, optimization, and reallocation decisions while campaigns are live.
  • Ability to connect paid media performance to downstream outcomes such as subscriber quality, qualified pipeline, revenue, and ARR.
  • Experience analyzing attribution and performance when data is incomplete, diagnosing tracking issues, and improving measurement processes.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for campaign analysis, pacing models, and performance reporting.
  • Clear communication skills and demonstrated experience using AI tools to improve reporting, analysis, creative research, or campaign optimization.

Nice-to-Have Qualifications

  • Experience with HubSpot, Looker, or comparable analytics platforms.
  • Experience with newsletter or creator acquisition using platforms such as SparkLoop, Beehiiv, Kit, or similar tools.
  • Background in paid media for media networks, media agencies, publishers, or subscription products.
  • Experience with full-funnel incrementality testing, geo holdouts, or platform lift studies.

Where You'll Work

  • Location: United States
  • Work location: Remote
  • Travel: Less than 5%

Application Requirements

  • Applications must be submitted by: Tuesday, September 8th at 9am ET.
  • Applications must be submitted in English.
  • Required materials: Resume/CV.
  • Cover letter: Optional.

Pay & Benefits

The cash compensation below includes base salary, on-target commission for employees in eligible roles, and annual bonus targets under HubSpot’s bonus plan for eligible roles. In addition to cash compensation, some roles are eligible to participate in HubSpot’s equity plan to receive restricted stock units (RSUs). Some roles may also be eligible for overtime pay. Individual compensation packages are tailored to your skills, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons.

This resource will help guide how we recommend thinking about the range you see. Learn more about HubSpot’s compensation philosophy.

Benefits are also an important piece of your total compensation package. Explore the benefits and perks HubSpot offers to help employees grow better.

At HubSpot, fair compensation practices aren’t just about checking off the box for legal compliance. It’s about living out our value of transparency with our employees, candidates, and community.

$94,800—$142,200 USD

We know theconfidence gap and impostor syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so please don’t hesitate to apply — we’d love to hear from you.

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us using this form.

At HubSpot, we value both flexibility and connection. Whether you’re a Remote employee or work from the Office, we want you to start your journey here by building strong connections with your team and peers. If you are joining our Engineering team, you will be required to attend a regional HubSpot office for in-person onboarding. If you join our broader Product team, you’ll also attend other in-person events, such as your Product Group Summit and other gatherings, to continue building on those connections.

If you require an accommodation due to travel limitations or other reasons, please inform your recruiter during the hiring process. We are committed to supporting candidates who may need alternative arrangements

About HubSpot

HubSpot (NYSE: HUBS) is an AI-powered customer platform with all the software, integrations, and resources customers need to connect marketing, sales, and service. HubSpot's connected platform enables businesses to grow faster by focusing on what matters most: customers.

At HubSpot, bold is our baseline. Our employees around the globe move fast, stay customer-obsessed, and win together. Our culture is grounded in four commitments: Solve for the Customer, Be Bold, Learn Fast, Align, Adapt & Go!, and Deliver with HEART. These commitments shape how we work, lead, and grow.

We’re building a company where people can do their best work. We focus on brilliant work, not badge swipes. By combining clarity, ownership, and trust, we create space for big thinking and meaningful progress. And we know that when our employees grow, our customers do too.

Recognized globally for our award-winning culture by Comparably, Glassdoor, Fortune, and more, HubSpot is headquartered in Cambridge, MA, with employees and offices around the world.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Why this role is on the menu

Eversight, part of Instacart, is building next-generation data insights and analytics platforms that help leading CPGs & Retailers make smarter, faster decisions across pricing, promotions, retail media, and omni-commerce. We're hiring a Senior Revenue Operations Manager to build and run end-to-end revenue operations across our Commercial organization (Sales and Customer Success), spanning both CPG and Retail. This is a build-and-own role, not a request-response one: you'll identify what the business needs before it's escalated to you, bring a recommendation, and drive it to completion. You'll report directly to the Director of Sales Capabilities & Strategy, with broad latitude to design process, own reporting, and act as a trusted partner to commercial leadership across Eversight Sales, Customer Success, and Product, along with cross functional partners like Strategic Finance, Commercial Partnerships and Brand Partnerships.

What you'll cook up in your first year

  • Standardized reporting and forecasting models live across CPG and Retail, giving commercial leadership one clear view of pipeline, renewals, and customer health
  • Dashboards built and adopted across Sales and Customer Success that leadership actually uses to make decisions, tracking pipeline, renewal rate, expansion, and churn risk
  • Operational gaps identified and fixed before anyone had to ask, each tied to a measurable improvement in forecast accuracy, data integrity, or process efficiency
  • AI tools, agents, and workflow automations built and shipped that eliminate recurring reporting and data cleanup work, cutting manual operational overhead across the commercial org
  • Trusted operational relationships built across every team you touch, with clean handoffs and no surprises
  • Process documentation and standardized frameworks built as you go, not bolted on after the fact

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Analytics, Statistics, or related field
  • 7+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or a similar function within a SaaS company; experience in CPG, Retail, or trade promotion/pricing analytics highly preferred
  • Proven ability to analyze and interpret complex data sets to deliver actionable insight
  • Fluent in using AI tools, agents, and workflow automations to eliminate manual reporting and data cleanup, as a core part of how you operate rather than an occasional add-on
  • Experience with SQL and Tableau
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present findings to leadership
  • Demonstrated ability to identify challenges, prioritize solutions, and execute improvements independently
  • Adept at working cross-functionally with a focus on aligning multiple stakeholders toward shared goals
  • A self-starter able to operate independently in a fast-paced environment

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • MBA
  • Working knowledge of Salesforce and Planhat (or comparable CS platform)
  • Understanding of the CPG trade promotion, pricing, and revenue growth management landscape
  • Understanding of the Retail Merchandising landscape

jobs.description:
AI Data Platform Field ArchitectThis role has been designated as ‘Remote/Teleworker’, which means you will primarily work from home.

Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.

Job Description:

We are seeking a highly strategic and technically grounded AI Data Platform Field CTO to help drive the next phase of growth for our X10K AI data platform business. This is a customer-facing architect role that leads with a data-first perspective, focusing on how data is created, moved, enriched, and consumed across AI pipelines, using infrastructure as an enabler rather than the starting point.

You will operate at the intersection of data architecture, AI infrastructure, and business value, partnering with customers and sales teams to design high-impact AI solutions spanning RAG, inference, and model training workflows. You will also act as a critical bridge between the field and Product Management, influencing roadmap priorities and helping build repeatable, scalable go-to-market motions.

A key aspect of this role is the ability to work closely with sales and technical teams to identify and prioritize the right opportunities at the right time as we accelerate adoption in a rapidly evolving market. This includes applying strong technical and commercial judgment to align solutions with customer readiness, workload requirements, and scale, ensuring we win where we can deliver the most impact and long-term success.

This is not a pure storage role, but a strong understanding of how data platforms and storage enable AI pipelines is essential, along with the ability to position solutions thoughtfully based on where they deliver the most value.

Key Responsibilities

Data-Centric AI Architecture

  • Lead architecture discussions starting from data characteristics and lifecycle, including:
    • Data volume, velocity, and distribution
    • Structured vs. unstructured data considerations
    • Data locality, gravity, and movement patterns
  • Design AI solutions by optimizing:
    • Data access patterns (sequential vs. random, batch vs. real-time)
    • AI pipelines for data movement efficiency, minimizing bottlenecks between storage, compute, and model layers Metadata, indexing, and retrieval efficiency (critical for RAG)
    • Recommend design optimizations and improvements for performance, cost efficiency, reliability, and trustworthiness.
  • Evaluate how data design decisions impact:
    • Model performance and accuracy
    • Latency (including time-to-first-token)
    • GPU utilization, ingest requirements, and cost efficiency

Customer Engagement & Deal Leadership

  • Lead technical discovery sessions with enterprise customers to identify, shape, and qualify AI Factory opportunities
  • Translate business objectives into scalable AI architectures and solution designs
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to CTOs, Heads of AI, and Data Engineering leaders
  • Drive deal progression by aligning technical solutions to measurable business outcomes
  • Apply strong judgment in identifying where solutions are the right fit based on workload, scale, and requirements, ensuring credibility and long-term customer success

AI Solution Architecture & Sizing

  • Scope and size AI Factory environments based on:
    • GPU counts and configurations
    • Data volumes and throughput requirements
    • Model types and workloads (RAG, inference, training)
  • Define performance expectations across the full AI pipeline, including:
    • Data ingestion and preparation
    • Storage and retrieval patterns
    • GPU utilization and efficiency
  • Provide guidance on optimizing time-to-first-token (TTFT), throughput, and cost efficiency

Data & Storage Integration (X10K Focus)

  • Articulate the role of modern data platforms in AI workflows, including:
    • Object storage (S3) architectures
    • Data pipelines and pipeline simplification/elimination strategies
    • Integration with vector databases and AI frameworks
  • Position data platforms as a strategic enabler of AI performance, not just infrastructure
  • Align solution positioning to customer-specific data scale, access patterns, and performance needs

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Product Management to:
    • Influence roadmap priorities across RAG, inference, and training
    • Provide structured field feedback on customer requirements, gaps, and competitive dynamics
    • Create and present high‑impact technical content (reference architectures, design patterns, whitepapers, conference talks, and internal/external publications) to influence customers, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in a technical presales, solutions architecture, or field CTO role
  • Strong understanding of AI/ML workflows, including:
    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
    • Model inference and deployment
    • (Nice to have) Model training pipelines
  • Demonstrated ability to lead architecture from data requirements and access patterns rather than infrastructure-first design approaches
  • Map and optimize end-to-end data flow across the AI lifecycle, from ingestion through retrieval to model interaction and feedback loops
  • Proven experience working with Product Management and solution teams to define, develop, and extend AI Factory offerings, including:
    • Contributing to reference architectures
    • Influencing product direction and roadmap priorities
  • Experience sizing and designing GPU-based environments for AI workloads
  • Experience working with AI/ML or data engineering teams where data behavior, access patterns, and model interaction—not infrastructure alone—drive architectural decisions
  • Solid understanding of data architecture concepts, including:
    • Data pipelines, data lakes, and object storage
    • Performance considerations for large-scale data access
  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate and position solutions based on fit for purpose, including:
    • Matching architectures to workload requirements and scale
    • Understanding trade-offs across performance, cost, and complexity
  • Proven ability to lead customer discovery and translate requirements into technical solutions
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical and executive audiences

Preferred (Nice-to-Have) Experience

  • Exposure to high-performance computing (HPC) concepts or distributed compute environments
  • Familiarity with AI/ML frameworks and ecosystems (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow, vector databases)
  • Experience working with cloud and hybrid AI infrastructure
  • Background in storage technologies (object storage, high-throughput data platforms)
  • Experience collaborating with Product Management or influencing product strategy

What Success Looks Like

  • Consistently shaping and qualifying high-value AI Factory opportunities
  • Positioning solutions with precision—winning in the right opportunities for the right reasons
  • Enabling field teams to confidently position and sell AI solutions at scale
  • Driving measurable improvements in deal velocity, win rates, and pipeline growth
  • Influencing product direction based on real-world customer needs
  • Establishing a repeatable, scalable approach to AI Factory solution design

What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.

Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.

Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.

Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

We’re looking for an experienced Senior Payroll Specialist to join our Australian People team on a fixed-term contract, commencing as soon as possible through to July 2027.

Ocado is currently undertaking a global payroll transformation, transitioning towards a shared services model. During this period, you’ll provide continuity and senior payroll expertise for our Australian business, ensuring payroll continues to be delivered accurately, on time and in line with Australian requirements.

As our senior local payroll subject matter expert, you’ll own Australian payroll delivery and navigate complex matters including Enterprise Agreements, Modern Awards, annualised salaries, employee entitlements and time and attendance.

This isn’t a purely transactional payroll role. You’ll also help identify risks, strengthen controls, manage external providers and support the transition of Australian payroll into our future shared services model, including knowledge transfer to future delivery teams.

This role can be based remotely anywhere in Australia. Ideally, you’ll be Melbourne-based or able to attend our Truganina site for a small amount of training and knowledge transfer during the first month or so, generally no more than a couple of consecutive days at a time. Following this initial period, the role can be completely remote.

The day to day for a Senior Payroll Specialist may involve:

  • Delivering accurate and timely Australian payroll, including reviewing calculations, outputs and reconciliations.
  • Managing complex payroll transactions, discrepancies, over/underpayments and employee queries.
  • Providing expert advice on Australian payroll legislation, Enterprise Agreements, Modern Awards and employee entitlements.
  • Supporting compliance reconciliations, including annualised salaries, and implementing payroll changes and back payments.
  • Overseeing time and attendance inputs and resolving exceptions with operational teams.
  • Managing external payroll and system providers, validating outputs and driving issues through to resolution.
  • Maintaining payroll controls, audit evidence, governance reporting and identifying payroll risks or control gaps.
  • Supporting the transition to our future shared services model through testing, validation, documentation, training and knowledge transfer.

About You:

We’re looking for an experienced payroll professional who knows Australian payroll inside and out, enjoys solving complex problems and is comfortable working autonomously.

  • Senior-level end-to-end Australian payroll experience.
  • Strong knowledge of Australian payroll legislation and statutory obligations.
  • Experience interpreting Enterprise Agreements and/or Modern Awards and applying employee entitlements.
  • Strong experience with payroll reconciliations, complex discrepancies, governance and controls.
  • Experience managing external payroll providers and confidently challenging outputs where required.
  • Strong Excel and/or Google Sheets skills, including reconciliations and remuneration modelling.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementation, transformation or service delivery change.
  • Strong analytical, stakeholder management and communication skills with excellent attention to detail.

Experience with annualised salary arrangements, time and attendance systems, Workday or another enterprise HRIS, or transitioning payroll into a shared services environment would be highly regarded.

What's In It for You:

  • The chance to make a real impact, helping ensure Australian payroll requirements are understood and embedded into our future operating model.

If you’re an experienced Australian payroll specialist who enjoys solving complex problems, taking ownership and making sure things are done properly, we’d love to hear from you.

Day-to-day responsibilities

  • Create high-quality environment assets and scenes (architecture, organic environment, kits, hero props, set dressing) built for real-time performance.
  • Drive material quality: trim sheets, tileables, layered materials, vertex blends, and reusable material functions as appropriate.
  • Own scene/asset optimization: LOD strategy, streaming considerations, draw calls, memory, lightmap constraints, and platform targets.
  • Lead execution for a small pod or strike team: break down tasks, set short-term priorities, and keep deliverables moving.
  • Provide reviews and mentorship: actionable notes, paintovers/blockouts as needed, and consistent standards for “definition of done.”
  • Collaborate cross-discipline (Design, Lighting, Tech Art, Engineering) to ensure environments support gameplay readability and performance.
  • Support client-facing communication when needed: clarify requirements, share WIP, align on standards, and reduce rework through early alignment.
  • Contribute to pipeline/process improvements: naming conventions, template scenes, kit documentation, and onboarding guides.

Requirements

  • Minimum 8-years of professional game industry experience with at least one shipped title.
  • Experience working with industry standard tools such as Maya, 3DS Max, Blender, Substance Painter, Substance Designer, ZBrush, etc
  • Proven experience shipping or delivering real-time environment work in Unreal Engine 4 or 5.
  • Strong environment art fundamentals: composition, mood, scale, material definition, and cohesion.
  • Strong modeling skills (architectural/modular, hard-surface, and organic); solid UV and baking fundamentals.
  • Strong texturing/material skills (Photoshop + Substance Painter; Designer/trim workflows strongly preferred).
  • Demonstrated optimization knowledge (LODs, texel density, streaming, draw calls, memory budgets).
  • Leadership-level communication: clear written and verbal updates, actionable feedback, strong collaboration habits.
  • Experience mentoring or guiding other artists (formal lead title not required, but leadership behaviors are).
  • Can work Central (CT) core hours with possible overlap hours with Pacific (PT) or Eastern (ET).
  • Work options are flexible: remote / hybrid / onsite.

Nice-to-have

  • Houdini experience (procedural kits, scattering, tools).
  • Foliage/organic workflows (SpeedTree, ZBrush, photogrammetry).
  • Lighting/post-process experience (can support look targets and debug scene issues).
  • Experience owning a small slice of a level/biome from planning to delivery.
  • Comfort working across stylized and realistic pipelines; strong reference analysis skills.
  • Scripting/tooling familiarity (Python, editor scripting, or simple pipeline automation).

Portfolio requirements

Your portfolio must include:

  • Real-time environments showing strong composition, material definition, and scene cohesion.
  • Evidence of production thinking: modularity, reuse, consistency, and optimization awareness.
  • At least one in-engine example (video walkthrough or gameplay capture preferred).
  • Bonus (strongly preferred): evidence of leadership impact—mentorship examples, consistent kits built across multiple assets, documentation/templates, or before/after improvements.

How to apply

  • Resume + portfolio link required.
  • An art test may be required as part of the process.

This position is currently open to candidates residing in the following Canada Provinces: Ontario, Quebec or British Columbia.

GameSim est un studio de développement vidéoludique qui collabore avec des clients afin de créer des jeux aux styles artistiques variés, que ce soit sur PC ou sur console. Nous avons à cœur le savoir-faire, la collaboration et la livraison de produits auxquels nous sommes fiers d’être associés. Si vous aimez élaborer des environnements et des espaces crédibles, nous souhaitons vous rencontrer. Notre siège social est situé à Orlando, en Floride!

Avis d’offre d’emploi (vivier de talents)
Notez que cette offre d’emploi n’est pas associée à un poste actuellement vacant. Nous étoffons de manière proactive un vivier de candidat(e)s qualifié(e)s afin d’anticiper les embauches nécessaires au cours des mois à venir. Les candidatures seront analysées, conservées et considérées lorsque les occasions se présenteront.

Nous cherchons un(e) artiste senior en environnement (avec responsabilités liées au leadership) pour notre équipe! Vous créerez en intégralité de l’art environnemental utilisable en jeu : planification et stratégie → modélisation → matériaux/textures → aménagement → implémentation dans un moteur propriétaire ou commercial. Ceci est un rôle de haut niveau, centré sur la production, qui comporte son lot de responsabilités : vous établirez le niveau de qualité à atteindre et les standards, effectuerez des évaluations, dirigerez les flux de travail, vous assurerez que les environnements sont cohérents au sein des équipes et sont conformes aux attentes des clients, accompagnerez d’autres artistes et éliminerez les bloqueurs de production de manière proactive. Nous cherchons des personnes positives et inclusives, qui communiquent de manière claire et proactive et cherchent toujours des solutions.

À quoi ressemble une période de 90 jours réussie

Au cours de vos 90 premiers jours de travail…

  • Vous utiliserez de manière efficace UE5, ou vous vous adapterez rapidement à un moteur propriétaire et vous livrerez un travail de qualité tout en respectant ses restrictions.
  • Vous livrerez un ensemble de contenu environnemental (une trousse modulaire, un ensemble de héros ou une section d’une scène clé) soigné et utilisable qui respecte la direction artistique du projet et les performances ciblées.
  • Vous établirez la confiance en tant que senior : vous partagerez des rétroactions claires, vous créerez des exemples/modèles réutilisables et vous améliorerez la cohérence et la cadence de production de l’équipe.
  • Vous identifierez dès les premiers stades les risques environnementaux (portée, lacunes du flux de travail, restrictions de performance) et proposerez des solutions pratiques aux équipes de direction artistique, d’art technique et de production.

Responsabilités au quotidien

  • Créer des scènes et des éléments environnementaux d’excellente qualité (architecture, environnement organique, trousses, accessoires de personnages, aménagement), conçus pour avoir une bonne performance en temps réel.
  • Stimuler la qualité matérielle : trim sheets, pavés potentiels, matériaux à calques, fusions de vertex, et fonctions de matériau réutilisables, le cas échéant.
  • Gérer l’optimisation de la scène/des éléments : stratégie pour le niveau de détail, considérations liées à la diffusion continue, draw calls, mémoire, restrictions de la lightmap et plateformes ciblées.
  • Gérer une petite cellule ou une équipe de frappe : diviser les tâches, établir les priorités à court terme et s’assurer de la progression des livrables
  • Être une source d’évaluations et de mentorat : remarques concrètes, repeintures/dissimulations lorsque nécessaire et standards cohérents pour la « définition de fini ».
  • Effectuer une collaboration interdisciplinaire (conception, éclairage, art technique, ingénierie) afin de s’assurer que les environnements sont compatibles avec la lisibilité de la jouabilité et la performance du jeu.
  • Contribuer aux communications avec les clients lorsque nécessaire : clarifier les exigences, partager les éléments en cours d’élaboration, se mettre d’accord sur les standards à respecter et réduire la quantité de travail à reprendre en se mettant d’accord dès les premiers stades.
  • Contribuer à l’amélioration des pipelines/processus : conventions d’appellation, modèles de scènes, documentation de la trousse et guides pour les nouveaux membres de l’équipe.

Exigences

  • Au moins 8 ans d’expérience professionnelle dans l’industrie des jeux vidéos, incluant au moins un jeu publié.
  • Expérience de travail avec des outils standards de l’industrie, tels que Maya, 3DS Max, Blender, Substance Painter, Substance Designer, ZBrush, etc.
  • Expérience prouvée en livraison d’environnements en temps réel dans Unreal Engine 4 ou 5.
  • Fondements solides en art environnemental : composition, ambiance, échelle, définition matérielle et cohérence.
  • Compétences solides en modélisation (éléments architecturaux/modulaires, à surface dure et organiques); fondements solides en UV et pré-calcul.
  • Compétences solides en matière de textures/matériaux (Photoshop + Substance Painter; les flux de travail de concepteur/TRIM sont un atout majeur).
  • Connaissances prouvées en optimisation (niveaux de détail, densité des pixels texturés, diffusion continue, draw calls, mémoire disponible).
  • Capacité à communiquer exprimant un leadership : mises à jour claires à l’écrit comme à l’oral, rétroaction concrète, bonnes habitudes solides pour la collaboration.
  • Expérience en mentorat ou en soutien d’autres artistes (un titre officiel de gestionnaire n’est pas exigé, mais les comportements associés le sont).
  • Capacité à travailler pendant les heures communes du fuseau horaire du Centre (HNC), avec possibilité de partager quelques heures de travail avec les fuseaux horaires du Pacifique (HNP) ou de l’Est (HNE).
  • Options de travail flexibles : télétravail / hybride / présentiel.

Atouts

  • Expérience avec Houdini (trousses procédurales, diffusion, outils).
  • Flux de travail pour feuillage/éléments organiques (SpeedTree, ZBrush, photogrammétrie).
  • Expérience en éclairage/post-procession (peut atteindre les visuels ciblés et effectuer le débogage des scènes en cas de problème).
  • Expérience en gestion exclusive d’un fragment d’un niveau/biome, de la planification à la livraison.
  • Capacité à travailler à la fois sur des pipelines stylisés et réalistes; compétences solides en analyse de références.
  • Familiarité avec le scriptage/l’outillage (Python, scripts de l’éditeur ou automatisation simple du pipeline).

Exigences du portfolio

Votre portfolio doit comprendre :

  • Des environnements en temps réel qui démontrent une composition, une définition matérielle et une cohésion solides.
  • Preuves d’une pensée centrée sur la production : modularité, réutilisation, cohérence et conscience de l’optimisation.
  • Au moins un exemple d’implémentation dans un moteur (vidéo de fonctionnement ou capture en jeu privilégiées).
  • Comme atout majeur, un exemple démontrant l’impact de votre leadership (des exemples de mentorat, des trousses cohérentes composées d’éléments multiples, de la documentation/des modèles, ou des comparaisons avant/après montrant une amélioration).

Comment poser votre candidature

Come join the organization that is redefining security for the AI era. At Wiz, you’ll have the freedom to think creatively, dream big, and use your full range of skills to contribute to our momentous growth. jobs.description:
Job Title:

Head of Product

Job Description

About Concentrix

Concentrix is a global technology and services leader that powers the world's best brands, today and into the future. We work with more than 2,000 clients, including over 155 of the Fortune Global 500, designing and delivering customer and employee experiences at scale across every major industry and geography.

Our business is built on solving hard, real-world problems for large enterprises. Increasingly, that means building AI-powered products that change how customer experience is delivered — not slideware, but software running in production against demanding client commitments.

This position will be remote/WAH and can be performed anywhere in the United States.

About iX Suite

iX Suite is Concentrix's family of AI-powered products for customer experience. It spans three product lines: agent-assist software that makes human agents faster and better, customer-facing AI automation that resolves issues end to end, and an intelligence and memory layer that makes both smarter over time.

iX Suite is strategically central to Concentrix. It is how we protect and grow our core business as AI reshapes the industry. This is a mandate with real weight behind it, real budget, and direct visibility to the executive team — not a side experiment.

The Role

We are hiring a Head of Product to own product strategy, roadmap, and execution across all three iX Suite product lines. You will report directly to the Group Vice President of the Global Product Organization and sit as a peer to the leaders of Engineering, Commercial, and Delivery.

You will own the decisions that matter most: what we build, what we buy or partner for, and whether a product is ready to launch and stand behind. You will build a single, coherent product roadmap and a product story that both business leaders and technical architects can read and trust.

This is a build-inside-a-large-enterprise role. You will ship great product by partnering closely with engineering rather than commanding it, by designing commercial models that fit a services-led business, and by creating demand and clarity in an environment that does not run on classic product-led-growth mechanics. If you are energized by shipping real product under real constraints, this is a role with genuine scope and impact. If you need full org-chart authority over engineering to feel effective, this is not the right fit — and we would rather be honest about that up front.

What You Will Own

  • Product strategy and roadmap across three product lines, unified into one coherent plan and narrative.
  • The build-versus-partner-versus-consulting decision for new products and features.
  • Launch-readiness decisions: owning the criteria, the checklist, and the accountability for whether a product ships.
  • Creating a great culture of product management across a team of 20+ product managers.
  • Post-launch product performance review and the fast-follow feature decisions that come out of it.
  • A single source of truth for product materials, built and maintained jointly with the Commercial leader.
  • Market intelligence, competitive landscape, and product-level enablement.
  • Joint responsibility for pricing and packaging, in partnership with Commercial.

What You Bring

Required Experience

  • Ten or more years in product management, with at least three to five years leading product in a senior or head-of-product capacity.
  • A track record of shipping software products inside a large, complex, matrixed organization — where you delivered by influencing teams you did not directly control, not by relying on reporting lines.
  • Experience owning a product roadmap end to end, including hard prioritization and cut decisions under fixed external commitments.
  • Demonstrated ability to translate business complexity into a clear product strategy that both non-technical executives and technical leaders can act on.
  • Experience partnering deeply with engineering as an equal, and with commercial and delivery functions, to get product into production.

Strongly Preferred

  • Product leadership in an environment with heavy IT, security, or compliance dependencies — where other teams controlled parts of your critical path.
  • Experience building or evolving commercial and pricing models for software delivered inside a services, enterprise, or embedded context, rather than pure self-serve SaaS.
  • Experience shipping product while the organization itself was changing — a restructure, integration, carve-out, or platform consolidation.
  • Applied experience with AI or machine-learning products in production.

Skills and Attributes

  • Deep product craft: you know what great product management and product-led growth look like, and you can build that discipline in a team — while adapting it to an environment that does not have all the ideal conditions.
  • Influence without authority: you win engineering, commercial, and delivery partners over through credibility, sequencing, and judgment.
  • Decisiveness under ambiguity: you make and defend hard scope calls to protect a commitment, rather than deferring to endless alignment.
  • Clear communication: you make complex product direction legible across very different audiences in the same room.
  • Bias to ship: you treat constraints as the terrain to navigate, not as reasons a thing cannot be done.

Compensation and Benefits

This is a Vice President level role.

The base salary range for this position is $210000- $250000, plus incentives that align with individual and company performance. Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, comprehensive employee assistance program, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off and holidays and paid learning days.

The deadline to apply for this position is September 15, 2026. This position is for an existing, immediate vacancy. We are currently seeking to fill this role with an individual who can start as soon as possible.

Concentrix is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace and welcome applicants of all backgrounds.

How to Apply

Apply through the Concentrix careers portal or contact our internal talent acquisition team directly. We are moving quickly on this role and reviewing applications on a rolling basis.

Full time

The employee is regularly required to operate a computer, keyboard, telephone/headset, and/or other office equipment as essential functions of this position. Work is generally sedentary in nature.

Equal Employment Opportunity:

jobs.description:
About Us:

Verifiable is a provider credentialing and network monitoring platform, delivery industry-leading AI, API and Software solutions to help healthcare organizations optimize operations at enterprise scale. We are a top Salesforce partner, winning the 2024 Salesforce Partner Innovation Award, and also were named to Inc. 5000 2025, the most prestigious ranking of America's fastest-growing private companies. We work with leading healthcare organizations such as Humana Dental, Talkspace, Headway, Empower Pharmacy, and many others.
Verifiable is a fast-moving, early-stage team that values impact, ownership, and follow-through. Everyone here rolls up their sleeves, dives into ambiguity, and takes end-to-end responsibility for meaningful work. Priorities shift, problems aren’t always perfectly defined, and we move with urgency—so we look for people who are energized by hard problems, rapid learning, and stepping in wherever the team needs support.
We’re collaborative and human, but we keep a high bar. If you thrive in a scrappy, high-ownership environment where your work directly shapes the company’s trajectory, you’ll feel right at home here.

The Salesforce Implementation Consultant configures, customizes, and validates Verifiable’s Salesforce-based implementation solutions for customers. This role collaborates closely with Implementation Managers, Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and customer stakeholders to deliver technically sound, scalable implementations aligned with customer business needs.

The ideal candidate is comfortable working directly in Salesforce, translating customer requirements into technical solutions, and identifying risks early. Strong Salesforce configuration experience, problem-solving skills, and the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  • Configure Verifiable’s Salesforce-based SaaS solutions for customer implementations, including fields, page layouts, permissions, automation, reporting, dashboards, and implementation-specific configuration.

  • Partner with Implementation Managers to translate customer requirements into clear technical solutions, implementation tasks, and delivery plans.

  • Serve as a trusted technical resource for customers and internal teams throughout the implementation lifecycle.

  • Build, update, and troubleshoot Salesforce automation, including Flow-based processes, validation rules, data updates, and configuration-driven business logic.

  • Support data migration, data cleanup, and backfill activities using Salesforce tools such as Data Loader, reports, exports, and structured import processes.

  • Configure and validate Salesforce security models, including users, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings, and object/field-level access.

  • Troubleshoot technical issues during implementation, identify root causes, and clearly communicate resolution options.

  • Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to define technical gaps, product issues, enhancement requests, or required development support.

  • Participate in QA, UAT support, and go-live readiness activities to ensure implementations are accurate, stable, and customer-ready.

  • Create and maintain technical documentation, including configuration notes, solution designs, deployment notes, testing instructions, and customer-specific implementation details.

  • Communicate clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders, including customers, Implementation Managers, Engineering, Product, and Customer Success.

  • Apply Salesforce and Verifiable implementation best practices to ensure solutions are scalable, supportable, and aligned with long-term customer success.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience implementing and configuring Salesforce or Salesforce-based SaaS solutions for customers.

  • Strong hands-on Salesforce configuration experience, including objects, fields, page layouts, record types, validation rules, reports, dashboards, and permissions.

  • Experience building and troubleshooting Salesforce Flows.

  • Understanding of Salesforce security and sharing architecture, including users, profiles, roles, permission sets, sharing rules, and object/field-level security.

  • Experience with data migration, data repair, or data backfill activities using tools such as Data Loader, Salesforce reports, exports, and structured data imports.

  • Ability to analyze customer requirements and translate them into technical implementation tasks.

  • Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, especially within Salesforce automation, data, permissions, and configuration.

  • Ability to identify when a request requires product, engineering, or development support and clearly specify the needed technical changes.

  • Experience delivering custom Salesforce configuration in environments that include a managed package, with an understanding of package constraints, extension patterns, upgrade impacts, and how to avoid breaking managed package functionality.

Nice-to-Have

  • Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent hands-on Salesforce experience.

  • Experience working in healthcare, credentialing, provider data management, compliance, or regulated industries.

  • Experience supporting integrations, APIs, middleware, or connected systems.

  • Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Salesforce deployment tools, or similar project delivery systems.

  • Experience creating solution design documentation or technical implementation plans.

  • Familiarity with Apex, SOQL, Salesforce metadata, or deployment/change set processes is a plus.

  • Experience with AI to improve implementation efficiency, documentation quality, testing coverage, and technical problem-solving.

The Honors Application Reviewer Manager position in Undergraduate Admissions within Strategic Enrollment Management provides a holistic evaluation source for domestic and international applications for acceptance into the Honors Program at The Ohio State University. The Honors Application Reviewer Manager provides supervision to ten (10) seasonal honors application reviewers. The seasonal honors application review manager is responsible for planning trainings and meetings, assisting with application assignment, providing feedback, and coaching to reviewers and resolving concerns from reviewers. Develops a thorough understanding of Ohio State’s Honors Program enrollment goals, policies and procedures and completes holistic review and evaluation of application credentials. Works with the assistant director of application review to employ a comprehensive process of setting expectations of seasonal reviewers through role planning, coaching, assignment and review. The seasonal honors application reviewer manager has the responsibility to remain up to date with procedural and guideline changes which might affect the review process provided by Undergraduate Admissions.

Opportunities for professional development during the review season will be offered. jobs.excerpt: ABOUT QUINCEQuince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo.
jobs.description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Head of Inventory Control and Strategy

Quince is seeking a seasoned inventory control expert to run our global inventory control program from the ground up. You will own the standards, playbook, and governance that underpin inventory integrity across our entire growing global fulfillment network.

Responsibilities

Inventory Accuracy & Shrink Control

  • Own book vs. physical accuracy targets across all global nodes
  • Shrink control frameworks — identifying, quantifying, and remediating inventory loss at every point of the supply chain

Cycle Count Governance

  • Execute the global cycle count cadence strategy
  • Oversee counts and audit protocols across all facilities and 3PL partners

Reconciliation & Adjustment Root Cause

  • Own the inventory adjustment governance model
  • Drive cross-functional root cause analysis on systemic variances across all functions
  • Maintain SOX-compliant inventory controls, including documented approval thresholds, audit trails for adjustments, and segregation of duties across the reconciliation process
  • Reduce unresolved adjustment volume quarter over quarter with measurable targets

WMS Integrity

  • Ensure inventory records in WMS accurately reflect physical reality at all times
  • Partner with technology and operations teams to identify and close data integrity gaps, latency issues, and process breakdowns within the WMS

Global SOP Design & Process Infrastructure

  • Author and maintain the global inventory control SOP library — policies, procedures, escalation paths, and training frameworks
  • Drive consistency of execution across domestic and international nodes

Qualifications

Required:

  • 7+ years in inventory control, fulfillment operations, or supply chain at a high-volume retailer, e-commerce operator, or logistics company
  • Experience maintaining SOX compliance for inventory processes, including control documentation and coordination with internal/external audit
  • Deep WMS expertise, having configured, audited, and conducted troubleshooting of WMS inventory records, not just used the system
  • Proven ability to build global or multi-site SOPs from scratch and drive adoption across distributed teams
  • Strong analytics literacy: you can write SQL, build a reconciliation model in a spreadsheet, and tell a story with inventory data without needing a data analyst as an intermediary
  • Experience managing 3PL relationships and holding external partners accountable

Preferred:

  • Experience operating across international fulfillment nodes (APAC, EMEA, or global 3PL networks)
  • Familiarity with a variety of WMS platforms
  • Background in audit, finance-adjacent inventory controls, or shrink investigation

Pay Range: $170,000-$220,000

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.

$170,000—$220,000 USD

WHY QUINCE?

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. 📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Nous recherchons un Product Owner / Coordinateur Business Analyse pour piloter la gestion stratégique, fonctionnelle et opérationnelle d’une plateforme web dédiée au traitement dématérialisé des permis d’urbanisme publics et privés.

Dans ce rôle, vous assurez à la fois l’ownership produit et la coordination de l’analyse métier, en veillant à l’alignement entre les besoins opérationnels, les priorités du programme et les évolutions réglementaires.

1. Product Ownership – Gestion du produit

  • Définir, porter et faire évoluer la vision produit en cohérence avec les besoins métier, les priorités organisationnelles et le cadre réglementaire.
  • Gérer et prioriser le backlog produit, rédiger les user stories et suivre l’avancement des développements.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes techniques et fonctionnelles afin de garantir la cohérence globale de la solution.
  • Organiser et animer les instances de gouvernance produit : ateliers, revues, démonstrations et tests utilisateurs.
  • Identifier les évolutions nécessaires, proposer des améliorations continues et veiller à la qualité fonctionnelle du produit.

2. Business Analyse – Référent des processus urbanisme

  • Être l’interlocuteur de référence pour l’analyse, la modélisation et l’optimisation des processus métier.
  • Veiller à ce que la plateforme soutienne efficacement les processus opérationnels liés à l’urbanisme.
  • Conduire les ateliers de définition et d’amélioration des processus, puis accompagner leur mise en œuvre.
  • Promouvoir et appliquer les bonnes pratiques en gestion des processus (BPM).
  • Faire office de point de référence pour les analystes impliqués dans le programme de dématérialisation des permis.
  • Assurer un rôle de coach auprès des nouveaux analystes rejoignant l’équipe.
  • Soutenir le programme manager dans la coordination des priorités des analystes en fonction des orientations stratégiques du programme.

📝 Votre profil

  • Expérience confirmée en tant que Senior Product Owner.
  • Expérience avérée dans la coordination de parties prenantes multiples, tant métier que techniques et fournisseurs.
  • Expérience confirmée en Product Ownership dans des programmes digitaux complexes.
  • Capacité à analyser l’impact d’évolutions réglementaires sur les processus métier et à les traduire en besoins fonctionnels.
  • Capacité à assurer l’ownership fonctionnel d’un produit digital, de sa vision jusqu’à son amélioration continue.
  • Leadership naturel, avec aptitude à encadrer, coacher et challenger des analystes.
  • Communication claire et structurée avec des interlocuteurs métier, IT et décisionnels.
  • Approche proactive, orientée résultats, avec un niveau d’exigence élevé sur la qualité fonctionnelle.
  • Maîtrise indispensable de Agile Scrum, Azure DevOps, Confluence et Miro.
  • Français obligatoire.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Nous vous offrirons un environnement de travail agréable, entouré(e) de collègues sympathiques. Ensemble, nous élaborerons un plan de carrière, avec une attention particulière et un budget dédié à la formation ou à la certification complémentaire. Overview of CommonLit

CommonLit is a nonprofit education technology organization dedicated to ensuring that all students, especially students in Title I schools, graduate with the reading, writing, communication, and problem-solving skills they need to be successful in college and beyond. We envision a world where all students get the opportunity to have a world class education. We operate an online reading program for grades 3-12, www.CommonLit.org, that is used by teachers in over 90,000 American schools.

The Opportunity

CommonLit's finance team manages all financial and accounting operations across our ~$20M organization. As we scale a fast-growing SaaS operating model, the finance team plays a critical role in pursuing a double bottom line – building financial stability while expanding mission-driven impact. As Controller, you will lead the day-to-day accounting operations for CommonLit — running the month-end close, executing treasury operations, and supporting compliance — while managing two direct reports (the Finance & Accounting Coordinator and Accounts Receivable Coordinator). You will report to and work closely with the VP of Finance and Accounting, who owns cash strategy, banking relationships, audit and insurance oversight, and the organization's broader financial strategy.

This role is well suited to an experienced accounting professional who wants to apply strong technical skills and hands-on people management within a growing, mission-driven organization. You will own execution of the accounting function day-to-day, while partnering with the VP of Finance and Accounting on more strategic financial matters.

In the first 90 days in the role, you will be responsible for an accurate month-end close with an eye toward improving timeline and efficiency, and will begin building strong working relationships with your direct reports and cross-functional partners.

We're hiring a Director of Compensation to own our broad-based comp strategy end-to-end. This is a senior people leadership role reporting to the Head of Total Rewards. You’ll drive the programs, frameworks, and cross-functional partnerships that keep our pay competitive and fair as we grow into new markets. This role sits at the intersection of people strategy and business partnership, and the person who fills it will have a direct line of sight to how we attract, retain, and motivate the talent that powers Instacart's growth.

What you'll cook up in your first year

Our annual and mid-year comp cycles run with greater precision and speed. You own the design and delivery end-to-end and have raised the quality bar even as scope and complexity have grown.

Work closely with HR Business Partners, Finance, Legal, and senior business leaders to solve hard problems and give them recommendations they can act on. You'll weigh in on executive offers, retention decisions, org changes, pay equity question, and stand behind difficult calls in gray areas.

Instacart's equity compensation approach is competitive and forward-looking. You deeply understand the market landscape and drive meaningful changes to how we design and communicate equity.

You lead a high-performing team of compensation business partners. You set clear direction, high standards, and cultivate an environment where people do their best work.

You carry individual contributor responsibilities as a compensation business partner to help you stay close to evolving business needs. Scale your experience to coach your team.

Lead our international expansion compensation work. Build the frameworks, market data, and guidance needed to pay people competitively and compliantly as we expand into new countries.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 10+ years of progressive compensation experience, with at least 3 years leading a people management role.
  • Proven track record directly supporting large R&D or Engineering functions, with experience advising VP/SVP-level leaders on complex compensation decisions and earning their trust.
  • Deep expertise in equity compensation design and strategy. You've worked at a tech company where equity is central to the comp philosophy, and you know how to shape it, not just administer it.
  • Experience building compensation programs at scale, not just operating within inherited ones: job architecture, market pricing, performance cycles, and pay-for-performance frameworks.
  • You can transform disparate data into a clear recommendation for executives. Expertise in spreadsheet work (gSheets and Excel).
  • A genuine interest in how AI and technology can make compensation work better, and the initiative to actually go build it.

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience supporting Sales/GTM client groups alongside R&D.
  • Exposure to executive compensation design and strategy.
  • International compensation experience, especially in the context of expanding into new geographies.
  • Familiarity with AI or advanced analytics tools (Tableau, SQL, Python) to accelerate compensation work.

jobs.description:
Wer wir sind

NEXUS gehört zu den führenden europäischen Anbietern von Softwarelösungen für Krankenhäuser, Reha-Einrichtungen und das Sozialwesen.

Im Mittelpunkt steht unser Krankenhausinformationssystem (KIS), mit dem wir Kliniken bei der Digitalisierung ihrer Kernprozesse unterstützen.

Mit mehreren tausend Mitarbeitenden gestalten wir die digitale Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens – gemeinsam, innovativ und mit Leidenschaft.

Wir suchen ab sofort eine/n

Gruppenleitung Projektmanagement (m/w/d)

Schwerpunkt Krankenhausinformationssystem (KIS)

Standort: Donaueschingen, Ismaning, Frankfurt am Main, Jena, Berlin

Gestalte die Zukunft unseres Projektmanagements.

Bei NEXUS entwickeln Menschen mit Leidenschaft innovative Softwarelösungen für das Gesundheitswesen. Als einer der führenden europäischen Anbieter von eHealth-Lösungen unterstützen wir Krankenhäuser dabei, ihre Prozesse digital und effizient zu gestalten – damit Ärzt:innen und Pflegekräfte mehr Zeit für das Wesentliche haben: ihre Patient:innen.

Im Bereich Professional Services entsteht aktuell eine neue Führungsebene. Deshalb suchen wir zwei Gruppenleitungen, die nicht nur Menschen führen, sondern gemeinsam mit uns den Projektmanagementbereich der Zukunft aufbauen.

Wenn du Freude daran hast, Teams weiterzuentwickeln, komplexe Projekte zu steuern und Strukturen aktiv mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Deine Aufgabe

Als Gruppenleitung führst du ein Team von fünf bis zehn Projektleiter:innen und sorgst gemeinsam mit ihnen für den Erfolg unserer Kundenprojekte.

Dabei übernimmst du Verantwortung in drei zentralen Bereichen:


Menschen führen

Du entwickelst dein Team fachlich und persönlich weiter, führst regelmäßige Feedback- und Entwicklungsgespräche und schaffst ein Umfeld, in dem Projektleiter:innen erfolgreich arbeiten können. Gleichzeitig unterstützt du das Recruiting neuer Kolleg:innen und förderst den Wissenstransfer innerhalb deiner Gruppe.


Projekte steuern

Du behältst den Überblick über alle Projekte deiner Gruppe, erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und sorgst für die richtige Priorisierung von Ressourcen. Bei Eskalationen unterstützt du deine Projektleiter:innen und arbeitest eng mit Kunden sowie internen Fachbereichen zusammen.

Gemeinsam entwickelt ihr professionelle Standards und Methoden für unser Projektmanagement weiter und etabliert diese nachhaltig im Team.


Den Bereich weiterentwickeln

Diese Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, den Aufbau einer neuen Führungsebene aktiv mitzugestalten.

Zusammen mit den anderen Gruppenleitungen entwickelst du Prozesse, Methoden und Strukturen weiter und bringst deine Erfahrungen aus dem Projektalltag in die kontinuierliche Verbesserung unseres Bereichs ein.

Wähle deinen Schwerpunkt

Wir besetzen zwei Gruppenleitungspositionen.


Schwerpunkt Neukundenprojekte

Du verantwortest Projekte zur Einführung unseres Krankenhausinformationssystems bei neuen Kunden. Diese Projekte zeichnen sich durch hohe Dynamik, viele Beteiligte und anspruchsvolle Projektphasen bis zum erfolgreichen Go-live aus.


Schwerpunkt Bestandskunden

Du verantwortest Projekte rund um Rollouts, Upgrades und die Weiterentwicklung bestehender Kundeninstallationen. Hier stehen langfristige Kundenbeziehungen, Veränderungsmanagement und nachhaltige Projektqualität im Mittelpunkt.

Bitte gib in deiner Bewerbung an, welcher Schwerpunkt dich besonders interessiert. Selbstverständlich freuen wir uns auch über Bewerbungen, wenn beide Bereiche für dich spannend sind.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Programmmanagement komplexer IT-Projekte
  • Idealerweise Erfahrung im Gesundheitswesen oder im Krankenhausumfeld
  • Erste Führungserfahrung oder den Wunsch, den nächsten Schritt in eine Führungsrolle zu gehen
  • Freude daran, Menschen zu entwickeln und Teams erfolgreich zu machen
  • Erfahrung in der Steuerung mehrerer Projekte gleichzeitig
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Entscheidungsfreude und Durchsetzungsvermögen
  • Strukturierte, pragmatische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Deutschlands

Darauf kannst du dich freuen

  • Eine neu geschaffene Führungsrolle mit großem Gestaltungsspielraum
  • Die Möglichkeit, den Projektmanagementbereich eines führenden eHealth-Unternehmens aktiv mitzuentwickeln
  • Anspruchsvolle Digitalisierungsprojekte im Gesundheitswesen
  • Flache Hierarchien und kurze Entscheidungswege
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten sowie mobiles Arbeiten innerhalb Deutschlands
  • Dienstwagen auch zur privaten Nutzung
  • Attraktive, leistungsorientierte Vergütung
  • Individuelle Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Ein wertschätzendes Miteinander und regelmäßige Team-Events

Interesse geweckt?

Dann freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Bitte sende uns deine Bewerbungsunterlagen inklusive Gehaltsvorstellung, frühestmöglichem Eintrittstermin sowie deinem bevorzugten Schwerpunkt (Neukunden- oder Bestandskundenprojekte) über unser Bewerberportal.
